verses.fr: Le serviteur lui dit: Voici, il y a dans cette ville un homme de Dieu, et c''est un homme considéré; tout ce qu''il dit ne manque pas d''arriver. Allons y donc; peut-être nous fera-t-il connaître le chemin que nous devons prendre.
verses.am: እርሱም። እነሆ፥ አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በዚህች ከተማ አለ፤ እርሱም የተከበረ ሰው ነው፥ የሚናገረውም ሁሉ በእውነት ይፈጸማል፤ አሁን ወደዚያ እንሂድ፤ ምናልባት የምንሄድበትን መንገድ ይነግረናል አለው።

verses.en: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?
verses.fr: Saül dit à son serviteur: Mais si nous y allons, que porterons-nous à l''homme de Dieu? Car il n''y a plus de provisions dans nos sacs, et nous n''avons aucun présent à offrir à l''homme de Dieu. Qu''est-ce que nous avons?
verses.am: ሳኦልም ብላቴናውን። እነሆ፥ እንሄዳለን፤ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ሰው ምን እናመጣለታለን? እንጀራ ከከረጢታችን አልቆአልና፥ እጅ መንሻም የለንምና ለእግዚአብሔር ሰው የምናመጣለት ምን አለን? አለው።

verses.en: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have here at hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.
verses.fr: Le serviteur reprit la parole, et dit à Saül: Voici, j''ai sur moi le quart d''un sicle d''argent; je le donnerai à l''homme de Dieu, et il nous indiquera notre chemin.
verses.am: ብላቴናው ደግሞ ለሳኦል መልሶ። እነሆ፥ በእጄ የሰቅል ብር ሩቡ አለኝ፤ እርሱንም መንገዳችንን እንዲነግረን ለእግዚአብሔር ሰው እሰጣለሁ አለ።

verses.en: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to enquire of God, thus he spake, Come, and let us go to the seer: for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)
verses.fr: Autrefois en Israël, quand on allait consulter Dieu, on disait: Venez, et allons au voyant! Car celui qu''on appelle aujourd''hui le prophète s''appelait autrefois le voyant. -
verses.am: ዛሬ ነቢይ የሚባለው ቀድሞ ባለ ራእይ ይባል ነበርና አስቀድሞ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ሲሄድ። ኑ፥ ወደ ባለ ራእይ እንሂድ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.
verses.fr: Saül dit à son serviteur: Tu as raison: viens, allons! Et ils se rendirent à la ville où était l''homme de Dieu.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ብላቴናውን። የተናገረኸው ነገር መልካም ነው፤ ና፥ እንሂድ አለውና የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወዳለበት ከተማ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And as they went up the hill to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?
verses.fr: Comme ils montaient à la ville, ils rencontrèrent des jeunes filles sorties pour puiser de l''eau, et ils leur dirent: Le voyant est-il ici?
verses.am: በከተማይቱም ዳገት በወጡ ጊዜ ቆነጃጅት ውኃውን ሊቀዱ ሲወጡ አገኙና። ባለ ራእይ በዚህ አለ ወይ? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, he is before you: make haste now, for he came to day to the city; for there is a sacrifice of the people to day in the high place:
verses.fr: Elles leur répondirent en disant: Oui, il est devant toi; mais va promptement, car aujourd''hui il est venu à la ville parce qu''il y a un sacrifice pour le peuple sur le haut lieu.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አዎን፤ እነሆ፥ በፊታችሁ ነው፤ ዛሬ ወደ ከተማይቱ መጥቶአልና፥ ዛሬም ሕዝቡ በኮረብታው ላይ ባለው መስገጃ መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ አለባቸውና ፈጥናችሁ ውጡ።

verses.en: As soon as ye be come into the city, ye shall straightway find him, before he go up to the high place to eat: for the people will not eat until he come, because he doth bless the sacrifice; and afterwards they eat that be bidden. Now therefore get you up; for about this time ye shall find him.
verses.fr: Quand vous serez entrés dans la ville, vous le trouverez avant qu''il monte au haut lieu pour manger; car le peuple ne mangera point qu''il ne soit arrivé, parce qu''il doit bénir le sacrifice; après quoi, les conviés mangeront. Montez donc, car maintenant vous le trouverez.
verses.am: ወደ ከተማይቱም በገባችሁ ጊዜ መሥዋዕቱን እርሱ የሚባርክ ስለ ሆነ እርሱ ሳይወጣ ሕዝቡ ምንም አይቀምሱምና፥ ከዚያም በኋላ የተጠሩት ይበላሉና ለመብላት ወደ ኮረብታው መስገጃ ሳይወጣ ታገኙታላችሁ፤ በዚህም ጊዜ ታገኙታላችሁና አሁን ውጡ አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And they went up into the city: and when they were come into the city, behold, Samuel came out against them, for to go up to the high place.
verses.fr: Et ils montèrent à la ville. Ils étaient arrivés au milieu de la ville, quand ils furent rencontrés par Samuel qui sortait pour monter au haut lieu.
verses.am: ወደ ከተማይቱም ወጡ፤ በከተማይቱም ውስጥ በገቡ ጊዜ እነሆ፥ ሳሙኤል ወደ ኮረብታው መስገጃ ለመውጣት ወደ እነርሱ መጣ።

verses.en: Now the Lord had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,
verses.fr: Or, un jour avant l''arrivée de Saül, l''Eternel avait averti Samuel, en disant:
verses.am: ገናም ሳኦል ሳይመጣ ከአንድ ቀን በፊት እግዚአብሔር ሳሙኤልን እንዲህ ብሎ ገልጦለት ነበር።

verses.en: To morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.
verses.fr: Demain, à cette heure, je t''enverrai un homme du pays de Benjamin, et tu l''oindras pour chef de mon peuple d''Israël. Il sauvera mon peuple de la main des Philistins; car j''ai regardé mon peuple, parce que son cri est venu jusqu''à moi.
verses.am: ነገ በዚህች ሰዓት ከብንያም አገር አንድ ሰው እሰድድልሃለሁ፤ ልቅሶአቸው ወደ እኔ የደረስ ሕዝቤን ተመልክቻለሁና ለሕዝቤ ለእስራኤል አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ትቀባዋለህ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ ሕዝቤን ያድናል።

verses.en: And when Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said unto him, Behold the man whom I spake to thee of! this same shall reign over my people.
verses.fr: Lorsque Samuel eut aperçu Saül, l''Eternel lui dit: Voici l''homme dont je t''ai parlé; c''est lui qui régnera sur mon peuple.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልን ባየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር። ያ የነገርሁህ ሰው እነሆ፤ እርሱም በሕዝቤ ላይ ይሠለጥናል አለው።

verses.en: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.
verses.fr: Saül s''approcha de Samuel au milieu de la porte, et dit: Indique-moi, je te prie, où est la maison du voyant.
verses.am: ሳኦልም በበሩ ወደ ሳሙኤል ቀርቦ። የባለ ራእዩ ቤት ወዴት እንደ ሆነ፥ እባክህ፥ ንገረኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer: go up before me unto the high place; for ye shall eat with me to day, and to morrow I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thine heart.
verses.fr: Samuel répondit à Saül: C''est moi qui suis le voyant. Monte devant moi au haut lieu, et vous mangerez aujourd''hui avec moi. Je te laisserai partir demain, et je te dirai tout ce qui se passe dans ton coeur.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም መልሶ ሳኦልን። ባለ ራእዩ እኔ ነኝ፤ ዛሬም ከእኔ ጋር ትበላላችሁና በፊቴ ወደ ኮረብታው መስገጃ ውጡ፤ ነገም አሰናብትሃለሁ፥ በልብህም ያለውን ሁሉ እነግርሃለሁ፤

verses.en: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And on whom is all the desire of Israel? Is it not on thee, and on all thy father's house?
verses.fr: Ne t''inquiète pas des ânesses que tu as perdues il y a trois jours, car elles sont retrouvées. Et pour qui est réservé tout ce qu''il y a de précieux en Israël? N''est-ce pas pour toi et pour toute la maison de ton père?
verses.am: ከሦስት ቀንም በፊት የጠፉ አህዮችህ ተገኝተዋልና ልብህን አትጣልባቸው። የእስራኤል ምኞት ለማን ነው? ለአንተና ለአባትህ ቤት አይደለምን? አለው።

verses.en: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou so to me?
verses.fr: Saül répondit: Ne suis-je pas Benjamite, de l''une des plus petites tribus d''Israël? et ma famille n''est-elle pas la moindre de toutes les familles de la tribu de Benjamin? Pourquoi donc me parles-tu de la sorte?
verses.am: ሳኦልም መልሶ። እኔ ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ከሚያንስ ወገን የሆንሁ ብንያማዊ አይደለሁምን? ወገኔስ ከብንያም ነገድ ወገኖች ሁሉ የሚያንስ አይደለምን? እንዲህስ ያለውን ነገር ለምን ነገርኸኝ? አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, which were about thirty persons.
verses.fr: Samuel prit Saül et son serviteur, les fit entrer dans la salle, et leur donna une place à la tête des conviés, qui étaient environ trente hommes.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልንና ብላቴናውን ወስዶ ወደ አዳራሽ አገባቸው፥ በመርፈቂያውም ራስ አስቀመጣቸው፤ የተጠሩትም ሠላሳ ሰዎች ያህል ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.
verses.fr: Samuel dit au cuisinier: Sers la portion que je t''ai donnée, en te disant: Mets-la à part.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ወጥቤቱን። በአንተ ዘንድ አኑረው ብዬ የሰጠሁህን እድል ፈንታ አምጣ አለው።

verses.en: And the cook took up the shoulder, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is left! set it before thee, and eat: for unto this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.
verses.fr: Le cuisinier donna l''épaule et ce qui l''entoure, et il la servit à Saül. Et Samuel dit: Voici ce qui a été réservé; mets-le devant toi, et mange, car on l''a gardé pour toi lorsque j''ai convié le peuple. Ainsi Saül mangea avec Samuel ce jour-là.
verses.am: ወጥቤቱም ጭኑንና በእርሱ ላይ የነበረውን አምጥቶ በሳኦል ፊት አኖረው። ሳሙኤልም። ሕዝቡን ከጠራሁ ጀምሮ እስከ ተወሰነው ጊዜ ድረስ ለአንተ ተጠብቆአልና እነሆ፥ የተቀመጠልህን በፊትህ አኑረህ ብላው አለ። በዚያም ቀን ሳኦል ከሳሙኤል ጋር በላ።

verses.en: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, Samuel communed with Saul upon the top of the house.
verses.fr: Ils descendirent du haut lieu à la ville, et Samuel s''entretint avec Saül sur le toit.
verses.am: ከኮረብታውም መስገጃ ወደ ከተማይቱ ወረዱ፤ ሳሙኤልም ለሳኦል በሰገነቱ ላይ መኝታ አዘጋጀለት፥ እርሱም ተኛ።

verses.en: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.
verses.fr: Puis ils se levèrent de bon matin; et, dès l''aurore, Samuel appela Saül sur le toit, et dit: Viens, et je te laisserai partir. Saül se leva, et ils sortirent tous deux, lui et Samuel.
verses.am: ማልዶም ተነሡ፤ በነጋም ጊዜ ሳሙኤል ሳኦልን ከሰገነቱ ላይ ጠርቶ። ተነሣና ላሰናብትህ አለው። ሳኦልም ተነሣ፥ እርሱና ሳሙኤልም ሁለቱ ወደ ሜዳ ወጡ።

verses.en: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on), but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.
verses.fr: Quand ils furent descendus à l''extrémité de la ville, Samuel dit à Saül: Dis à ton serviteur de passer devant nous. Et le serviteur passa devant. Arrête-toi maintenant, reprit Samuel, et je te ferai entendre la parole de Dieu.
verses.am: እነርሱም በከተማይቱ ዳር ሲወርዱ ሳሙኤል ሳኦልን። ብላቴናውን ወደ ፊታችን እንዲያልፍ እዘዘው፤ አንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አሰማህ ዘንድ በዚህ ቁም አለው። ብላቴናውም አለፈ።

verses.en: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the Lord hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?
verses.fr: Samuel prit une fiole d''huile, qu''il répandit sur la tête de Saül. Il le baisa, et dit: L''Eternel ne t''a-t-il pas oint pour que tu sois le chef de son héritage?
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም የዘይቱን ብርሌ ወስዶ በራሱ ላይ አፈሰሰው፥ ሳመውም፥ እንዲህም አለው። በርስቱ ላይ አለቃ ትሆን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ቀብቶሃል፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሕዝብ ትገዛለህ፥ በዙሪያውም ካሉ ጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ታድናቸዋለህ።

verses.en: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
verses.fr: Aujourd''hui, après m''avoir quitté, tu trouveras deux hommes près du sépulcre de Rachel, sur la frontière de Benjamin, à Tseltsach. Ils te diront: Les ânesses que tu es allé chercher sont retrouvées; et voici, ton père ne pense plus aux ânesses, mais il est en peine de vous, et dit: Que dois-je faire au sujet de mon fils?
verses.am: ዛሬ ከእኔ በተለየህ ጊዜ በብንያም ዳርቻ በጼልጻህ አገር ባለው በራሔል መቃብር አጠገብ ሁለት ሰዎች ታገኛለህ፤ እነርሱም። ልትሻቸው ሄደህ የነበርህላቸ አህዮች ተገኝተዋል፤ እነሆም፥ አባትህ ስለ አህዮች ማሰብ ትቶ። የልጄን ነገር እንዴት አደርጋለሁ? እያለ ስለ እናንተ ይጨነቃል ይሉሃል።

verses.en: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
verses.fr: De là tu iras plus loin, et tu arriveras au chêne de Thabor, où tu seras rencontré par trois hommes montant vers Dieu à Béthel, et portant l''un trois chevreaux, l''autre trois gâteaux de pain, et l''autre une outre de vin.
verses.am: ከዚያም ደግሞ ወደ ፊት ትሄዳለህ፤ ወደ ታቦር ወደ ትልቁ ዛፍ ትደርሳለህ፤ በዚያም ሦስት ሰዎች፥ አንዱ ሦስት ሰዎች፥ አንዱ ሦስት የፍየል ጠቦቶች፥ ሁለተኛው ሦስት ዳቦ፥ ሦስተኛውም የወይን ጠጅ አቁማዳ ይዘው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ቤቴል ሲወጡ ያገኙሃል፤

verses.en: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
verses.fr: Ils te demanderont comment tu te portes, et ils te donneront deux pains, que tu recevras de leur main.
verses.am: ሰላምታም ይሰጡሃል፥ ሁለትም ዳቦ ይሰጡሃል፥ ከእጃቸውም ትቀበላለህ።

verses.en: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:
verses.fr: Après cela, tu arriveras à Guibea-Elohim, où se trouve une garnison de Philistins. En entrant dans la ville, tu rencontreras une troupe de prophètes descendant du haut lieu, précédés du luth, du tambourin, de la flûte et de la harpe, et prophétisant eux-mêmes.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የፍልስጥኤማውያን ጭፍራ ወዳለበት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ኮረብታ ትመጣለህ፤ ወደዚያም ወደ ከተማይቱ በደረስህ ጊዜ፥ በገናና ከበሮ እምቢልታና መሰንቆ ይዘው ትንቢት እየተናገሩ ከኮረብታው መስገጃ የሚወርዱ የነቢያት ጉባኤ ያገኙሃል።

verses.en: And the Spirit of the Lord will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
verses.fr: L''esprit de l''Eternel te saisira, tu prophétiseras avec eux, et tu seras changé en un autre homme.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በኃይል ይወርድብሃል፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ትንቢት ትናገራለህ፥ እንደ ሌላ ሰውም ሆነህ ትለወጣለህ።

verses.en: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.
verses.fr: Lorsque ces signes auront eu pour toi leur accomplissement, fais ce que tu trouveras à faire, car Dieu est avec toi.
verses.am: እነዚህም ምልክቶች በደረሱህ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነውና እጅህ የምታገኘውን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.
verses.fr: Puis tu descendras avant moi à Guilgal; et voici, je descendrai vers toi, pour offrir des holocaustes et des sacrifices d''actions de grâces. Tu attendras sept jours, jusqu''à ce que j''arrive auprès de toi et que je te dise ce que tu dois faire.
verses.am: በፊቴም ወደ ጌልገላ ትወርዳለህ፤ እኔም፥ እነሆ፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቀርብ ዘንድ፥ የደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት እሠዋ ዘንድ ወደ አንተ እወርዳለሁ፤ እኔ ወደ አንተ እስክመጣና የምታደርገውን እስክነግርህ ድረስ ሰባት ቀን ትቆያለህ።

verses.en: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.
verses.fr: Dès que Saül eut tourné le dos pour se séparer de Samuel, Dieu lui donna un autre coeur, et tous ces signes s''accomplirent le même jour.
verses.am: ከሳሙኤልም ዘንድ ለመሄድ ፊቱን በመለሰ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ሌላ ልብ ለወጠለት፤ በዚያም ቀን እነዚህ ምልክቶች ሁሉ ደረሱለት።

verses.en: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils arrivèrent à Guibea, voici, une troupe de prophètes vint à sa rencontre. L''esprit de Dieu le saisit, et il prophétisa au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ወደዚያም ኮረብታ በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ የነቢያት ጉባኤ አገኙት፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በኃይል ወረደበት፥ በመካከላቸውም ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui l''avaient connu auparavant virent qu''il prophétisait avec les prophètes, et l''on se disait l''un à l''autre dans le peuple: Qu''est-il arrivé au fils de Kis? Saül est-il aussi parmi les prophètes?
verses.am: ቀድሞም የሚያውቁት ሁሉ ከነቢያት ጋር ትንቢት ሲናገር ባዩት ጊዜ ሕዝቡ እርስ በርሳቸው። የቂስን ልጅ ያገኘው ምንድር ነው? በውኑ ሳኦል ከነቢያት ወገን ነውን? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.fr: Quelqu''un de Guibea répondit: Et qui est leur père? -De là le proverbe: Saül est-il aussi parmi les prophètes?
verses.am: ከዚያም ስፍራ ያለ አንድ ሰው። አባታቸውስ ማን ነው? ብሎ መለሰ። ስለዚህም። ሳኦል ደግሞ ከነቢያት ወገን ነውን? የሚል ምሳሌ ሆነ።

verses.en: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut fini de prophétiser, il se rendit au haut lieu.
verses.am: ትንቢት መናገሩንም በፈጸመ ጊዜ ወደ ኮረብታው መስገጃ መጣ።

verses.en: And Saul's uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.
verses.fr: L''oncle de Saül dit à Saül et à son serviteur: Où êtes-vous allés? Saül répondit: Chercher les ânesses; mais nous ne les avons pas aperçues, et nous sommes allés vers Samuel.
verses.am: አጎቱም ሳኦልንና ብላቴናውን፥ ወዴት ሄዳችሁ ኖሮአል? አላቸው። እርሱም። አህዮችን ልንሻ ሄደን ነበር፤ ባጣናቸውም ጊዜ ወደ ሳሙኤል መጣን አለ።

verses.en: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
verses.fr: L''oncle de Saül reprit: Raconte-moi donc ce que vous a dit Samuel.
verses.am: የሳኦልም አጎት። ሳሙኤል የነገረህን፥ እባክህ፥ ንገረኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
verses.fr: Et Saül répondit à son oncle: Il nous a assuré que les ânesses étaient retrouvées. Et il ne lui dit rien de la royauté dont avait parlé Samuel.
verses.am: ሳኦልም አጎቱን። አህዮች እንደ ተገኙ ገለጠልን አለው፤ ነገር ግን ሳሙኤል የነገረውን የመንግሥትን ነገር አላወራለትም።

verses.en: And Samuel called the people together unto the Lord to Mizpeh;
verses.fr: Samuel convoqua le peuple devant l''Eternel à Mitspa,
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሕዝቡን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ምጽጳ ጠራ።

verses.en: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:
verses.fr: et il dit aux enfants d''Israël: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: J''ai fait monter d''Egypte Israël, et je vous ai délivrés de la main des Egyptiens et de la main de tous les royaumes qui vous opprimaient.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም ልጆች። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤልን ከግብጽ አወጣሁ፥ ከግብጻውያንም እጅ ከሚያስጨንቁአችሁም ነገሥታት ሁሉ እጅ አዳንኋችሁ።

verses.en: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the Lord by your tribes, and by your thousands.
verses.fr: Et aujourd''hui, vous rejetez votre Dieu, qui vous a délivrés de tous vos maux et de toutes vos souffrances, et vous lui dites: Etablis un roi sur nous! Présentez-vous maintenant devant l''Eternel, selon vos tribus et selon vos milliers.
verses.am: ዛሬ ግን ከመከራችሁና ከጭንቃችሁ ሁሉ ያዳናችሁን አምላካችሁን ንቃችሁ። እንዲህ አይሁን፥ ነገር ግን ንጉሥ አታንግሥልን አላችሁት። አሁንም በየነገዳችሁና በየወገናችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅረቡ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
verses.fr: Samuel fit approcher toutes les tribus d''Israël, et la tribu de Benjamin fut désignée.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም የእስራኤልን ነገዶች ሁሉ አቀረበ፥ ዕጣውም በብንያም ነገድ ላይ ወደቀ።

verses.en: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
verses.fr: Il fit approcher la tribu de Benjamin par familles, et la famille de Matri fut désignée. Puis Saül, fils de Kis, fut désigné. On le chercha, mais on ne le trouva point.
verses.am: የብንያምንም ነገድ በየወገናቸው አቀረበ፥ ዕጣውም በማጥሪ ወገን ላይ ወደቀ። የማጥሪንም ወገን በየሰዉ አቀረበ፥ ዕጣውም በቂስ ልጅ በሳኦል ላይ ወደቀ፤ ፈለጉትም፥ አላገኙትምም።

verses.en: Therefore they enquired of the Lord further, if the man should yet come thither. And the Lord answered, Behold he hath hid himself among the stuff.
verses.fr: On consulta de nouveau l''Eternel: Y a-t-il encore un homme qui soit venu ici? Et l''Eternel dit: Voici, il est caché vers les bagages.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም። ገና ወደዚህ የሚመጣ ሰው አለን? ብለው ደግሞ ጠየቁት፤ እግዚአብሔርም። እነሆ፥ በዕቃ መካከል ተሸሽጎአል ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
verses.fr: On courut le tirer de là, et il se présenta au milieu du peuple. Il les dépassait tous de la tête.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሮጠው ከዚያ አመጡት፤ እርሱም በሕዝቡ መካከል ቆመ፥ ከሕዝቡም ሁሉ ይልቅ ከትከሻው ወደ ላይ ከፍ ያለ ቁመተ ረጅም ነበረ።

verses.en: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the Lord hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.
verses.fr: Samuel dit à tout le peuple: Voyez-vous celui que l''Eternel a choisi? Il n''y a personne dans tout le peuple qui soit semblable à lui. Et tout le peuple poussa les cris de: Vive le roi!
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ። ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ እርሱን የሚመስል እንደሌለ እግዚአብሔር የመረጠውን ታያላችሁን? አላቸው፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ንጉሥ ሕያው ይሁን እያሉ እልልታ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the Lord. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
verses.fr: Samuel fit alors connaître au peuple le droit de la royauté, et il l''écrivit dans un livre, qu''il déposa devant l''Eternel. Puis il renvoya tout le peuple, chacun chez soi.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም የመንግሥቱን ወግ ነገረ፥ በመጽሐፍም ጻፈው በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት አኖረው። ሳሙኤልም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ወደ እየቤታቸው አሰናበታቸው።

verses.en: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
verses.fr: Saül aussi s''en alla dans sa maison à Guibea. Il fut accompagné par les honnêtes gens, dont Dieu avait touché le coeur.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ጊብዓ ሄደ፤ እግዚአብሔር ልባቸውን የነካ ኃያላንም ከእርሱ ጋር ሄዱ።

verses.en: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought no presents. But he held his peace.
verses.fr: Il y eut toutefois des hommes pervers, qui disaient: Quoi! c''est celui-ci qui nous sauvera! Et ils le méprisèrent, et ne lui apportèrent aucun présent. Mais Saül n''y prit point garde.
verses.am: ምናምንቴዎች ሰዎች ግን። ይህ ሰው እንዴት ያድነናል? ብለው ናቁት፥ እጅ መንሻም አላመጡለትም።

verses.en: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
verses.fr: Nachasch, l''Ammonite, vint assiéger Jabès en Galaad. Tous les habitants de Jabès dirent à Nachasch: Traite alliance avec nous, et nous te servirons.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከአንድ ወር በኋላ አሞናዊው ናዖስ ወጣ፥ በኢያቢስ ገለዓድም ሰፈረ፤ የኢያቢስም ሰዎች ሁሉ። ቃል ኪዳን አድርግልን፥ እኛም እንገዛልሃለን አሉት።

verses.en: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.
verses.fr: Mais Nachasch, l''Ammonite, leur répondit: Je traiterai avec vous à la condition que je vous crève à tous l''oeil droit, et que j''imprime ainsi un opprobre sur tout Israël.
verses.am: አሞናዊውም ናዖስ። ቀኝ ዓይናችሁን ሁሉ በማውጣት ቃል ኪዳን አደርግላችኋለሁ፤ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ላይ ስድብ አደረጋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days' respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.
verses.fr: Les anciens de Jabès lui dirent: Accorde-nous une trêve de sept jours, afin que nous envoyions des messagers dans tout le territoire d''Israël; et s''il n''y a personne qui nous secoure, nous nous rendrons à toi.
verses.am: የኢያቢስም ሽማግሌዎች። ወደ እስራኤል አገር ሁሉ መልክተኞችን እንድንልክ ሰባት ቀን ቆይልን፤ ከዚያም በኋላ የሚያድነን ባይኖር ወደ አንተ እንመጣለን አሉት።

verses.en: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.
verses.fr: Les messagers arrivèrent à Guibea de Saül, et dirent ces choses aux oreilles du peuple. Et tout le peuple éleva la voix, et pleura.
verses.am: መልክተኞቹም ሳኦል ወዳለበት ወደ ጊብዓ መጥተው ይህን ነገር በሕዝቡ ጆሮ ተናገሩ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው አለቀሱ።

verses.en: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.
verses.fr: Et voici, Saül revenait des champs, derrière ses boeufs, et il dit: Qu''a donc le peuple pour pleurer? On lui raconta ce qu''avaient dit ceux de Jabès.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሳኦል በሬዎቹን ተከትሎ ከእርሻው መጣ፤ ሳኦልም። ሕዝቡ የሚያለቅስ ምን ሆኖ ነው? አለ። የኢያቢስንም ሰዎች ነገር ነገሩት።

verses.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.
verses.fr: Dès que Saül eut entendu ces choses, il fut saisi par l''esprit de Dieu, et sa colère s''enflamma fortement.
verses.am: ይህንም ነገር በሰማው ጊዜ በሳኦል ላይ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በኃይል ወረደ፥ ቍጣውም እጅግ ነደደ።

verses.en: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the Lord fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.
verses.fr: Il prit une paire de boeufs, et les coupa en morceaux, qu''il envoya par les messagers dans tout le territoire d''Israël, en disant: Quiconque ne marchera pas à la suite de Saül et de Samuel, aura ses boeufs traités de la même manière. La terreur de l''Eternel s''empara du peuple, qui se mit en marche comme un seul homme.
verses.am: ጥምዱንም በሬዎች ወስዶ ቈራረጣቸው፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ዳርቻ ሁሉ በመልክተኞቹ እጅ ሰደደና። ሳኦልንና ሳሙኤልን ተከትሎ የማይወጣ ሁሉ፥ በበሬዎቹ እንዲሁ ይደረግ አለ። ድንጋጤም በሕዝቡ ላይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደቀ፥ እንደ አንድ ሰውም ሆነው ወጡ።

verses.en: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
verses.fr: Saül en fit la revue à Bézek; les enfants d''Israël étaient trois cent mille, et les hommes de Juda trente mille.
verses.am: በቤዜቅም ቈጠራቸው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ሺህ፥ የይሁዳም ሰዎች ሠላሳ ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabeshgilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
verses.fr: Ils dirent aux messagers qui étaient venus: Vous parlerez ainsi aux habitants de Jabès en Galaad: Demain vous aurez du secours, quand le soleil sera dans sa chaleur. Les messagers portèrent cette nouvelle à ceux de Jabès, qui furent remplis de joie;
verses.am: የመጡትንም መልክተኞች። የኢያቢስ ገለዓድን ሰዎች። ነገ ፀሐይ በተኮሰ ጊዜ ማዳን ይሆንላችኋል በሉአቸው አሉአቸው። መልክተኞችም መጥተው ለኢያቢስ ሰዎች ነገሩ፤ ደስም አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.
verses.fr: et qui dirent aux Ammonites: Demain nous nous rendrons à vous, et vous nous traiterez comme bon vous semblera.
verses.am: የአያቢስም ሰዎች። ነገ እንወጣላችኋለን፥ ደስ የሚያሰኛችሁንም አድርጉብን አሉ።

verses.en: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, Saül divisa le peuple en trois corps. Ils pénétrèrent dans le camp des Ammonites à la veille du matin, et ils les battirent jusqu''à la chaleur du jour. Ceux qui échappèrent furent dispersés, et il n''en resta pas deux ensemble.
verses.am: በነጋውም ሳኦል ሕዝቡን በሦስት ወገን አደረጋቸው፤ ወገግም ባለ ጊዜ ወደ ሰፈሩ መካከል ገቡ፥ ቀትርም እስኪሆን ድረስ አሞናውያንን መቱ፤ የቀሩትም ተበተኑ፥ ሁለትም በአንድ ላይ ሆነው አልቀሩላቸውም።

verses.en: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.
verses.fr: Le peuple dit à Samuel: Qui est-ce qui disait: Saül régnera-t-il sur nous? Livrez ces gens, et nous les ferons mourir.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሳሙኤልን። ሳኦል አይንገሥብን ያሉ እነማናቸው? አውጡአቸውና እንግደላቸው አሉት።

verses.en: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the Lord hath wrought salvation in Israel.
verses.fr: Mais Saül dit: Personne ne sera mis à mort en ce jour, car aujourd''hui l''Eternel a opéré une délivrance en Israël.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ማዳን አድርጎአልና ዛሬ አንድ ሰው አይሞትም አለ።

verses.en: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.
verses.fr: Et Samuel dit au peuple: Venez, et allons à Guilgal, pour y confirmer la royauté.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሕዝቡን። ኑ፥ ወደ ጌልገላ እንሂድ፥ በዚያም መንግሥቱን እናድስ አላቸው።

verses.en: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the Lord in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the Lord; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple se rendit à Guilgal, et ils établirent Saül pour roi, devant l''Eternel, à Guilgal. Là, ils offrirent des sacrifices d''actions de grâces devant l''Eternel; et là, Saül et tous les hommes d''Israël se livrèrent à de grandes réjouissances.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ጌልገላ ሄዱ፥ በዚያም ሳኦልን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በጌልገላ አነገሡት፤ በዚያም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት አቀረቡ፤ በዚያም ሳኦልና የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ ታላቅ ደስታ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.
verses.fr: Samuel dit à tout Israël: Voici, j''ai écouté votre voix dans tout ce que vous m''avez dit, et j''ai établi un roi sur vous.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም እስራኤልን ሁሉ አለ። የነገራችሁኝን ሁሉ ሰምቼ አንግሼላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, voici le roi qui marchera devant vous. Pour moi, je suis vieux, j''ai blanchi, et mes fils sont avec vous; j''ai marché à votre tête, depuis ma jeunesse jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ንጉሡ በፊታችሁ ይሄዳል፤ እኔም አርጅቻለሁ ሸምግያለሁም፤ እነሆም፥ ልጆቼ ከእናንተ ጋር ናቸው፤ እኔም ከሕፃንነቴ ጀምሬ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በፊታችሁ ሄድሁ።

verses.en: Behold, here I am: witness against me before the Lord, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.
verses.fr: Me voici! Rendez témoignage contre moi, en présence de l''Eternel et en présence de son oint. De qui ai-je pris le boeuf et de qui ai-je pris l''âne? Qui ai-je opprimé, et qui ai-je traité durement? De qui ai-je reçu un présent, pour fermer les yeux sur lui? Je vous le rendrai.
verses.am: እነሆኝ፤ በእግዚአብሔርና እርሱ በቀባው ፊት መስክሩብኝ፤ የማንን በሬ ወሰድሁ? የማንንስ አህያ ወሰድሁ? ማንንስ ሸነገልሁ? በማንስ ላይ ግፍ አደረግሁ? ዓይኖቼንስ ለማሳወር ከማን ጋር እጅ ጉቦ ተቀበልሁ? እኔም እመልስላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man's hand.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Tu ne nous as point opprimés, et tu ne nous as point traités durement, et tu n''as rien reçu de la main de personne.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አልሸነገልኸንም፥ ግፍም አላደረግህብንም፥ ከሰውም እጅ ምንም አልወሰድህም አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, The Lord is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.
verses.fr: Il leur dit encore: L''Eternel est témoin contre vous, et son oint est témoin, en ce jour, que vous n''avez rien trouvé dans mes mains. Et ils répondirent: Ils en sont témoins.
verses.am: እርሱም። በእጄ ምንም እንዳላገኛችሁ እግዚአብሔርና እርሱ የቀባው ዛሬ በእናንተ ላይ ምስክሮች ናቸው አላቸው፤ እነርሱም። ምስክር ነው አሉ።

verses.en: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the Lord that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Alors Samuel dit au peuple: C''est l''Eternel qui a établi Moïse et Aaron, et qui a fait monter vos pères du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሕዝቡን አለ። ሙሴንና አሮንን ያላቀ፥ አባቶቻችሁንም ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the Lord of all the righteous acts of the Lord, which he did to you and to your fathers.
verses.fr: Maintenant, présentez-vous, et je vous jugerai devant l''Eternel sur tous les bienfaits que l''Eternel vous a accordés, à vous et à vos pères.
verses.am: አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁ ስላደረገው ጽድቅ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እምዋገታችሁ ዘንድ በዚህ ቁሙ።

verses.en: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the Lord, then the Lord sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.
verses.fr: Après que Jacob fut venu en Egypte, vos pères crièrent à l''Eternel, et l''Eternel envoya Moïse et Aaron, qui firent sortir vos pères d''Egypte et les firent habiter dans ce lieu.
verses.am: ያዕቆብና ልጆቹ ወደ ግብጽ በገቡ ጊዜ ግብጻውያን አስጨነቁአቸው፤ አባቶቻችሁም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን ላከ፥ አባቶቻችሁንም ከግብጽ አውጥተው በዚህ ቦታ አኖሩአቸው።

verses.en: And when they forgat the Lord their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
verses.fr: Mais ils oublièrent l''Eternel, leur Dieu; et il les vendit entre les mains de Sisera, chef de l''armée de Hatsor, entre les mains des Philistins, et entre les mains du roi de Moab, qui leur firent la guerre.
verses.am: አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ረሱ፥ ለአሶር ሠራዊትም አለቃ ለሲሣራ እጅ፥ ለፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ፥ ለሞዓብም ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.en: And they cried unto the Lord, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the Lord, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.
verses.fr: Ils crièrent encore à l''Eternel, et dirent: Nous avons péché, car nous avons abandonné l''Eternel, et nous avons servi les Baals et les Astartés; délivre-nous maintenant de la main de nos ennemis, et nous te servirons.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔርን ትተን በኣሊምንና አስታሮትን በማምለካችን በድለናል፤ አሁንም ከጠላቶቻችን እጅ አድነን፥ እናመልክህማለን ብለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ።

verses.en: And the Lord sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel envoya Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthé et Samuel, et il vous délivra de la main de vos ennemis qui vous entouraient, et vous demeurâtes en sécurité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይሩበአልም፥ ባርቅንም፥ ዮፍታሔንም፥ ሳሙኤልንም ላከ፥ በዙሪያችሁም ካሉት ከጠላቶቻችሁ እጅ አዳናችሁ፤ ተዘልላችሁም ተቀመጣችሁ።

verses.en: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the Lord your God was your king.
verses.fr: Puis, voyant que Nachasch, roi des fils d''Ammon, marchait contre vous, vous m''avez dit: Non! mais un roi régnera sur nous. Et cependant l''Eternel, votre Dieu, était votre roi.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ ናዖስ እንደ መጣባችሁ ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ንጉሣችሁ ሳለ። እንዲህ አይሁን፥ ነገር ግን ንጉሥ ይንገሥልን አላችሁኝ።

verses.en: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the Lord hath set a king over you.
verses.fr: Voici donc le roi que vous avez choisi, que vous avez demandé; voici, l''Eternel a mis sur vous un roi.
verses.am: አሁንም የመረጣችሁትንና የፈለጋችሁትን ንጉሥ እዩ፤ እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር ንጉሥ አደረገላችሁ።

verses.en: If ye will fear the Lord, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the Lord, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the Lord your God:
verses.fr: Si vous craignez l''Eternel, si vous le servez, si vous obéissez à sa voix, et si vous n''êtes point rebelles à la parole de l''Eternel, vous vous attacherez à l''Eternel, votre Dieu, vous et le roi qui règne sur vous.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ብትፈሩ ብታመልኩትም፥ ቃሉንም ብትሰሙ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ላይ ባታምፁ፥ እናንተና በእናንተ ላይ የነገሠው ንጉሥ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ብትከተሉ፥ መልካም ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.en: But if ye will not obey the voice of the Lord, but rebel against the commandment of the Lord, then shall the hand of the Lord be against you, as it was against your fathers.
verses.fr: Mais si vous n''obéissez pas à la voix de l''Eternel, et si vous êtes rebelles à la parole de l''Eternel, la main de l''Eternel sera contre vous, comme elle a été contre vos pères.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ባትሰሙ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ላይ ብታምፁ፥ በእናንተና በንጉሣችሁ ላይ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the Lord will do before your eyes.
verses.fr: Attendez encore ici, et voyez le prodige que l''Eternel va opérer sous vos yeux.
verses.am: አሁንም ቁሙ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በዓይናችሁ ፊት ወደሚያደርገው ወደዚህ ታላቅ ነገር ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the Lord, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the Lord, in asking you a king.
verses.fr: Ne sommes-nous pas à la moisson des blés? J''invoquerai l''Eternel, et il enverra du tonnerre et de la pluie. Sachez alors et voyez combien vous avez eu tort aux yeux de l''Eternel de demander pour vous un roi.
verses.am: የስንዴ መከር ዛሬ አይደለምን? ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጮኻለሁ፥ እርሱም ነጎድጓድና ዝናብ ይልካል፤ እናንተም ንጉሥ በመለመናችሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያደረጋችሁት ክፋት ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ ታውቃላችሁ ታያላችሁም።

verses.en: So Samuel called unto the Lord; and the Lord sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the Lord and Samuel.
verses.fr: Samuel invoqua l''Eternel, et l''Eternel envoya ce même jour du tonnerre et de la pluie. Tout le peuple eut une grande crainte de l''Eternel et de Samuel.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በዚያን ቀን ነጐድጓድና ዝናብ ላከ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርንና ሳሙኤልን እጅግ ፈሩአቸው።

verses.en: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the Lord thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.
verses.fr: Et tout le peuple dit à Samuel: Prie l''Eternel, ton Dieu, pour tes serviteurs, afin que nous ne mourions pas; car nous avons ajouté à tous nos péchés le tort de demander pour nous un roi.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሳሙኤልን። ንጉሥ በመለመናችን በኃጢአታችን ሁሉ ላይ ይህን ክፋት ጨምረናልና እንዳንሞት ስለ ባሪያዎችህ ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልይ አሉት።

verses.en: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the Lord, but serve the Lord with all your heart;
verses.fr: Samuel dit au peuple: N''ayez point de crainte! Vous avez fait tout ce mal; mais ne vous détournez pas de l''Eternel, et servez l''Eternel de tout votre coeur.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሕዝቡን አለ። አትፍሩ፤ በእውነት ይህን ክፋት ሁሉ አደረጋችሁ፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልባችሁ አምልኩት እንጂ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ፈቀቅ አትበሉ።

verses.en: And turn ye not aside: for then should ye go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.
verses.fr: Ne vous en détournez pas; sinon, vous iriez après des choses de néant, qui n''apportent ni profit ni délivrance, parce que ce sont des choses de néant.
verses.am: ምናምንቴ ነውና የማይረባንና የማያድን ከንቱን ነገር ለመከተል ፈቀቅ አትበሉ።

verses.en: For the Lord will not forsake his people for his great name's sake: because it hath pleased the Lord to make you his people.
verses.fr: L''Eternel n''abandonnera point son peuple, à cause de son grand nom, car l''Eternel a résolu de faire de vous son peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ ሕዝብ ያደርጋችሁ ዘንድ ወድዶአልና እግዚአብሔር ስለ ታላቅ ስሙ ሕዝቡን አይተውም።

verses.en: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the Lord in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
verses.fr: Loin de moi aussi de pécher contre l''Eternel, de cesser de prier pour vous! Je vous enseignerai le bon et le droit chemin.
verses.am: ደግሞ መልካሙንና ቅኑን መንገድ አስተምራችኋለሁ እንጂ ስለ እናንተ መጸለይን በመተው እግዚአብሔርን እበድል ዘንድ ይህ ከእኔ ይራቅ።

verses.en: Only fear the Lord, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
verses.fr: Craignez seulement l''Eternel, et servez-le fidèlement de tout votre coeur; car voyez quelle puissance il déploie parmi vous.
verses.am: ብቻ እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩ፥ ያደረገላችሁንም ታላቅ ነገር አይታችኋልና በፍጹም ልባችሁ በእውነት አምልኩት።

verses.en: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.
verses.fr: Mais si vous faites le mal, vous périrez, vous et votre roi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክፉ ብትሠሩ እናንተም ንጉሣችሁም ትጠፋላችሁ።

verses.en: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,
verses.fr: Saül était âgé de... ans, lorsqu''il devint roi, et il avait déjà régné deux ans sur Israël.
verses.am: ሳኦልም በእስራኤል ላይ ሁለት ዓመት ከነገሠ በኋላ፥

verses.en: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.
verses.fr: Saül choisit trois mille hommes d''Israël: deux mille étaient avec lui à Micmasch et sur la montagne de Béthel, et mille étaient avec Jonathan à Guibea de Benjamin. Il renvoya le reste du peuple, chacun à sa tente.
verses.am: ሳኦል ሦስት ሺህ ሰዎች ከእስራኤል መረጠ፤ ሁለቱም ሺህ በማክማስና በቤቴል ተራራ ከሳኦል ጋር ነበሩ፥ አንዱም ሺህ በብንያም ጊብዓ ከዮናታን ጋር ነበሩ፤ የቀረውንም ሕዝብ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ድንኳኑ አሰናበተ።

verses.en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.
verses.fr: Jonathan battit le poste des Philistins qui était à Guéba, et les Philistins l''apprirent. Saül fit sonner de la trompette dans tout le pays, en disant: Que les Hébreux écoutent!
verses.am: ዮናታንም በናሲብ ውስጥ የነበረውን የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ መታ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ያን ሰሙ፤ ሳኦልም። ዕብራውያን ይስሙ ብሎ በአገሩ ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከት ነፋ።

verses.en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.
verses.fr: Tout Israël entendit que l''on disait: Saül a battu le poste des Philistins, et Israël se rend odieux aux Philistins. Et le peuple fut convoqué auprès de Saül à Guilgal.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ሳኦል የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ጭፍራ እንደ መታ፥ ደግሞም እስራኤል በፍልስጥኤማውያን ዘንድ እንደ ተጸየፉ ሰሙ፤ ሕዝቡም ሳኦልን ለመከተል ወደ ጌልገላ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Bethaven.
verses.fr: Les Philistins s''assemblèrent pour combattre Israël. Ils avaient mille chars et six mille cavaliers, et ce peuple était innombrable comme le sable qui est sur le bord de la mer. Ils vinrent camper à Micmasch, à l''orient de Beth-Aven.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከእስራኤል ጋር ለመዋጋት ተሰበሰቡ፤ ሠላሳ ሺህ ሰረገሎች ስድስትም ሺህ ፈረሰኞች በባሕርም ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበሩ፤ ወጥተውም ከቤትአዌን በምሥራቅ በኩል በማክማስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.
verses.fr: Les hommes d''Israël se virent à l''extrémité, car ils étaient serrés de près, et ils se cachèrent dans les cavernes, dans les buissons, dans les rochers, dans les tours et dans les citernes.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ተጨንቀው ነበርና የእስራኤል ሰዎች በጭንቀት እንዳሉ ባዩ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ በዋሻና በእሾህ ቍጥቋጦ በገደልና በግንብ በጕድጓድም ውስጥ ተሸሸጉ።

verses.en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
verses.fr: Il y eut aussi des Hébreux qui passèrent le Jourdain, pour aller au pays de Gad et de Galaad. Saül était encore à Guilgal, et tout le peuple qui se trouvait auprès de lui tremblait.
verses.am: ከዕብራውያንም ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግረው ወደ ጋድና ወደ ገለዓድ ምድር ሄዱ፤ ሳኦል ግን ገና በጌልገላ ነበረ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተንቀጥቅጠው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
verses.fr: Il attendit sept jours, selon le terme fixé par Samuel. Mais Samuel n''arrivait pas à Guilgal, et le peuple se dispersait loin de Saül.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ሳሙኤል እንደ ቀጠረው ጊዜ ሰባት ቀን ቆየ፤ ሳሙኤል ግን ወደ ጌልገላ አልመጣም፥ ሕዝቡም ከእርሱ ተለይተው ተበታተኑ።

verses.en: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
verses.fr: Alors Saül dit: Amenez-moi l''holocauste et les sacrifices d''actions de grâces. Et il offrit l''holocauste.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት አምጡልኝ አለ። የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አሳረገ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.
verses.fr: Comme il achevait d''offrir l''holocauste, voici, Samuel arriva, et Saül sortit au-devant de lui pour le saluer.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ማሳረግ በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሳሙኤል መጣ፤ ሳኦልም እንዲመርቀው ሊገናኘው ወጣ።

verses.en: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;
verses.fr: Samuel dit: Qu''as-tu fait? Saül répondit: Lorsque j''ai vu que le peuple se dispersait loin de moi, que tu n''arrivais pas au terme fixé, et que les Philistins étaient assemblés à Micmasch,
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም። ያደረግኸው ምንድር ነው? አለ። ሳኦልም። ሕዝቡ ከእኔ ተለይተው እንደ ተበታተኑ፥ አንተም በቀጠሮው እንዳልመጣህ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ወደ ማክማስ እንደ ተሰበሰቡ አየሁ፤

verses.en: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the Lord: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.
verses.fr: je me suis dit: Les Philistins vont descendre contre moi à Guilgal, et je n''ai pas imploré l''Eternel! C''est alors que je me suis fait violence et que j''ai offert l''holocauste.
verses.am: ሰለዚህ። ፍልስጥኤማውያን አሁን ወደ ጌልገላ ይወርዱብኛል፥ እኔም የእግዚአብሔርን ሞገስ አልለመንሁም አልሁ፤ ስለዚህም ሳልታገሥ የሚቃጠልን መሥዋዕት አሳረግሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the Lord thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the Lord have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.
verses.fr: Samuel dit à Saül: Tu as agi en insensé, tu n''as pas observé le commandement que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''avait donné. L''Eternel aurait affermi pour toujours ton règne sur Israël;
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልን። አላበጀህም፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘህን ትእዛዝ አልጠበቅህም፤ ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥትህን በእስራኤል ላይ ለዘላለም አጽንቶልህ ነበረ።

verses.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the Lord hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the Lord hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the Lord commanded thee.
verses.fr: et maintenant ton règne ne durera point. L''Eternel s''est choisi un homme selon son coeur, et l''Eternel l''a destiné à être le chef de son peuple, parce que tu n''as pas observé ce que l''Eternel t''avait commandé.
verses.am: አሁንም መንግሥትህ አይጸናም፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ልቡ የሆነ ሰው መርጦአል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያዘዘህን አልጠበቅህምና እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ላይ አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ አዝዞታል አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.
verses.fr: Puis Samuel se leva, et monta de Guilgal à Guibea de Benjamin. Saül fit la revue du peuple qui se trouvait avec lui: il y avait environ six cents hommes.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ከጌልገላ ተነሥቶ መንገዱን ሄደ፤ የቀሩትም ሕዝብ ሳኦልን ተከተለው ሰልፈኞቹን ሊገናኙ ሄዱ። ከጌልገላም ተነሥተው ወደ ብንያም ጊብዓ መጡ፤ ሳኦልም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ሕዝብ ቈጠረ፥ ስድስት መቶም የሚያህሉ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
verses.fr: Saül, son fils Jonathan, et le peuple qui se trouvait avec eux, avaient pris position à Guéba de Benjamin, et les Philistins campaient à Micmasch.
verses.am: ሳኦልና ልጁ ዮናታንም ከእነርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሕዝብ በብንያም ጊብዓ ተቀመጡ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም በማክማስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:
verses.fr: Il sortit du camp des Philistins trois corps pour ravager: l''un prit le chemin d''Ophra, vers le pays de Schual;
verses.am: ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሰፈር ማራኪዎች በሦስት ክፍል ሆነው ወጡ፤ አንዱም ክፍል በዖፍራ መንገድ ወደ ሦጋል ምድር ሄደ።

verses.en: And another company turned the way to Bethhoron: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
verses.fr: l''autre prit le chemin de Beth-Horon; et le troisième prit le chemin de la frontière qui regarde la vallée de Tseboïm, du côté du désert.
verses.am: ሁለተኛው ክፍል ወደ ቤት ሖሮን መንገድ ዞረ፤ ሦስተኛውም ክፍል በበረሃው አጠገብ ባለው ወደ ስቦይም ሸለቆ በሚመለከተው በዳርቻ መንገድ ዞረ።

verses.en: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:
verses.fr: On ne trouvait point de forgeron dans tout le pays d''Israël; car les Philistins avaient dit: Empêchons les Hébreux de fabriquer des épées ou des lances.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም። ዕብራውያን ሰይፍና ጦር እንዳይሠሩ ብለው ነበርና በእስራኤል ምድር ሁሉ ብረተ ሠሪ አልተገኘም።

verses.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.
verses.fr: Et chaque homme en Israël descendait chez les Philistins pour aiguiser son soc, son hoyau, sa hache et sa bêche,
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ የማረሻውን ጫፍና ማጭዱን መጥረቢያውንና መቆፈሪያውን ይስል ዘንድ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ይወርድ ነበር።

verses.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.
verses.fr: quand le tranchant des bêches, des hoyaux, des tridents et des haches, était émoussé, et pour redresser les aiguillons.
verses.am: ለማረሻው ጫፍና ለመቆፈሪያው ዋጋው የሰቅል ከ3 እጅ 2ቱ እጅ ነበረ። መጥረቢያውንም ለማሳል መውጊያውንም ለማበጀት ዋጋው የሰቅል ከ3 እጅ 1ዱ እጅ ነበረ።

verses.en: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.
verses.fr: Il arriva qu''au jour du combat il ne se trouvait ni épée ni lance entre les mains de tout le peuple qui était avec Saül et Jonathan; il ne s''en trouvait qu''auprès de Saül et de Jonathan, son fils.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በሰልፍ ቀን ሰይፍና ጦር ከሳኦልና ከዮናታን ጋር በነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ እጅ አልተገኘም፤ ብቻ በሳኦልና በልጁ በዮናታን ዘንድ ተገኘ። የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ ወደ ማክማስ መተላለፊያ ወጡ።

verses.en: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.
verses.fr: Un poste de Philistins vint s''établir au passage de Micmasch.

verses.en: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.
verses.fr: Un jour, Jonathan, fils de Saül, dit au jeune homme qui portait ses armes: Viens, et poussons jusqu''au poste des Philistins qui est là de l''autre côté. Et il n''en dit rien à son père.
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የሳኦል ልጅ ዮናታን ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። ና፥ በዚያ በኩል ወዳለው ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ጭፍራ እንለፍ አለው፤ ለአባቱም አልነገረውም።

verses.en: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;
verses.fr: Saül se tenait à l''extrémité de Guibea, sous le grenadier de Migron, et le peuple qui était avec lui formait environ six cents hommes.
verses.am: ሳኦልም በመጌዶን ባለው በሮማኑ ዛፍ በታች በጊብዓ ዳርቻ ተቀምጦ ነበረ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበረው ሕዝብ ስድስት መቶ የሚያህል ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the Lord's priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.
verses.fr: Achija, fils d''Achithub, frère d''I-Kabod, fils de Phinées, fils d''Eli, sacrificateur de l''Eternel à Silo, portait l''éphod. Le peuple ne savait pas que Jonathan s''en fût allé.
verses.am: የኢካቦድ ወንድም የአኪጦብ ልጅ የፊንሐስ ልጅ የዔሊ ልጅ በሴሎ ለእግዚአብሔር ካህን የሆነ ኤፉድም የለበሰ አኪያ አብሮ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡ ዮናታን እንደ ሄደ አላወቁም።

verses.en: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines' garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
verses.fr: Entre les passages par lesquels Jonathan cherchait à arriver au poste des Philistins, il y avait une dent de rocher d''un côté et une dent de rocher de l''autre côté, l''une portant le nom de Botsets et l''autre celui de Séné.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ጭፍራ ሊሻገርበት በወደደው መተላለፊያ መካከል በወዲህ አንድ ሾጣጣ በወዲህ አንድ ሾጣጣ ድንጋዮች ነበሩ፤ የአንዱም ስም ቦጼጽ የሁለተኛውም ስም ሴኔ ነበረ።

verses.en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.
verses.fr: L''une de ces dents est au nord vis-à-vis de Micmasch, et l''autre au midi vis-à-vis de Guéba.
verses.am: አንዱም ሾጣጣ በማክማስ አንጻር በሰሜን በኩል፥ ሁለተኛውም በጊብዓ አንጻር በደቡብ በኩል የቆሙ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the Lord will work for us: for there is no restraint to the Lord to save by many or by few.
verses.fr: Jonathan dit au jeune homme qui portait ses armes: Viens, et poussons jusqu''au poste de ces incirconcis. Peut-être l''Eternel agira-t-il pour nous, car rien n''empêche l''Eternel de sauver au moyen d''un petit nombre comme d''un grand nombre.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። ና፥ ወደ እነዚህ ቈላፋን ጭፍራ እንለፍ፤ በብዙ ወይም በጥቂት ማዳን እግዚአብሔርን አያስቸግረውምና ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር ይሠራልን ይሆናል አለው።

verses.en: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.
verses.fr: Celui qui portait ses armes lui répondit: Fais tout ce que tu as dans le coeur, n''écoute que ton sentiment, me voici avec toi prêt à te suivre.
verses.am: ጋሻ ጃግሬውም። ልብህ ያሰኘህን ሁሉ አድርግ፤ እነሆ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፤ እንደ አንተ ልብ ሁሉ የእኔም ልብ እንዲሁ ነው አለው።

verses.en: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.
verses.fr: Hé bien! dit Jonathan, allons à ces gens et montrons-nous à eux.
verses.am: ዮናታንም አለ። እነሆ፥ ወደ ሰዎቹ እናልፋለን እንገለጥላቸውማለን፤

verses.en: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.
verses.fr: S''ils nous disent: Arrêtez, jusqu''à ce que nous venions à vous! nous resterons en place, et nous ne monterons point vers eux.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ወደ እናንተ እስክንመጣ ድረስ ቆዩ ቢሉን በስፍራችን እንቆማለን፥ ወደ እነርሱም አንወጣም።

verses.en: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the Lord hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.
verses.fr: Mais s''ils disent: Montez vers nous! nous monterons, car l''Eternel les livre entre nos mains. C''est là ce qui nous servira de signe.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ወደ እኛ ውጡ ቢሉን እግዚአብሔር በእጃችን አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአቸዋልና እንወጣለን፤ ምልክታችንም ይህ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.
verses.fr: Ils se montrèrent tous deux au poste des Philistins, et les Philistins dirent: Voici les Hébreux qui sortent des trous où ils se sont cachés.
verses.am: ሁለታቸውም ለፍልስጥኤማውያን ጭፍራ ተገለጡ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም። እነሆ፥ ዕብራውያን ከተሸሸጉበት ጕድጓድ ይወጣሉ አሉ።

verses.en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the Lord hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.
verses.fr: Et les hommes du poste s''adressèrent ainsi à Jonathan et à celui qui portait ses armes: Montez vers nous, et nous vous ferons savoir quelque chose. Jonathan dit à celui qui portait ses armes: Monte après moi, car l''Eternel les livre entre les mains d''Israël.
verses.am: የጭፍራው ሰዎችም ዮናታንንና ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። ወደ እኛ ውጡ፥ አንድ ነገርም እናሳያችኋለን አሉ። ዮናታንም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአቸዋልና ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.
verses.fr: Et Jonathan monta en s''aidant des mains et des pieds, et celui qui portait ses armes le suivit. Les Philistins tombèrent devant Jonathan, et celui qui portait ses armes donnait la mort derrière lui.
verses.am: ዮናታንም በእጁና በእግሩ ወጣ፥ ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ተከተለው፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም በዮናታን እጅ ወደቁ፥ ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ተከትሎ ገደላቸው።

verses.en: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
verses.fr: Dans cette première défaite, Jonathan et celui qui portait ses armes tuèrent une vingtaine d''hommes, sur l''espace d''environ la moitié d''un arpent de terre.
verses.am: የዮናታንና የጋሻ ጃግሬውም የመጀመሪያ ግዳያቸው በአንድ ትልም እርሻ መካከል ሀያ ያህል ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.
verses.fr: L''effroi se répandit au camp, dans la contrée et parmi tout le peuple; le poste et ceux qui ravageaient furent également saisis de peur; le pays fut dans l''épouvante. C''était comme une terreur de Dieu.
verses.am: በሰፈሩም በእርሻውና በሕዝቡም ሁሉ መካከል ሽብር ነበረ፤ በሰፈሩ የተቀመጡና ለምርኮ የወጡት ተሸበሩ፤ ምድሪቱም ተናወጠች፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ታላቅ ሽብር ሆነ።

verses.en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another.
verses.fr: Les sentinelles de Saül, qui étaient à Guibea de Benjamin, virent que la multitude se dispersait et allait de côté et d''autre.
verses.am: በብንያም ጊብዓ ያሉ የሳኦል ዘበኞችም ተመለከቱ፤ እነሆም፥ ሠራዊቱ ወዲህና ወዲያ እየተራወጡ ተበታተኑ።

verses.en: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there.
verses.fr: Alors Saül dit au peuple qui était avec lui: Comptez, je vous prie, et voyez qui s''en est allé du milieu de nous. Ils comptèrent, et voici, il manquait Jonathan et celui qui portait ses armes.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ሕዝብ። እስኪ ተቋጠሩ፥ ከእኛ ዘንድ የሄደ ማን እንደሆነ ተመልከቱ አላቸው። በተቋጠሩም ጊዜ እነሆ፥ ዮናታንና ጋሻ ጃግሬው በዚያ አልነበሩም።

verses.en: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Et Saül dit à Achija: Fais approcher l''arche de Dieu! -Car en ce temps l''arche de Dieu était avec les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን አኪያ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ኤፉድ ለብሶ ነበርና ሳኦል። ኤፉድን አምጣ አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.
verses.fr: Pendant que Saül parlait au sacrificateur, le tumulte dans le camp des Philistins allait toujours croissant; et Saül dit au sacrificateur: Retire ta main!
verses.am: ሳኦል ከካህኑ ጋር ሲነጋገር በፍልስጥኤማውያን ሰፈር ግርግርታ እየበዛና እየጠነከረ ሄደ፤ ሳኦልም ካህኑን። እጅህን መልስ አለው።

verses.en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.
verses.fr: Puis Saül et tout le peuple qui était avec lui se rassemblèrent, et ils s''avancèrent jusqu''au lieu du combat; et voici, les Philistins tournèrent l''épée les uns contre les autres, et la confusion était extrême.
verses.am: ሳኦልና ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ወደ ውጊያው መጡ፤ እነሆም፥ የእያንዳንዱ ሰው ሰይፍ በባልንጀራው ላይ ነበረ፥ እጅግም ታላቅ ድንጋጤ ሆነ።

verses.en: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.
verses.fr: Il y avait parmi les Philistins, comme auparavant, des Hébreux qui étaient montés avec eux dans le camp, où ils se trouvaient disséminés, et ils se joignirent à ceux d''Israël qui étaient avec Saül et Jonathan.
verses.am: ቀድሞ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር የነበሩት ከእነርሱም ጋር ከሰፈሩ ዙሪያ የወጡት ዕብራውያን ደግሞ ከሳኦልና ከዮናታን ጋር ወደ ነበሩት አስራኤላውያን ለመሆን ዞሩ።

verses.en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
verses.fr: Tous les hommes d''Israël qui s''étaient cachés dans la montagne d''Ephraïm, apprenant que les Philistins fuyaient, se mirent aussi à les poursuivre dans la bataille.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ሰዎች በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር የተሸሸጉት ሁሉ ፍልስጥኤማውያን እንደ ኰበለሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ እነርሱ ደግሞ ሊዋጉአቸው ተከትለው ገሠገሡ።

verses.en: So the Lord saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.
verses.fr: L''Eternel délivra Israël ce jour-là, et le combat se prolongea jusqu''au delà de Beth-Aven.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ ቀን እስራኤልን አዳነ፤ ውጊያውም በቤትአዌን በኩል አለፈ። ከሳኦልም ጋር የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ አሥር ሺህ የሚያህሉ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ውጊያውም በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ሁሉ ተበታትኖ ነበር።

verses.en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.
verses.fr: La journée fut fatigante pour les hommes d''Israël. Saül avait fait jurer le peuple, en disant: Maudit soit l''homme qui prendra de la nourriture avant le soir, avant que je me sois vengé de mes ennemis! Et personne n''avait pris de nourriture.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች በዚያ ቀን ተጨነቁ፤ ሳኦል። ጠላቶቼን እስክበቀል እስከ ማታ ድረስ መብል የሚበላ ሰው ርጉም ይሁን ብሎ ሕዝቡን አምሎአቸው ነበርና። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ መብል አልቀመሱም።

verses.en: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple était arrivé dans une forêt, où il y avait du miel à la surface du sol.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ ዱር ገባ፤ ማርም በምድር ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.
verses.fr: Lorsque le peuple entra dans la forêt, il vit du miel qui coulait; mais nul ne porta la main à la bouche, car le peuple respectait le serment.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወደ ዱር በገባ ጊዜ እነሆ፥ የሚፈስስ ማር ነበረ፤ ሕዝቡ መሐላውን ፈርቶ ነበርና ማንም እጁን ወደ አፉ አላደረገም።

verses.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
verses.fr: Jonathan ignorait le serment que son père avait fait faire au peuple; il avança le bout du bâton qu''il avait à la main, le plongea dans un rayon de miel, et ramena la main à la bouche; et ses yeux furent éclaircis.
verses.am: ዮናታን ግን አባቱ ሕዝቡን ባማለ ጊዜ አልሰማም ነበር፤ እርሱም በእጁ ያለችውን በትር ጫፍዋን ወደ ወለላው ነከረ፥ እጁንም ወደ አፉ አደረገ፤ ዓይኑም በራ።

verses.en: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.
verses.fr: Alors quelqu''un du peuple, lui adressant la parole, dit: Ton père a fait jurer le peuple, en disant: Maudit soit l''homme qui prendra de la nourriture aujourd''hui! Or le peuple était épuisé.
verses.am: ከሕዝቡም አንድ ሰው መልሶ። አባትህ። ዛሬ መብል የሚበላ ሰው ርጉም ይሁን ብሎ ሕዝቡን መሐላ አምሎአቸዋል አለው፤ ሕዝቡም ደከሙ።

verses.en: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.
verses.fr: Et Jonathan dit: Mon père trouble le peuple; voyez donc comme mes yeux se sont éclaircis, parce que j''ai goûté un peu de ce miel.
verses.am: ዮናታንም። አባቴ ምድሪቱን አስቸገረ፤ ከዚህ ማር ጥቂት ብቀምስ ዓይኔ እንደ በራ እዩ።

verses.en: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?
verses.fr: Certes, si le peuple avait aujourd''hui mangé du butin qu''il a trouvé chez ses ennemis, la défaite des Philistins n''aurait-elle pas été plus grande?
verses.am: ይልቅስ ሕዝቡ ካገኙት ከጠላቶቻቸው ምርኮ በልተው ቢሆኑ የፍልስጥኤማውያን መመታት ይበልጥ አልነበረምን? አለ።

verses.en: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.
verses.fr: Ils battirent ce jour-là les Philistins depuis Micmasch jusqu''à Ajalon. Le peuple était très fatigué,
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ከማክማስ እስከ ኤሎን ድረስ መቱአቸው፤ ሕዝቡም እጅግ ደከሙ።

verses.en: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.
verses.fr: et il se jeta sur le butin. Il prit des brebis, des boeufs et des veaux, il les égorgea sur la terre, et il en mangea avec le sang.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ለምርኮ ሳሱ፤ በጎችን በሬዎችንም ጥጆችንም ወስደው በምድር ላይ አረዱ፤ ሕዝቡም ከደሙ ጋር በሉ።

verses.en: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the Lord, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.
verses.fr: On le rapporta à Saül, et l''on dit: Voici, le peuple pèche contre l''Eternel, en mangeant avec le sang. Saül dit: Vous commettez une infidélité; roulez à l''instant vers moi une grande pierre.
verses.am: ለሳኦልም። እነሆ፥ ሕዝቡ ከደሙ ጋር በመብላታቸው እግዚአብሔርን በደሉ ብለው ነገሩት። ሳኦልም። እጅግ ተላለፋችሁ፤ አሁንም ትልቅ ድንጋይ አንከባልላችሁ አቅርቡልኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the Lord in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.
verses.fr: Puis il ajouta: Répandez-vous parmi le peuple, et dites à chacun de m''amener son boeuf ou sa brebis, et de l''égorger ici. Vous mangerez ensuite, et vous ne pécherez point contre l''Eternel, en mangeant avec le sang. Et pendant la nuit, chacun parmi le peuple amena son boeuf à la main, afin de l''égorger sur la pierre.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። በሕዝቡ መካከል እየዞራችሁ። እያንዳንዱ ሰው በሬውንና በጉን ወደ እኔ ያቅርብ፥ በዚህም እረዱና ብሉ፤ ከደሙም ጋር በመብላታችሁ እግዚአብሔርን አትበድሉ በሉአቸው አለው። እያንዳንዱም ሰው ሁሉ በእጁ ያለውን በሬውን በዚያች ሌሊት አቀረበ፥ በዚያም አረደው።

verses.en: And Saul built an altar unto the Lord: the same was the first altar that he built unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Saül bâtit un autel à l''Eternel: ce fut le premier autel qu''il bâtit à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያን ሠራ፤ ይኸውም ለእግዚአብሔር የሠራው መጀመሪያ መሠዊያ ነው።

verses.en: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.
verses.fr: Saül dit: Descendons cette nuit après les Philistins, pillons-les jusqu''à la lumière du matin, et n''en laissons pas un de reste. Ils dirent: Fais tout ce qui te semblera bon. Alors le sacrificateur dit: Approchons-nous ici de Dieu.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። ፍልስጥኤማውያንን በሌሊት ተከትለን እስኪነጋ ድረስ እንበዝብዛቸው፤ አንድ ሰው እንኳ አናስቀርላቸው አለ። እነርሱም። ደስ የሚያሰኝህን ሁሉ አድርግ አሉት። ካህኑም። ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንቅረብ አለ።

verses.en: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.
verses.fr: Et Saül consulta Dieu: Descendrai-je après les Philistins? Les livreras-tu entre les mains d''Israël? Mais en ce moment il ne lui donna point de réponse.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ልከተልን? በእስራኤልስ እጅ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣቸዋለህን? ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀው። በዚያ ቀን ግን አልመለሰለትም።

verses.en: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.
verses.fr: Saül dit: Approchez ici, vous tous chefs du peuple; recherchez et voyez comment ce péché a été commis aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። እናንተ የሕዝቡ አለቆች ሁሉ፥ ወደዚህ ቅረቡ፤ ዛሬ ይህ ኃጢአት በምን እንደ ሆነ እወቁ፥ ተመልከቱም፤

verses.en: For, as the Lord liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel, le libérateur d''Israël, est vivant! lors même que Jonathan, mon fils, en serait l''auteur, il mourrait. Et dans tout le peuple personne ne lui répondit.
verses.am: እስራኤልን የሚያድን ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ኃጢአቱ በልጄ በዮናታን ቢሆን ፈጽሞ ይሞታል አለ። ከሕዝቡም ሁሉ አንድ የመለሰለት ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.en: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.
verses.fr: Il dit à tout Israël: Mettez-vous d''un côté; et moi et Jonathan, mon fils, nous serons de l''autre. Et le peuple dit à Saül: Fais ce qui te semblera bon.
verses.am: እስራኤልንም ሁሉ። እናንተ በአንድ ወገን ሁኑ፥ እኔና ልጄ ዮናታንም በሌላ ወገን እንሆናለን አለ። ሕዝቡም ሳኦልን ደስ የሚያሰኝህን አድርግ አሉት።

verses.en: Therefore Saul said unto the Lord God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.
verses.fr: Saül dit à l''Eternel: Dieu d''Israël! fais connaître la vérité. Jonathan et Saül furent désignés, et le peuple fut libéré.
verses.am: ሳኦልም የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን። እውነትን ግለጥ አለው። ሳኦልና ዮናታንም ተያዙ፤ ሕዝቡም ነጻ ሆነ።

verses.en: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.
verses.fr: Saül dit: Jetez le sort entre moi et Jonathan, mon fils. Et Jonathan fut désigné.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። በእኔና በልጄ በዮናታን መካከል ዕጣ ጣሉ አለ። ዮናታንም ተያዘ።

verses.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.
verses.fr: Saül dit à Jonathan: Déclare-moi ce que tu as fait. Jonathan le lui déclara, et dit: J''ai goûté un peu de miel, avec le bout du bâton que j''avais à la main: me voici, je mourrai.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዮናታንን። ያደረግኸውን ንገረኝ አለው፤ ዮናታንም። በእጄ ባለው በበትሬ ጫፍ ጥቂት ማር በእርግጥ ቀምሻለሁ፤ እነሆኝ፥ እሞታለሁ ብሎ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.
verses.fr: Et Saül dit: Que Dieu me traite dans toute sa rigueur, si tu ne meurs pas, Jonathan!
verses.am: ሳኦልም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያድርግብኝ እንዲህም ይጨምርብኝ፤ ዮናታን ሆይ፥ ፈጽመህ ትሞታለህ አለ።

verses.en: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the Lord liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.
verses.fr: Le peuple dit à Saül: Quoi! Jonathan mourrait, lui qui a opéré cette grande délivrance en Israël! Loin de là! L''Eternel est vivant! il ne tombera pas à terre un cheveu de sa tête, car c''est avec Dieu qu''il a agi dans cette journée. Ainsi le peuple sauva Jonathan, et il ne mourut point.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሳኦልን። በውኑ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ታላቅ መድኃኒት ያደረገ ዮናታን ይሞታልን? ይህ አይሁን፤ ዛሬ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አድርጎአልና ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ከራሱ ጠጕር አንዲት በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም አሉት። ሕዝቡም እንዳይሞት ዮናታንን አዳነው።

verses.en: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.
verses.fr: Saül cessa de poursuivre les Philistins, et les Philistins s''en allèrent chez eux.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ከመከተል ተመለሰ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ወደ ስፍራቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.
verses.fr: Après que Saül eut pris possession de la royauté sur Israël, il fit de tous côtés la guerre à tous ses ennemis, à Moab, aux enfants d''Ammon, à Edom, aux rois de Tsoba, et aux Philistins; et partout où il se tournait, il était vainqueur.
verses.am: ሳኦልም መንግሥቱን በእስራኤል ላይ አጸና፤ በዙሪያውም ካሉት ከጠላቶቹ ሁሉ ጋር፥ ከሞዓብም፥ ከአሞንም ልጆች፥ ከኤዶምያስም፥ ከሱባም ነገሥታት፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር፤ በየሄደበትም ሁሉ ድል ይነሣ ነበር።

verses.en: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.
verses.fr: Il manifesta sa force, battit Amalek, et délivra Israël de la main de ceux qui le pillaient.
verses.am: እርሱም ጀግና ነበረ፥ አማሌቃውያንንም መታ፥ እስራኤልንም ከዘራፊዎቹ እጅ አዳነ።

verses.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:
verses.fr: Les fils de Saül étaient Jonathan, Jischvi et Malkischua. Ses deux filles s''appelaient: l''aînée Mérab, et la plus jeune Mical.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ወንዶች ልጆች ዮናታን፥ የሱዊ፥ ሜልኪሳ ነበሩ፤ የሁለቱም ሴቶች ልጆቹ ስም ይህ ነበረ፤ የታላቂቱ ስም ሜሮብ፥ የታናሺቱም ስም ሜልኮል ነበረ።

verses.en: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.
verses.fr: Le nom de la femme de Saül était Achinoam, fille d''Achimaats. Le nom du chef de son armée était Abner, fils de Ner, oncle de Saül.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ሚስት ስም የአኪማአስ ልጅ አኪናሆም ነበረ፤ የሠራዊቱም አለቃ ስም የሳኦል አጎት የኔር ልጅ አበኔር ነበረ።

verses.en: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
verses.fr: Kis, père de Saül, et Ner, père d''Abner, étaient fils d''Abiel.
verses.am: የሳኦልም አባት ቂስ ነበረ፤ የአበኔርም አባት ኔር የአቢኤል ልጅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
verses.fr: Pendant toute la vie de Saül, il y eut une guerre acharnée contre les Philistins; et dès que Saül apercevait quelque homme fort et vaillant, il le prenait à son service.
verses.am: በሳኦልም ዕድሜ ሁሉ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ጽኑ ውጊያ ነበረ፤ ሳኦልም ጽኑ ወይም ኃያል ሰው ባየ ጊዜ ወደ እርሱ ይሰበስብ ነበር።

verses.en: Samuel also said unto Saul, The Lord sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the Lord.
verses.fr: Samuel dit à Saül: C''est moi que l''Eternel a envoyé pour t''oindre roi sur son peuple, sur Israël: écoute donc ce que dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልን አለው። በሕዝቡ በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ እንድትሆን እቀባህ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ላከኝ፥ አሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ድምፅ ስማ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Je me souviens de ce qu''Amalek fit à Israël, lorsqu''il lui ferma le chemin à sa sortie d''Egypte.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤል ከግብጽ በወጣ ጊዜ አማሌቅ በመንገድ እየተቃወመ ያደረገበትን እበቀላለሁ።

verses.en: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.
verses.fr: Va maintenant, frappe Amalek, et dévouez par interdit tout ce qui lui appartient; tu ne l''épargneras point, et tu feras mourir hommes et femmes, enfants et nourrissons, boeufs et brebis, chameaux et ânes.
verses.am: አሁንም ሄደህ አማሌቅን ምታ፥ ያላቸውንም ሁሉ ፈጽመህ አጥፋ፥ አትማራቸውም፤ ወንዱንና ሴቱን ብላቴናውንና ሕፃኑን በሬውንና በጉን ግመሉንና አህያውን ግደል።

verses.en: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
verses.fr: Saül convoqua le peuple, et en fit la revue à Thelaïm: il y avait deux cent mille hommes de pied, et dix mille hommes de Juda.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ሕዝቡን ጠርቶ በጌልገላ ቈጠራቸው፤ ሁለት መቶ ሺህ እግረኞች፥ ከይሁዳም አሥር ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.
verses.fr: Saül marcha jusqu''à la ville d''Amalek, et mit une embuscade dans la vallée.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ወደ አማሌቅ ከተማ ወጣ፥ በሸለቆውም ውስጥ ተደበቀ።

verses.en: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
verses.fr: Il dit aux Kéniens: Allez, retirez-vous, sortez du milieu d''Amalek, afin que je ne vous fasse pas périr avec lui; car vous avez eu de la bonté pour tous les enfants d''Israël, lorsqu''ils montèrent d''Egypte. Et les Kéniens se retirèrent du milieu d''Amalek.
verses.am: ሳኦል ቄናውያንን። ተነሥታችሁ ሂዱ፤ ከግብጽ በወጡ ጊዜ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ቸርነት አድርጋችኋልና ከአማሌቅ ጋር እንዳላጠፋችሁ ከመካከላቸው ውረዱ አላቸው፤ ቄናውያንም ከአማሌቃውያን መካከል ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.
verses.fr: Saül battit Amalek depuis Havila jusqu''à Schur, qui est en face de l''Egypte.
verses.am: ሳኦልም አማሌቃውያንን ከኤውላጥ ጀምሮ በግብጽ ፊት እስካለችው እስከ ሱር ድረስ መታቸው።

verses.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
verses.fr: Il prit vivant Agag, roi d''Amalek, et il dévoua par interdit tout le peuple en le passant au fil de l''épée.
verses.am: የአማሌቅንም ንጉሥ አጋግን በሕይወቱ ማረከው፥ ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት ፈጽሞ አጠፋቸው።

verses.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.
verses.fr: Mais Saül et le peuple épargnèrent Agag, et les meilleures brebis, les meilleurs boeufs, les meilleures bêtes de la seconde portée, les agneaux gras, et tout ce qu''il y avait de bon; ils ne voulurent pas le dévouer par interdit, et ils dévouèrent seulement tout ce qui était méprisable et chétif.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሳኦልና ሕዝቡ ለአጋግ፥ ለተመረጡትም በጎችና በሬዎች ለሰቡትም ጥጆችና ጠቦቶች፥ ለመልካሞቹም ሁሉ ራሩላቸው፥ ፈጽሞ ሊያጠፉአቸውም አልወደዱም፤ ነገር ግን ምናምንቴንና የተናቀውን ሁሉ ፈጽመው አጠፉት።

verses.en: Then came the word of the Lord unto Samuel, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel adressa la parole à Samuel, et lui dit:
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም በነጋው ሳኦልን ለመገናኘት ማለደ። ሳኦልም ወደ ቀርሜሎስ መጣ፤ እነሆም፥ የመታሰቢያ ዓምድ ባቆመ ጊዜ ዞሮ አለፈ፥ ወደ ጌልገላም ወረደ የሚል ወሬ ለሳሙኤል ደረሰለት።

verses.en: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the Lord all night.
verses.fr: Je me repens d''avoir établi Saül pour roi, car il se détourne de moi et il n''observe point mes paroles. Samuel fut irrité, et il cria à l''Eternel toute la nuit.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም በነጋው ሳኦልን ለመገናኘት ማለደ። ሳኦልም ወደ ቀርሜሎስ መጣ፤ እነሆም፥ የመታሰቢያ ዓምድ ባቆመ ጊዜ ዞሮ አለፈ፥ ወደ ጌልገላም ወረደ የሚል ወሬ ለሳሙኤል ደረሰለት።

verses.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.
verses.fr: Il se leva de bon matin, pour aller au-devant de Saül. Et on vint lui dire: Saül est allé à Carmel, et voici, il s''est érigé un monument; puis il s''en est retourné, et, passant plus loin, il est descendu à Guilgal.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ወደ ሳኦል መጣ፤ ሳኦልም። አንተ ለእግዚአብሔር የተባረክህ ሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ፈጽሜአለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the Lord: I have performed the commandment of the Lord.
verses.fr: Samuel se rendit auprès de Saül, et Saül lui dit: Sois béni de l''Eternel! J''ai observé la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም። ይህ በጆሮዬ የምሰማው የበጎች ጩኸትና የበሬዎች ግሣት ምንድር ነው? አለ።

verses.en: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
verses.fr: Samuel dit: Qu''est-ce donc que ce bêlement de brebis qui parvient à mes oreilles, et ce mugissement de boeufs que j''entends?
verses.am: ሳኦልም። ሕዝቡ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዉአቸው ዘንድ መልካሞቹን በጎችና በሬዎች አድነዋቸዋልና ከአማሌቃውያን አምጥተዋቸዋል፤ የቀሩትንም ፈጽመን አጠፋን አለው።

verses.en: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the Lord thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.
verses.fr: Saül répondit: Ils les ont amenés de chez les Amalécites, parce que le peuple a épargné les meilleures brebis et les meilleurs boeufs, afin de les sacrifier à l''Eternel, ton Dieu; et le reste, nous l''avons dévoué par interdit.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልን። ቆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ ሌሊት የነገረኝን ልንገርህ አለው፤ እርሱም። ተናገር አለው።
