verses.en: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the Lord hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.
verses.fr: Samuel dit à Saül: Arrête, et je te déclarerai ce que l''Eternel m''a dit cette nuit. Et Saül lui dit: Parle!
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም አለ። በዓይንህ ምንም ታናሽ ብትሆን ለእስራኤል ነገዶች አለቃ አልሆንህምን? እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ትሆን ዘንድ ቀባህ።

verses.en: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the Lord anointed thee king over Israel?
verses.fr: Samuel dit: Lorsque tu étais petit à tes yeux, n''es-tu pas devenu le chef des tribus d''Israël, et l''Eternel ne t''a-t-il pas oint pour que tu sois roi sur Israël?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሄደህ ኃጢአተኞቹን አማሌቃውያንን ፈጽመህ አጥፋቸው፥ እስኪጠፉም ድረስ ውጋቸው ብሎ በመንገድ ላከህ።

verses.en: And the Lord sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel t''avait fait partir, en disant: Va, et dévoue par interdit ces pécheurs, les Amalécites; tu leur feras la guerre jusqu''à ce que tu les aies exterminés.
verses.am: ለምርኮ ሳስተህ ለምን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማህም? ለምንስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረግህ?

verses.en: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the Lord, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the Lord?
verses.fr: Pourquoi n''as-tu pas écouté la voix de l''Eternel? pourquoi t''es-tu jeté sur le butin, et as-tu fait ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel?
verses.am: ሳኦልም ሳሙኤልን። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰምቻለሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በላከኝ መንገድ ሄጃለሁ፤ የአማሌቅን ንጉሥ አጋግን አምጥቻለሁ፥ አማሌቃውያንንም ፈጽሜ አጥፍቻለሁ።

verses.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the Lord, and have gone the way which the Lord sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
verses.fr: Saül répondit à Samuel: J''ai bien écouté la voix de l''Eternel, et j''ai suivi le chemin par lequel m''envoyait l''Eternel. J''ai amené Agag, roi d''Amalek, et j''ai dévoué par interdit les Amalécites;
verses.am: ሕዝቡ ግን ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር በጌልገላ ይሠዉ ዘንድ ከእርሙ የተመረጡትን በጎችንና በሬዎችን ከምርኮው ወሰዱ አለው።

verses.en: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the Lord thy God in Gilgal.
verses.fr: mais le peuple a pris sur le butin des brebis et des boeufs, comme prémices de ce qui devait être dévoué, afin de les sacrifier à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, à Guilgal.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም። በውኑ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በመስማት ደስ እንደሚለው እግዚአብሔር በሚቃጠልና በሚታረድ መሥዋዕት ደስ ይለዋልን? እነሆ፥ መታዘዝ ከመሥዋዕት፥ ማዳመጥም የአውራ በግ ስብ ከማቅረብ ይበልጣል።

verses.en: And Samuel said, Hath the Lord as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
verses.fr: Samuel dit: L''Eternel trouve-t-il du plaisir dans les holocaustes et les sacrifices, comme dans l''obéissance à la voix de l''Eternel? Voici, l''obéissance vaut mieux que les sacrifices, et l''observation de sa parole vaut mieux que la graisse des béliers.
verses.am: ዓመፀኝነት እንደ ምዋርተኛ ኃጢአት፥ እልከኝነትም ጣዖትንና ተራፊምን እንደ ማምለክ ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ንቀሃልና እግዚአብሔር ንጉሥ እንዳትሆን ናቀህ አለ።

verses.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
verses.fr: Car la désobéissance est aussi coupable que la divination, et la résistance ne l''est pas moins que l''idolâtrie et les théraphim. Puisque tu as rejeté la parole de l''Eternel, il te rejette aussi comme roi.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ሳሙኤልን። ሕዝቡን ስለ ፈራሁ፥ ቃላቸውንም ስለ ሰማሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝና የአንተን ቃል በመተላለፍ በድያለሁ።

verses.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.
verses.fr: Alors Saül dit à Samuel: J''ai péché, car j''ai transgressé l''ordre de l''Eternel, et je n''ai pas obéi à tes paroles; je craignais le peuple, et j''ai écouté sa voix.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እባክህ፥ ኃጢአቴን ይቅር በለኝ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም እሰግድ ዘንድ ከእኔ ጋር ተመለስ አለው።

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the Lord.
verses.fr: Maintenant, je te prie, pardonne mon péché, reviens avec moi, et je me prosternerai devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሳኦልን። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ንቀሃልና፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ እንዳትሆን ንቆሃልና ከአንተ ጋር አልመለስም አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, and the Lord hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.
verses.fr: Samuel dit à Saül: Je ne retournerai point avec toi; car tu as rejeté la parole de l''Eternel, et l''Eternel te rejette, afin que tu ne sois plus roi sur Israël.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሊሄድ ዘወር ባለ ጊዜ ሳኦል የልብሱን ጫፍ ያዘ፥ ተቀደደም።

verses.en: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
verses.fr: Et comme Samuel se tournait pour s''en aller, Saül le saisit par le pan de son manteau, qui se déchira.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም። እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን መንግሥት ዛሬ ከአንተ ቀደዳት፥ ከአንተም ለሚሻል ለጎረቤትህ አሳልፎ ሰጣት፤

verses.en: And Samuel said unto him, The Lord hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.
verses.fr: Samuel lui dit: L''Eternel déchire aujourd''hui de dessus toi la royauté d''Israël, et il la donne à un autre, qui est meilleur que toi.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ኃይል እንደ ሰው የሚጸጸት አይደለምና አይዋሽም አይጸጸትምም አለው።

verses.en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.
verses.fr: Celui qui est la force d''Israël ne ment point et ne se repent point, car il n''est pas un homme pour se repentir.
verses.am: እርሱም። በድያለሁ፤ አሁን ግን በሕዝቤ ሽማግሌዎች ፊትና በእስራኤል ፊት፥ እባክህ፥ አክብረኝ፤ ለአምላክህም ለእግዚአብሔር እሰግድ ዘንድ ከእኔ ጋር ተመለስ አለው።

verses.en: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Saül dit encore: J''ai péché! Maintenant, je te prie, honore-moi en présence des anciens de mon peuple et en présence d''Israël; reviens avec moi, et je me prosternerai devant l''Eternel, ton Dieu.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ከሳኦል በኋላ ተመለሰ፤ ሳኦልም ለእግዚአብሔር ሰገደ።

verses.en: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the Lord.
verses.fr: Samuel retourna et suivit Saül, et Saül se prosterna devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም። የአማሌቅን ንጉሥ አጋግን አምጡልኝ አለ። አጋግም እየተንቀጠቀጠ ወደ እርሱ መጣ። አጋግም። በውኑ ሞት እንደዚህ መራራ ነውን? አለ።

verses.en: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
verses.fr: Puis Samuel dit: Amenez-moi Agag, roi d''Amalek. Et Agag s''avança vers lui d''un air joyeux; il disait: Certainement, l''amertume de la mort est passée.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም። ሰይፍህ ሴቶችን ልጆች አልባ እንዳደረገቻቸው እንዲሁ እናትህ በሴቶች መካከል ልጅ አልባ ትሆናለች አለ፤ ሳሙኤልም አጋግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በጌልገላ ቈራረጠው።

verses.en: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the Lord in Gilgal.
verses.fr: Samuel dit: De même que ton épée a privé des femmes de leurs enfants, ainsi ta mère entre les femmes sera privée d''un fils. Et Samuel mit Agag en pièces devant l''Eternel, à Guilgal.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ወደ አርማቴም ሄደ፤

verses.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
verses.fr: Samuel partit pour Rama, et Saül monta dans sa maison à Guibea de Saül.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ጊብዓ ወጣ። ሳሙኤልም እስከ ሞተበት ቀን ድረስ ሳኦልን ለማየት ዳግመኛ አልሄደም፥ ሳሙኤልም ለሳኦል አለቀሰ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ ሳኦልን ስላነገሠ ተጸጸተ።

verses.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the Lord repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.
verses.fr: Samuel n''alla plus voir Saül jusqu''au jour de sa mort; car Samuel pleurait sur Saül, parce que l''Eternel se repentait d''avoir établi Saül roi d''Israël.
verses.am: ፤ ሳኦልም ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ጊብዓ ወጣ። ሳሙኤልም እስከ ሞተበት ቀን ድረስ ሳኦልን ለማየት ዳግመኛ አልሄደም፥ ሳሙኤልም ለሳኦል አለቀሰ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ላይ ሳኦልን ስላነገሠ ተጸጸተ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Samuel: Quand cesseras-tu de pleurer sur Saül? Je l''ai rejeté, afin qu''il ne règne plus sur Israël. Remplis ta corne d''huile, et va; je t''enverrai chez Isaï, Bethléhémite, car j''ai vu parmi ses fils celui que je désire pour roi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሳሙኤልን። በእስራኤል ላይ እንዳይነግሥ ለናቅሁት ለሳኦል የምታለቅስለት እስከ መቼ ነው? በቀንድህ ዘይቱን ሞልተህ ሂድ፤ በልጆቹ መካከል ንጉሥ አዘጋጅቻለሁና ወደ እሴይ ወደ ቤተ ልሔም እልክሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And the Lord said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.fr: Samuel dit: Comment irai-je? Saül l''apprendra, et il me tuera. Et l''Eternel dit: Tu emmèneras avec toi une génisse, et tu diras: Je viens pour offrir un sacrifice à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም። እንዴት እሄዳለሁ? ሳኦል ቢሰማ ይገድለኛል አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። አንዲት ጊደር ይዘህ ሂድና፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እሠዋ ዘንድ መጣሁ በል።

verses.en: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.
verses.fr: Tu inviteras Isaï au sacrifice; je te ferai connaître ce que tu dois faire, et tu oindras pour moi celui que je te dirai.
verses.am: እሴይንም ወደ መሥዋዕቱ ጥራው፥ የምታደርገውንም አስታውቅሃለሁ፤ የምነግርህንም ቅባልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel did that which the Lord spake, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?
verses.fr: Samuel fit ce que l''Eternel avait dit, et il alla à Bethléhem. Les anciens de la ville accoururent effrayés au-devant de lui et dirent: Ton arrivée annonce-t-elle quelque chose d''heureux?
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን አደረገ፥ ወደ ቤተ ልሔምም መጣ። የአገሩም ሽማግሌዎች እየተንቀጠቀጡ ሊገናኙት መጡና። የመጣኸው ለደኅንነት ነውን? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the Lord: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Oui; je viens pour offrir un sacrifice à l''Eternel. Sanctifiez-vous, et venez avec moi au sacrifice. Il fit aussi sanctifier Isaï et ses fils, et il les invita au sacrifice.
verses.am: እርሱም። ለደኅንነት ነው፤ ለእግዚአብሔር እሠዋ ዘንድ መጣሁ፤ ቅዱሳን ሁኑ፥ ከእኔም ጋር ወደ መሥዋዕቱ ኑ አለ። እሴይንና ልጆቹንም ቀደሳቸው፥ ወደ መሥዋዕቱም ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the Lord's anointed is before him.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils entrèrent, il se dit, en voyant Eliab: Certainement, l''oint de l''Eternel est ici devant lui.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በመጡ ጊዜ ወደ ኤልያብ ተመልክቶ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር የሚቀባው በፊቱ ነው አለ።

verses.en: But the Lord said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Samuel: Ne prends point garde à son apparence et à la hauteur de sa taille, car je l''ai rejeté. L''Eternel ne considère pas ce que l''homme considère; l''homme regarde à ce qui frappe les yeux, mais l''Eternel regarde au coeur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ሳሙኤልን። ፊቱን የቁመቱንም ዘለግታ አትይ፤ ሰው እንዲያይ እግዚአብሔር አያይምና ናቅሁት፤ ሰው ፊትን ያያል፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን ልብን ያያል አለው።

verses.en: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the Lord chosen this.
verses.fr: Isaï appela Abinadab, et le fit passer devant Samuel; et Samuel dit: L''Eternel n''a pas non plus choisi celui-ci.
verses.am: እሴይም አሚናዳብን ጠርቶ በሳሙኤል ፊት አሳለፈው፤ እርሱም። ይህን ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር አልመረጠውም አለ።

verses.en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the Lord chosen this.
verses.fr: Isaï fit passer Schamma; et Samuel dit: L''Eternel n''a pas non plus choisi celui-ci.
verses.am: እሴይም ሣማን አሳለፈው፤ እርሱም። ይህን ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር አልመረጠውም አለ።

verses.en: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The Lord hath not chosen these.
verses.fr: Isaï fit passer ses sept fils devant Samuel; et Samuel dit à Isaï: L''Eternel n''a choisi aucun d''eux.
verses.am: እሴይም ከልጆቹ ሰባቱን በሳሙኤል ፊት አሳለፋቸው። ሳሙኤልም እሴይን። እግዚአብሔር እነዚህን አልመረጠም አለው።

verses.en: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.
verses.fr: Puis Samuel dit à Isaï: Sont-ce là tous tes fils? Et il répondit: Il reste encore le plus jeune, mais il fait paître les brebis. Alors Samuel dit à Isaï: Envoie-le chercher, car nous ne nous placerons pas avant qu''il ne soit venu ici.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም እሴይን። የቀረ ሌላ ልጅ አለህን? አለው። እርሱም። ታናሹ ገና ቀርቶአል፤ እነሆም፥ በጎችን ይጠብቃል አለ። ሳሙኤልም እሴይን። እርሱ እስኪመጣ ድረስ አንረፍቅምና ልከህ አስመጣው አለው።

verses.en: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the Lord said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
verses.fr: Isaï l''envoya chercher. Or il était blond, avec de beaux yeux et une belle figure. L''Eternel dit à Samuel: Lève-toi, oins-le, car c''est lui!
verses.am: ልኮም አስመጣው፤ እርሱም ቀይ፥ ዓይኑም የተዋበ፥ መልኩም ያማረ ነበረ። እግዚአብሔርም። ይህ ነውና ተነሥተህ ቅባው አለ።

verses.en: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
verses.fr: Samuel prit la corne d''huile, et l''oignit au milieu de ses frères. L''esprit de l''Eternel saisit David, à partir de ce jour et dans la suite. Samuel se leva, et s''en alla à Rama.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም የዘይቱን ቀንድ ወስዶ በወንድሞቹ መካከል ቀባው። የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ ከዚያ ቀን ጀምሮ በዳዊት ላይ በኃይል መጣ። ሳሙኤልም ተነሥቶ ወደ አርማቴም ሄደ።

verses.en: But the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord troubled him.
verses.fr: L''esprit de l''Eternel se retira de Saül, qui fut agité par un mauvais esprit venant de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ ከሳኦል ራቀ፥ ክፉም መንፈስ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አሠቃየው።

verses.en: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs de Saül lui dirent: Voici, un mauvais esprit de Dieu t''agite.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ባሪያዎች። እነሆ ክፉ መንፈስ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያሠቃይሃል፤

verses.en: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.
verses.fr: Que notre seigneur parle! Tes serviteurs sont devant toi. Ils chercheront un homme qui sache jouer de la harpe; et, quand le mauvais esprit de Dieu sera sur toi, il jouera de sa main, et tu seras soulagé.
verses.am: በገና መልካም አድርጎ የሚመታ ሰው ይሹ ዘንድ ጌታችን በፊቱ የሚቆሙትን ባሪያዎቹን ይዘዝ፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ክፉ መንፈስ በሆነብህ ጊዜ በእጁ ሲመታ አንተ ደኅና ትሆናለህ አሉት።

verses.en: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.
verses.fr: Saül répondit à ses serviteurs: Trouvez-moi donc un homme qui joue bien, et amenez-le-moi.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ባሪያዎቹን። መልካም አድርጎ በገና መምታት የሚችል ሰው ፈልጋችሁ አምጡልኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the Lord is with him.
verses.fr: L''un des serviteurs prit la parole, et dit: Voici, j''ai vu un fils d''Isaï, Bethléhémite, qui sait jouer; c''est aussi un homme fort et vaillant, un guerrier, parlant bien et d''une belle figure, et l''Eternel est avec lui.
verses.am: ከብላቴኖቹም አንዱ መልሶ። እነሆ፥ መልካም አድርጎ በገና የሚመታ የቤተ ልሔማዊውን የእሴይን ልጅ አይቻለሁ፤ እርሱም ጽኑዕ ኃያል ነው፥ በነገርም ብልህ፥ መልኩም ያማረ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነው አለ።

verses.en: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.
verses.fr: Saül envoya des messagers à Isaï, pour lui dire: Envoie-moi David, ton fils, qui est avec les brebis.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ወደ እሴይ መልክተኞች ልኮ። ከበጎች ጋር ያለውን ልጅህን ዳዊትን ላክልኝ አለ።

verses.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.
verses.fr: Isaï prit un âne, qu''il chargea de pain, d''une outre de vin et d''un chevreau, et il envoya ces choses à Saül par David, son fils.
verses.am: እሴይም እንጀራና የወይን ጠጅ አቁማዳ የተጫነ አህያ የፍየልም ጠቦት ወስዶ በልጁ በዳዋት እጅ ወደ ሳኦል ላከ።

verses.en: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.
verses.fr: David arriva auprès de Saül, et se présenta devant lui; il plut beaucoup à Saül, et il fut désigné pour porter ses armes.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ወደ ሳኦል መጣ፥ በፊቱም ቆመ፤ እጅግም ወደደው፥ ለእርሱም ጋሻ ጃግሬው ሆነ።

verses.en: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.
verses.fr: Saül fit dire à Isaï: Je te prie de laisser David à mon service, car il a trouvé grâce à mes yeux.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ወደ እሴይ። በዓይኔ ሞገስ አግኝቶአልና ዳዊት በፊቴ፥ እባክህ፥ ይቁም ብሎ ላከ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
verses.fr: Et lorsque l''esprit de Dieu était sur Saül, David prenait la harpe et jouait de sa main; Saül respirait alors plus à l''aise et se trouvait soulagé, et le mauvais esprit se retirait de lui.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ክፉ መንፈስ በሳኦል ላይ በሆነ ጊዜ ዳዊት በገና ይዞ በእጁ ይመታ ነበር፤ ሳኦልንም ደስ ያሰኘው ያሳርፈውም ነበር፥ ክፉ መንፈስም ከእርሱ ይርቅ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.
verses.fr: Les Philistins réunirent leurs armées pour faire la guerre, et ils se rassemblèrent à Soco, qui appartient à Juda; ils campèrent entre Soco et Azéka, à Ephès-Dammim.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍሮቻቸውን በይሁዳ ባለው በሰኮት አከማቹ፤ በሰኮትና በዓዜቃ መካከል በኤፌስደሚም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
verses.fr: Saül et les hommes d''Israël se rassemblèrent aussi; ils campèrent dans la vallée des térébinthes, et ils se mirent en ordre de bataille contre les Philistins.
verses.am: ሳኦልና የእስራኤል ሰዎች ተከማቹ፥ በዔላ ሸለቆም ሰፈሩ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጋር ሊዋጉ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
verses.fr: Les Philistins étaient vers la montagne d''un côté, et Israël était vers la montagne de l''autre côté: la vallée les séparait.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም በአንድ ወገን በተራራ ላይ ቆመው ነበር፥ እስራኤልም በሌላው ወገን በተራራ ላይ ቆመው ነበር፤ በመካከላቸውም ሸለቆ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
verses.fr: Un homme sortit alors du camp des Philistins et s''avança entre les deux armées. Il se nommait Goliath, il était de Gath, et il avait une taille de six coudées et un empan.
verses.am: ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሰፈር የጌት ሰው ጎልያድ፥ ቁመቱም ስድስት ክንድ ከስንዝር የሆነ፥ ዋነኛ ጀግና መጣ።

verses.en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
verses.fr: Sur sa tête était un casque d''airain, et il portait une cuirasse à écailles du poids de cinq mille sicles d''airain.
verses.am: በራሱም የናስ ቍር ደፍቶ ነበር፥ ጥሩርም ለብሶ ነበር፤ የጥሩሩም ሚዛን አምስት ሺህ ሰቅል ናስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
verses.fr: Il avait aux jambes une armure d''airain, et un javelot d''airain entre les épaules.
verses.am: በእግሮቹም ላይ የናስ ገምባሌ ነበረ፥ የናስም ጭሬ በትከሻው ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
verses.fr: Le bois de sa lance était comme une ensouple de tisserand, et la lance pesait six cents sicles de fer. Celui qui portait son bouclier marchait devant lui.
verses.am: የጦሩም የቦ እንደ ሸማኔ መጠቅልያ ነበረ፤ የጦሩም ሚዛን ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ብረት ነበረ፤ ጋሻ ጃግሬውም በፊቱ ይሄድ ነበር።

verses.en: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.
verses.fr: Le Philistin s''arrêta; et, s''adressant aux troupes d''Israël rangées en bataille, il leur cria: Pourquoi sortez-vous pour vous ranger en bataille? Ne suis-je pas le Philistin, et n''êtes-vous pas des esclaves de Saül? Choisissez un homme qui descende contre moi!
verses.am: እርሱም ቆሞ ወደ እስራኤል ጭፍሮች ጮኸ። ለሰልፍ ትሠሩ ዘንድ ለምን ወጣችሁ? እኔ ፍልስጥኤማዊ፥ እናንተም የሳኦል ባሪያዎች አይደላችሁምን? ለእናንተ አንድ ሰው ምረጡ፥ ወደ እኔም ይውረድ፤

verses.en: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.
verses.fr: S''il peut me battre et qu''il me tue, nous vous serons assujettis; mais si je l''emporte sur lui et que je le tue, vous nous serez assujettis et vous nous servirez.
verses.am: ከእኔም ጋር ሊዋጋ ቢችል ቢገድለኝም፥ ባሪያዎች እንሆናችኋለን፤ እኔ ግን ባሸንፈው ብገድለውም፥ እናንተ ባሪያዎች ትሆኑናላችሁ፥ ለእኛም ትገዛላችሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.
verses.fr: Le Philistin dit encore: Je jette en ce jour un défi à l''armée d''Israël! Donnez-moi un homme, et nous nous battrons ensemble.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማዊውም። ዛሬ የእስራኤልን ጭፎሮች ተገዳደርኋቸው፤ እንዋጋ ዘንድ አንድ ሰው ስጡኝ አለ።

verses.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
verses.fr: Saül et tout Israël entendirent ces paroles du Philistin, et ils furent effrayés et saisis d''une grande crainte.
verses.am: ሳኦልና እስራኤልም ሁሉ እንዲህ የሚላቸውን የፍልስጥኤማዊውን ቃል በሰሙ ጊዜ እጅግ ፈሩ፥ ደነገጡም።

verses.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.
verses.fr: Or David était fils de cet Ephratien de Bethléhem de Juda, nommé Isaï, qui avait huit fils, et qui, du temps de Saül, était vieux, avancé en âge.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የዚያ የኤፍራታዊው ሰው ልጅ ነበረ፤ ያም ሰው ከቤተ ልሔም ይሁዳ ስሙም እሴይ ነበረ፤ ስምንትም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በሳኦልም ዘመን በዕድሜ አርጅቶ ሸምግሎም ነበር።

verses.en: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
verses.fr: Les trois fils aînés d''Isaï avaient suivi Saül à la guerre; le premier-né de ses trois fils qui étaient partis pour la guerre s''appelait Eliab, le second Abinadab, et le troisième Schamma.
verses.am: የእሴይም ሦስቱ ታላላቆች ልጆቹ ሳኦልን ተከትለው ወደ ሰልፉ ሄደው ነበር፤ ወደ ሰልፉም የሄዱት የሦስቱ ልጆቹ ስም ይህ ነበረ፤ ታላቁ ኤልያብ ሁለተኛውም አሚናዳብ ሦስተኛውም ሣማ ነበረ።

verses.en: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.
verses.fr: David était le plus jeune. Et lorsque les trois aînés eurent suivi Saül,
verses.am: ዳዊት የሁሉ ታናሽ ነበረ፤ ሦስቱም ታላላቆች ሳኦልን ተከትለው ነበር።

verses.en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.
verses.fr: David s''en alla de chez Saül et revint à Bethléhem pour faire paître les brebis de son père.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የአባቱን በጎች ለመጠበቅ ከሳኦል ዘንድ ወደ ቤተ ልሔም ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
verses.fr: Le Philistin s''avançait matin et soir, et il se présenta pendant quarante jours.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማዊውም ጥዋትና ማታ ይቀርብ፥ አርባ ቀንም ይታይ ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp of thy brethren;
verses.fr: Isaï dit à David, son fils: Prends pour tes frères cet épha de grain rôti et ces dix pains, et cours au camp vers tes frères;
verses.am: እሴይም ልጁን ዳዊትን እንዲህ አለው። ከዚህ ከተጠበሰው እሸት አንድ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ እነዚህንም አሥር እንጀራዎች ለወንድሞችህ ውሰድ፥ ወደ ሰፈሩም ወደ ወንድሞችህ ፈጥነህ አድርሳቸው፤

verses.en: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.
verses.fr: porte aussi ces dix fromages au chef de leur millier. Tu verras si tes frères se portent bien, et tu m''en donneras des nouvelles sûres.
verses.am: ይህንም አሥሩን አይብ ወደ ሻለቃው ውሰደው፤ የወንድሞችህንም ደኅንነት ጠይቅ፥ ወሬአቸውንም አምጣልኝ።

verses.en: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
verses.fr: Ils sont avec Saül et tous les hommes d''Israël dans la vallée des térébinthes, faisant la guerre aux Philistins.
verses.am: ሳኦልና እነርሱ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር እየተዋጉ በዔላ ሸለቆ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.
verses.fr: David se leva de bon matin. Il laissa les brebis à un gardien, prit sa charge, et partit, comme Isaï le lui avait ordonné. Lorsqu''il arriva au camp, l''armée était en marche pour se ranger en bataille et poussait des cris de guerre.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ በጎቹንም ለጠባቂ ተወ፥ እሴይም ያዘዘውን ይዞ ሄደ፤ ጭፍራውም ተሰልፎ ሲወጣ ለሰልፍም ሲጮኽ በሰረገሎች ወደ ተከበበው ሰፈር መጣ።

verses.en: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.
verses.fr: Israël et les Philistins se formèrent en bataille, armée contre armée.
verses.am: እስራኤልና ፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ለፊት ተሰላልፈው ነበር።

verses.en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.
verses.fr: David remit les objets qu''il portait entre les mains du gardien des bagages, et courut vers les rangs de l''armée. Aussitôt arrivé, il demanda à ses frères comment ils se portaient.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ዕቃውን በዕቃ ጠባቂው እጅ አኖረው፥ ወደ ሠራዊቱም ሮጠ፥ የወንድሞቹንም ደኅንነት ጠየቀ።

verses.en: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.
verses.fr: Tandis qu''il parlait avec eux, voici, le Philistin de Gath, nommé Goliath, s''avança entre les deux armées, hors des rangs des Philistins. Il tint les mêmes discours que précédemment, et David les entendit.
verses.am: እርሱም ሲነጋገራቸው፥ እነሆ፥ ጎልያድ የተባለው ያ ዋነኛ ጀግና ፍልስጥኤማዊ የጌት ሰው ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጭፍራ መካከል ወጣ፥ የተናገረውንም ቃል ተናገረ፤ ዳዊትም ሰማ።

verses.en: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.
verses.fr: A la vue de cet homme, tous ceux d''Israël s''enfuirent devant lui et furent saisis d''une grande crainte.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰውዮውን ባዩ ጊዜ እጅግ ፈርተው ከእርሱ ሸሹ።

verses.en: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.
verses.fr: Chacun disait: Avez-vous vu s''avancer cet homme? C''est pour jeter à Israël un défi qu''il s''est avancé! Si quelqu''un le tue, le roi le comblera de richesses, il lui donnera sa fille, et il affranchira la maison de son père en Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች። ይህን የወጣውን ሰው አያችሁትን? በእውነት እስራኤልን ሊገዳደር ወጣ፤ የሚገድለውንም ሰው ንጉሡ እጅግ ባለጠጋ ያደርገዋል፥ ልጁንም ይድርለታል፤ ያባቱንም ቤተ ሰብ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከግብር ነጻ ያወጣቸዋል አሉ።

verses.en: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
verses.fr: David dit aux hommes qui se trouvaient près de lui: Que fera-t-on à celui qui tuera ce Philistin, et qui ôtera l''opprobre de dessus Israël? Qui est donc ce Philistin, cet incirconcis, pour insulter l''armée du Dieu vivant?
verses.am: ዳዊትም በአጠገቡ ለቆሙት ሰዎች። ይህን ፍልስጥኤማዊ ለሚገድል፥ ከእስራኤልም ተግዳሮትን ለሚያርቅ ሰው ምን ይደረግለታል? የሕያውን አምላክ ጭፍሮች የሚገዳደር ይህ ያልተገረዘ ፍልስጥኤማዊ ማን ነው? ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
verses.fr: Le peuple, répétant les mêmes choses, lui dit: C''est ainsi que l''on fera à celui qui le tuera.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። ለሚገድለው ሰው እንዲህ ይደረግለታል ብለው እንደ ቀድሞው መለሱለት።

verses.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.
verses.fr: Eliab, son frère aîné, qui l''avait entendu parler à ces hommes, fut enflammé de colère contre David. Et il dit: Pourquoi es-tu descendu, et à qui as-tu laissé ce peu de brebis dans le désert? Je connais ton orgueil et la malice de ton coeur. C''est pour voir la bataille que tu es descendu.
verses.am: ታላቅ ወንድሙም ኤልያብ ከሰዎች ጋር ሲነጋገር ሰማ፤ የኤልያብም ቍጣ በዳዊት ላይ ነድዶ። ለምን ወደዚህ ወረድህ? እነዚያንስ ጥቂቶች በጎች በምድረ በዳ ለማን ተውሃቸው? እኔ ኵራትህንና የልብህን ክፋት አውቃለሁና ሰልፉን ለማየት መጥተሃል አለው።

verses.en: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
verses.fr: David répondit: Qu''ai-je donc fait? ne puis-je pas parler ainsi?
verses.am: ዳዊትም። እኔ ምን አደርግሁ? ይህ ታላቅ ነገር አይደለምን? አለ።

verses.en: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.
verses.fr: Et il se détourna de lui pour s''adresser à un autre, et fit les mêmes questions. Le peuple lui répondit comme la première fois.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ ወደ ሌላ ሰው ዘወር አለ፥ እንደዚህም ያለ ነገር ተናገረ፤ ሕዝቡም እንደ ቀድሞው ያለ ነገር መለሱለት።

verses.en: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''on eut entendu les paroles prononcées par David, on les répéta devant Saül, qui le fit chercher.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የተናገረው ቃል ተሰማ፥ ለሳኦልም ነገሩት፤ ወደ እርሱም አስጠራው።

verses.en: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.
verses.fr: David dit à Saül: Que personne ne se décourage à cause de ce Philistin! Ton serviteur ira se battre avec lui.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሳኦልን። ስለ እርሱ የማንም ልብ አይውደቅ፤ እኔ ባሪያህ ሄጄ ያንን ፍልስጥኤማዊ እወጋዋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.
verses.fr: Saül dit à David: Tu ne peux pas aller te battre avec ce Philistin, car tu es un enfant, et il est un homme de guerre dès sa jeunesse.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን። አንተ ገና ብላቴና ነህና፥ እርሱም ከብላቴንነቱ ጀምሮ ጦረኛ ነውና ይህን ፍልስጥኤማዊ ለመውጋት ትሄድ ዘንድ አትችልም አለው።

verses.en: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
verses.fr: David dit à Saül: Ton serviteur faisait paître les brebis de son père. Et quand un lion ou un ours venait en enlever une du troupeau,
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሳኦልን አለው። እኔ ባሪያህ የአባቴን በጎች ስጠብቅ አንበሳና ድብ ይመጣ ነበር፥ ከመንጋውም ጠቦት ይወስድ ነበር።

verses.en: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
verses.fr: je courais après lui, je le frappais, et j''arrachais la brebis de sa gueule. S''il se dressait contre moi, je le saisissais par la gorge, je le frappais, et je le tuais.
verses.am: በኋላውም እከተለውና እመታው ነበር፥ ከአፉም አስጥለው ነበር፤ በተነሣብኝም ጊዜ ጕሮሮውን ይዤ እመታውና እገድለው ነበር።

verses.en: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que ton serviteur a terrassé le lion et l''ours, et il en sera du Philistin, de cet incirconcis, comme de l''un d''eux, car il a insulté l''armée du Dieu vivant.
verses.am: እኔ ባሪያህ አንበሳና ድብ መታሁ፤ ይህም ያልተገረዘው ፍልስጥኤማዊ የሕያውን አምላክ ጭፍሮች ተገዳድሮአልና ከእነርሱ እንደ አንዱ ይሆናል።

verses.en: David said moreover, The Lord that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the Lord be with thee.
verses.fr: David dit encore: L''Eternel, qui m''a délivré de la griffe du lion et de la patte de l''ours, me délivrera aussi de la main de ce Philistin. Et Saül dit à David: Va, et que l''Eternel soit avec toi!
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ከአንበሳና ከድብ እጅ ያስጣለኝ እግዚአብሔር ከዚህ ፍልስጥኤማዊ እጅ ያስጥለኛል አለ። ሳኦልም ዳዊትን። ሂድ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል አለው።

verses.en: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
verses.fr: Saül fit mettre ses vêtements à David, il plaça sur sa tête un casque d''airain, et le revêtit d''une cuirasse.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን የገዛ ራሱን ልብስ አለበሰው፥ በራሱም ላይ የናስ ቍር ደፋለት፥ ጥሩርም አለበሰው።

verses.en: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
verses.fr: David ceignit l''épée de Saül par-dessus ses habits, et voulut marcher, car il n''avait pas encore essayé. Mais il dit à Saül: Je ne puis pas marcher avec cette armure, je n''y suis pas accoutumé. Et il s''en débarrassa.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሰይፉን በልብሱ ላይ ታጠቀ፥ ገናም አልፈተነውምና መሄድ ሞከረ። ዳዊትም ሳኦልን። አልፈተንሁትምና እንዲህ ብዬ መሄድ አልችልም አለው።

verses.en: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
verses.fr: Il prit en main son bâton, choisit dans le torrent cinq pierres polies, et les mit dans sa gibecière de berger et dans sa poche. Puis, sa fronde à la main, il s''avança contre le Philistin.
verses.am: ዳዊትም አወለቀ። በትሩንም በእጁ ወሰደ፥ ከወንዝም አምስት ድብልብል ድንጋዮችን መረጠ፥ በእረኛ ኮረጆውም በኪሱ ከተታቸው፤ ወንጭፍም በእጁ ነበረ፤ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማዊውም ቀረበ።

verses.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
verses.fr: Le Philistin s''approcha peu à peu de David, et l''homme qui portait son bouclier marchait devant lui.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማዊውም መጥቶ ወደ ዳዊት ቀረበ፤ ጋሻ ጃግሬውም በፊቱ ይሄድ ነበር።

verses.en: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
verses.fr: Le Philistin regarda, et lorsqu''il aperçut David, il le méprisa, ne voyant en lui qu''un enfant, blond et d''une belle figure.
verses.am: ጎልያድም ዳዊትን ትኵር ብሎ አየው፤ ቀይ ብላቴና መልኩም ያማረ ነበረና ናቀው።

verses.en: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.fr: Le Philistin dit à David: Suis-je un chien, pour que tu viennes à moi avec des bâtons? Et, après l''avoir maudit par ses dieux,
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማዊውም ዳዊትን። በትር ይዘህ የምትመጣብኝ እኔ ውሻ ነኝን? አለው። ፍልስጥኤማዊውም በአምላኮቹ ስም ዳዊትን ረገመው።

verses.en: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.
verses.fr: il ajouta: Viens vers moi, et je donnerai ta chair aux oiseaux du ciel et aux bêtes des champs.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማዊውም ዳዊትን። ወደ እኔ ና፥ ሥጋህንም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት እሰጣለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
verses.fr: David dit au Philistin: Tu marches contre moi avec l''épée, la lance et le javelot; et moi, je marche contre toi au nom de l''Eternel des armées, du Dieu de l''armée d''Israël, que tu as insultée.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ፍልስጥኤማዊውን አለው። አንተ ሰይፍና ጦር ጭሬም ይዘህ ትመጣብኛለህ፤ እኔ ግን ዛሬ በተገዳደርኸው በእስራኤል ጭፍሮች አምላክ ስም በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ስም እመጣብሃለሁ።

verses.en: This day will the Lord deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
verses.fr: Aujourd''hui l''Eternel te livrera entre mes mains, je t''abattrai et je te couperai la tête; aujourd''hui je donnerai les cadavres du camp des Philistins aux oiseaux du ciel et aux animaux de la terre. Et toute la terre saura qu''Israël a un Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ አንተን በእጄ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፤ እመታህማለሁ፥ ራስህንም ከአንተ አነሣዋለሁ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ሠራዊት ሬሶች ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት ዛሬ እሰጣለሁ። ይኸውም ምድር ሁሉ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ እንዳለ ታውቅ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the Lord's, and he will give you into our hands.
verses.fr: Et toute cette multitude saura que ce n''est ni par l''épée ni par la lance que l''Eternel sauve. Car la victoire appartient à l''Eternel. Et il vous livre entre nos mains.
verses.am: ይህም ጉባኤ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በሰይፍና በጦር የሚያድን እንዳይደል ያውቅ ዘንድ ነው። ሰልፉ ለእግዚአብሔር ነውና፤ እናንተንም በእጃችን አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came, and drew nigh to meet David, that David hastened, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
verses.fr: Aussitôt que le Philistin se mit en mouvement pour marcher au-devant de David, David courut sur le champ de bataille à la rencontre du Philistin.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማዊውም ተነሥቶ ዳዊትን ሊገናኘው በቀረበ ጊዜ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማዊውን ሊገናኘው ወደ ሰልፉ ሮጠ።

verses.en: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
verses.fr: Il mit la main dans sa gibecière, y prit une pierre, et la lança avec sa fronde; il frappa le Philistin au front, et la pierre s''enfonça dans le front du Philistin, qui tomba le visage contre terre.
verses.am: ዳዊትም እጁን ወደ ኮረጆው አግብቶ አንድ ድንጋይ ወሰደ፥ ወነጨፈውም፥ ፍልስጥኤማዊውንም ግምባሩን መታ፤ ድንጋዩም በግምባሩ ተቀረቀረ፥ እርሱም በምድር ላይ በፊቱ ተደፋ።

verses.en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
verses.fr: Ainsi, avec une fronde et une pierre, David fut plus fort que le Philistin; il le terrassa et lui ôta la vie, sans avoir d''épée à la main.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ፍልስጥኤማዊውን በወንጭፍና በድንጋይ አሸነፈው፥ ፍልስጥኤማዊውንም መትቶ ገደለ፤ በዳዊትም እጅ ሰይፍ አልነበረም።

verses.en: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.fr: Il courut, s''arrêta près du Philistin, se saisit de son épée qu''il tira du fourreau, le tua et lui coupa la tête. Les Philistins, voyant que leur héros était mort, prirent la fuite.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሮጦ በፍልስጥኤማዊው ላይ ቆመ፤ ሰይፉንም ይዞ ከሰገባው መዘዘው፥ ገደለውም፥ ራሱንም ቈረጠው። ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ዋናቸው እንደ ሞተ ባዩ ጊዜ ሸሹ።

verses.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.
verses.fr: Et les hommes d''Israël et de Juda poussèrent des cris, et allèrent à la poursuite des Philistins jusque dans la vallée et jusqu''aux portes d''Ekron. Les Philistins blessés à mort tombèrent dans le chemin de Schaaraïm jusqu''à Gath et jusqu''à Ekron.
verses.am: የእስራኤልና የይሁዳ ሰዎች ተነሥተው እልል አሉ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም እስከ ጌትና እስከ አስቀሎና በርድረስ አሳደዱአቸው። ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከሸዓራይም ጀምሮ እስከ ጌትና እስከ አቃሮን ድረስ በመንገድ ላይ የተመቱት ወደቁ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.
verses.fr: Et les enfants d''Israël revinrent de la poursuite des Philistins, et pillèrent leur camp.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ከማሳደድ ተመልሰው ሰፈራቸውን በዘበዙ።

verses.en: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.
verses.fr: David prit la tête du Philistin et la porta à Jérusalem, et il mit dans sa tente les armes du Philistin.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የፍልስጥኤማዊውን ራስ ይዞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አመጣው፤ ጋሻ ጦሩን ግን በድንኳኑ ውስጥ አኖረው።

verses.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.
verses.fr: Lorsque Saül avait vu David marcher à la rencontre du Philistin, il avait dit à Abner, chef de l''armée: De qui ce jeune homme est-il fils, Abner? Abner répondit: Aussi vrai que ton âme est vivante, ô roi! je l''ignore.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን ወደ ፍልስጥኤማዊው ሲወጣ ባየው ጊዜ ለሠራዊቱ አለቃ ለአበኔር። አበኔር ሆይ፥ ይህ ብላቴና የማን ልጅ ነው? አለው። አበኔርም። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በሕያው ነፍስህ እምላለሁ! አላውቅም አለ።

verses.en: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
verses.fr: Informe-toi donc de qui ce jeune homme est fils, dit le roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ይህ ብላቴና የማን ልጅ እንደ ሆነ አንተ ጠይቅ አለ።

verses.en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
verses.fr: Et quand David fut de retour après avoir tué le Philistin, Abner le prit et le mena devant Saül. David avait à la main la tête du Philistin.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ፍልስጥኤማዊውን ገድሎ በተመለሰ ጊዜ አበኔር ወሰደው፥ ወደ ሳኦልም ፊት አመጣው፤ የፍልስጥኤማዊውንም ራስ በእጁ ይዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.
verses.fr: Saül lui dit: De qui es-tu fils, jeune homme? Et David répondit: Je suis fils de ton serviteur Isaï, Bethléhémite.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። አንተ ብላቴና፥ የማን ልጅ ነህ? አለው። ዳዊትም። እኔ የቤተ ልሔሙ የባሪያህ የእሴይ ልጅ ነኝ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.fr: David avait achevé de parler à Saül. Et dès lors l''âme de Jonathan fut attachée à l''âme de David, et Jonathan l''aima comme son âme.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ለሳኦል መናገሩን በፈጸመ ጊዜ የዮናታን ነፍስ በዳዊት ነፍስ ታሰረች፥ ዮናታንም እንደ ነፍሱ ወደደው።

verses.en: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.
verses.fr: Ce même jour Saül retint David, et ne le laissa pas retourner dans la maison de son père.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሳኦል ወሰደው፥ ወደ አባቱም ቤት ይመልሰው ዘንድ አልተወውም።

verses.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.fr: Jonathan fit alliance avec David, parce qu''il l''aimait comme son âme.
verses.am: ዮናታንም እንደ ነፍሱ ስለ ወደደው ከዳዊት ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
verses.fr: Il ôta le manteau qu''il portait, pour le donner à David; et il lui donna ses vêtements, même son épée, son arc et sa ceinture.
verses.am: ዮናታንም የለበሰውን ካባ አውልቆ እርሱንና ልብሱን ሰይፉንም ሸለመው። ዮናታንም የለበሰውን ካባ አውልቆ እርሱንና ልብሱን ሰይፉንም ቀስቱንም መታጠቂያውንም ለዳዊት ሸለመው።

verses.en: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.
verses.fr: David allait et réussissait partout où l''envoyait Saül; il fut mis par Saül à la tête des gens de guerre, et il plaisait à tout le peuple, même aux serviteurs de Saül.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሳኦል ወደ ሰደደው ሁሉ ይሄድ ነበር፥ አስተውሎም ያደርግ ነበር፤ ሳኦልም በጦረኞች ላይ ሾመው፤ ይህም በሕዝብ ሁሉ ዓይን እና በሳኦል ባሪያዎች ዓይን መልካም ነበረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
verses.fr: Comme ils revenaient, lors du retour de David après qu''il eut tué le Philistin, les femmes sortirent de toutes les villes d''Israël au-devant du roi Saül, en chantant et en dansant, au son des tambourins et des triangles, et en poussant des cris de joie.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማዊውን ገድሎ በተመለሰ ጊዜ፥ እየዘመሩና እየዘፈኑ እልልም እያሉ ከበሮና አታሞ ይዘው ንጉሡን ሳኦልን ሊቀበሉ ሴቶች ከእስራኤል ከተሞች ሁሉ ወጡ።

verses.en: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
verses.fr: Les femmes qui chantaient se répondaient les unes aux autres, et disaient: Saül a frappé ses mille, Et David ses dix mille.
verses.am: ሴቶችም። ሳኦል ሺህ፥ ዳዊትም እልፍ ገደለ እያሉ እየተቀባበሉ ይዘፍኑ ነበር።

verses.en: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
verses.fr: Saül fut très irrité, et cela lui déplut. Il dit: On en donne dix mille à David, et c''est à moi que l''on donne les mille! Il ne lui manque plus que la royauté.
verses.am: ሳኦልም እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ ይህም ነገር አስከፋው፤ እርሱም። ለዳዊት እልፍ ሰጡት፥ ለእኔ ግን ሺህ ብቻ ሰጡኝ፤ ከመንግሥት በቀር ምን ቀረበት? አለ።

verses.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
verses.fr: Et Saül regarda David d''un mauvais oeil, à partir de ce jour et dans la suite.
verses.am: ከዚያም ቀን ጀምሮ ሳኦል ዳዊትን ተመቅኝቶ ተመለከተው።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, le mauvais esprit de Dieu saisit Saül, qui eut des transports au milieu de la maison. David jouait, comme les autres jours, et Saül avait sa lance à la main.
verses.am: በነጋውም ሳኦልን ክፉ መንፈስ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያዘው፥ በቤቱም ውስጥ ትንቢት ተናገረ።ዳዊትም በየቀኑ ያደርግ እንደ ነበረ በእጁ በገና ይመታ ነበር። ሳኦልም ጦሩን በእጁ ይዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verses.fr: Saül leva sa lance, disant en lui-même: Je frapperai David contre la paroi. Mais David se détourna de lui deux fois.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። ዳዊትን ከግንቡ ጋር አጣብቄ እመታዋለሁ ብሎ ጦሩን ወረወረ። ዳዊትም ሁለት ጊዜ ከፊቱ ዘወር አለ።

verses.en: And Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him, and was departed from Saul.
verses.fr: Saül craignait la présence de David, parce que l''Eternel était avec David et s''était retiré de lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ስለ ነበረ ከሳኦልም ስለ ተለየ ሳኦል ዳዊትን ፈራው።

verses.en: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.fr: Il l''éloigna de sa personne, et il l''établit chef de mille hommes. David sortait et rentrait à la tête du peuple;
verses.am: ስለዚህም ሳኦል ከእርሱ አራቀው፥ የሺህ አለቃም አደረገው፤ በሕዝቡም ፊት ይወጣና ይገባ ነበር።

verses.en: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the Lord was with him.
verses.fr: il réussissait dans toutes ses entreprises, et l''Eternel était avec lui.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በአካሄዱ ሁሉ አስተውሎ ያደርግ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
verses.fr: Saül, voyant qu''il réussissait toujours, avait peur de lui;
verses.am: ሳኦልም እጅግ ብልህ እንደ ሆነ አይቶ እጅግ ፈራው።

verses.en: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
verses.fr: mais tout Israël et Juda aimaient David, parce qu''il sortait et rentrait à leur tête.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በፊታቸው ይወጣና ይገባ ስለ ነበረ እስራኤልና ይሁዳ ሁሉ ዳዊትን ወደዱ።

verses.en: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the Lord's battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.
verses.fr: Saül dit à David: Voici, je te donnerai pour femme ma fille aînée Mérab; sers-moi seulement avec vaillance, et soutiens les guerres de l''Eternel. Or Saül se disait: Je ne veux pas mettre la main sur lui, mais que la main des Philistins soit sur lui.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን። ታላቂቱ ልጄ ሜሮብ እነኋት፤ እርስዋን እድርልሃለሁ፤ ብቻ ቀልጣፋ ልጅ ሁንልኝ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔርም ጦርነት ተጋደል አለው። ሳኦልም። የፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ በእርሱ ላይ ትሁን እንጂ የእኔ እጅ በእርሱ ላይ አትሁን ይል ነበር።

verses.en: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?
verses.fr: David répondit à Saül: Qui suis-je, et qu''est-ce que ma vie, qu''est-ce que la famille de mon père en Israël, pour que je devienne le gendre du roi?
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሳኦልን። ለንጉሥ አማች እሆን ዘንድ እኔ ማን ነኝ? ሰውነቴስ ምንድር ናት? የአባቴስ ወገን በእስራኤል ዘንድ ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.en: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
verses.fr: Lorsque arriva le temps où Mérab, fille de Saül, devait être donnée à David, elle fut donnée pour femme à Adriel, de Mehola.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሳኦል ልጅ ሜሮብ ዳዊትን የምታገባበት ጊዜ ሲደርስ ለመሓላታዊው ለኤስድሪኤል ተዳረች።

verses.en: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.fr: Mical, fille de Saül, aima David. On en informa Saül, et la chose lui convint.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ልጅ ሜልኮል ዳዊትን ወደደች፤ ይህም ወሬ ለሳኦል ደረሰለት፥ ነገሩም ደስ አሰኘው።

verses.en: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
verses.fr: Il se disait: Je la lui donnerai, afin qu''elle soit un piège pour lui, et qu''il tombe sous la main des Philistins. Et Saül dit à David pour la seconde fois: Tu vas aujourd''hui devenir mon gendre.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። ወጥመድ ትሆነው ዘንድ፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም እጅ በእርሱ ላይ ትሆን ዘንድ እርስዋን እድርለታለሁ አለ፤ ሳኦልም ዳዊትን። ዛሬ ሁለተኛ አማች ትሆነኛለህ አለው።

verses.en: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.
verses.fr: Saül donna cet ordre à ses serviteurs: Parlez en confidence à David, et dites-lui: Voici, le roi est bien disposé pour toi, et tous ses serviteurs t''aiment; sois maintenant le gendre du roi.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ባሪያዎቹን። እነሆ፥ ንጉሥ እጅግ ወድዶሃል፥ ባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ ወድደውሃል፥ አሁንም ለንጉሥ አማች ሁን ብላችሁ በስውር ለዳዊት ንገሩት ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king's son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
verses.fr: Les serviteurs de Saül répétèrent ces paroles aux oreilles de David. Et David répondit: Croyez-vous qu''il soit facile de devenir le gendre du roi? Moi, je suis un homme pauvre et de peu d''importance.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ባሪያዎች ይህን ቃል በዳዊት ጆሮ ተናገሩ፤ ዳዊትም። እኔ ድሀ የተጠቃሁም ሰው ስሆን ለንጉሥ አማች እሆን ዘንድ ለእናንተ ትንሽ ነገር ይመስላችኋልን? አለ።

verses.en: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs de Saül lui rapportèrent ce qu''avait répondu David.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ባሪያዎች። ዳዊት እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.fr: Saül dit: Vous parlerez ainsi à David: Le roi ne demande point de dot; mais il désire cent prépuces de Philistins, pour être vengé de ses ennemis. Saül avait le dessein de faire tomber David entre les mains des Philistins.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን በፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ ይጥለው ዘንድ አስቦ። የንጉሥን ጠላቶች ይበቀል ዘንድ ከመቶ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ሸለፈት በቀር ንጉሥ ማጫ አይሻም ብላችሁ ለዳዊት ንገሩት አላቸው።

verses.en: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs de Saül rapportèrent ces paroles à David, et David agréa ce qui lui était demandé pour qu''il devînt gendre du roi. Avant le terme fixé,
verses.am: የሳኦልም ባሪያዎች ይህን ቃል ለዳዊት ነገሩት፥ ለንጉሥም አማች ይሆን ዘንድ ዳዊትን ደስ አሰኘው።

verses.en: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
verses.fr: David se leva, partit avec ses gens, et tua deux cents hommes parmi les Philistins; il apporta leurs prépuces, et en livra au roi le nombre complet, afin de devenir gendre du roi. Alors Saül lui donna pour femme Mical, sa fille.
verses.am: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ተነሥተው ሄዱ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም መቶ ሰዎች ገደሉ፤ ዳዊትም ለንጉሥ አማች ይሆን ዘንድ ሰለባቸውን አምጥቶ በቍጥራቸው ልክ ለንጉሡ ሰጠ። ሳኦልም ልጁን ሜልኮልን ዳረለት።

verses.en: And Saul saw and knew that the Lord was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.
verses.fr: Saül vit et comprit que l''Eternel était avec David; et Mical, sa fille, aimait David.
verses.am: ሳኦልም እግዚአብሔር ከዳዊት ጋር እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ወደዱት።

verses.en: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.
verses.fr: Saül craignit de plus en plus David, et il fut toute sa vie son ennemi.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን አጥብቆ ፈራው፤ ሳኦልም ዕድሜውን ሁሉ ለዳዊት ጠላት ሆነ።

verses.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.
verses.fr: Les princes des Philistins faisaient des excursions; et chaque fois qu''ils sortaient, David avait plus de succès que tous les serviteurs de Saül, et son nom devint très célèbre.
verses.am: የፍልስጥኤማውያንም አለቆች ይወጡ ነበር፤ በወጡም ጊዜ ሁሉ ከሳኦል ባሪያዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ ዳዊት አስተውሎ ያደርግ ነበርና ስሙ እጅግ ተጠርቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
verses.fr: Saül parla à Jonathan, son fils, et à tous ses serviteurs, de faire mourir David.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ለልጁ ለዮናታንና ለባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ ዳዊትን ይገድሉ ዘንድ ነገራቸው። የሳኦል ልጅ ዮናታን ግን ዳዊትን እጅግ ይወድድ ነበር።

verses.en: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:
verses.fr: Mais Jonathan, fils de Saül, qui avait une grande affection pour David, l''en informa et lui dit: Saül, mon père, cherche à te faire mourir. Sois donc sur tes gardes demain matin, reste dans un lieu retiré, et cache-toi.
verses.am: ዮናታንም። አባቴ ሳኦል ሊገድልህ ፈልጎአል፤ አሁን እንግዲህ ለነገው ተጠንቅቀህ ተሸሸግ፥ በስውርም ተቀመጥ፤

verses.en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.
verses.fr: Je sortirai et je me tiendrai à côté de mon père dans le champ où tu seras; je parlerai de toi à mon père, je verrai ce qu''il dira, et je te le rapporterai.
verses.am: እኔም እወጣለሁ አንተም ባለህበት እርሻ በአባቴ አጠገብ እቆማለሁ፥ ስለ አንተም ከአባቴ ጋር እነጋገራለሁ፤ የሆነውንም አይቼ እነግርሃለሁ ብሎ ለዳዊት ነገረው።

verses.en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:
verses.fr: Jonathan parla favorablement de David à Saül, son père: Que le roi, dit-il, ne commette pas un péché à l''égard de son serviteur David, car il n''en a point commis envers toi. Au contraire, il a agi pour ton bien;
verses.am: ዮናታንም ለአባቱ ለሳኦል። እርሱ አልበደለህምና። ሥራውም ለአንተ እጅግ መልካም ሆኖአልና ንጉሡ ባሪያውን ዳዊትን አይበድለው፤

verses.en: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the Lord wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
verses.fr: il a exposé sa vie, il a tué le Philistin, et l''Eternel a opéré une grande délivrance pour tout Israël. Tu l''as vu, et tu t''en es réjoui. Pourquoi pécherais-tu contre le sang innocent, et ferais-tu sans raison mourir David?
verses.am: ነፍሱንም በእጁ ጥሎ ፍልስጥኤማዊውን ገደለ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለእስራኤል ሁሉ ታላቅ መድኃኒት አደረገ፤ አንተም አይተህ ደስ አለህ፤ በከንቱ ዳዊትን በመግደልህ ስለምን በንጹሕ ደም ላይ ትበድላለህ? ብሎ ስለ ዳዊት መልካም ተናገረ።

verses.en: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the Lord liveth, he shall not be slain.
verses.fr: Saül écouta la voix de Jonathan, et il jura, disant: L''Eternel est vivant! David ne mourra pas.
verses.am: ሳኦልም የዮናታንን ቃል ሰማ፤ ሳኦልም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ዳዊት አይገደልም ብሎ ማለ።

verses.en: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.
verses.fr: Jonathan appela David, et lui rapporta toutes ces paroles; puis il l''amena auprès de Saül, en présence de qui David fut comme auparavant.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ዳዊትን ጠርቶ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ነገረው፤ ዮናታንም ዳዊትን ወደ ሳኦል አመጣው፥ እንደ ቀድሞውም በፊቱ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
verses.fr: La guerre continuait. David marcha contre les Philistins, et se battit avec eux; il leur fit éprouver une grande défaite, et ils s''enfuirent devant lui.
verses.am: ደግሞም ጦርነት ሆነ፤ ዳዊትም ወጥቶ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ተዋጋ፥ ታላቅ ግዳይም ገደላቸው፥ ከፊቱም ሸሹ።

verses.en: And the evil spirit from the Lord was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
verses.fr: Alors le mauvais esprit de l''Eternel fut sur Saül, qui était assis dans sa maison, sa lance à la main. David jouait,
verses.am: ሳኦልም ጦሩን ይዞ በቤቱ ተቀምጦ ሳለ ክፉ መንፈስ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያዘው። ዳዊትም በእጁ በገና ይመታ ነበር።

verses.en: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin: but he slipped away out of Saul's presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.
verses.fr: et Saül voulut le frapper avec sa lance contre la paroi. Mais David se détourna de lui, et Saül frappa de sa lance la paroi. David prit la fuite et s''échappa pendant la nuit.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን ከግንብ ጋር ያጣብቀው ዘንድ ጦሩን ወረወረ፤ ዳዊትም ከሳኦል ፊት ዘወር አለ፥ ጦሩም በግንቡ ውስጥ ተተከለ፤ በዚያም ሌሊት ዳዊት ሸሽቶ አመለጠ።

verses.en: Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.
verses.fr: Saül envoya des gens vers la maison de David, pour le garder et le faire mourir au matin. Mais Mical, femme de David, l''en informa et lui dit: Si tu ne te sauves pas cette nuit, demain tu es mort.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን ጠብቀው በነጋው እንዲገድሉት መልእክተኞቹን ወደ ዳዊት ቤት ላከ፤ ሚስቱም ሜልኮል። በዚህች ሌሊት ነፍስህን ካላዳንህ ነገ ትገደላለህ ብላ ነገረችው።

verses.en: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.
verses.fr: Elle le fit descendre par la fenêtre, et David s''en alla et s''enfuit. C''est ainsi qu''il échappa.
verses.am: ሜልኮልም ዳዊትን በመስኮት አወረደችው፤ ሄደም፥ ሸሽቶም አመለጠ።

verses.en: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
verses.fr: Ensuite Mical prit le théraphim, qu''elle plaça dans le lit; elle mit une peau de chèvre à son chevet, et elle l''enveloppa d''une couverture.
verses.am: ሜልኮልም ተራፊምን ወስዳ በአልጋ ላይ አኖረችው፥ በራስጌውም ጕንጕን የፍየል ጠጉር አደረገች፥ በልብስም ከደነችው።

verses.en: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
verses.fr: Lorsque Saül envoya des gens pour prendre David, elle dit: Il est malade.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን እንዲያመጡት መልእክተኞችን ላከ፥ እርስዋም። ታምሞአል አለቻቸው።

verses.en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
verses.fr: Saül les renvoya pour qu''ils le vissent, et il dit: Apportez-le-moi dans son lit, afin que je le fasse mourir.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። እገድለው ዘንድ ዳዊትን ከነ አልጋው አምጡልኝ ብሎ መልእክተኞቹን ወደ ዳዊት ሰደደ።

verses.en: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster.
verses.fr: Ces gens revinrent, et voici, le théraphim était dans le lit, et une peau de chèvre à son chevet.
verses.am: መልእክተኞቹም በገቡ ጊዜ እነሆ፥ ተራፊሙን በአልጋው ላይ አገኙ፥ በራስጌውም ጕንጕን የፍየል ጠጉር ነበረ።

verses.en: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
verses.fr: Saül dit à Mical: Pourquoi m''as-tu trompé de la sorte, et as-tu laissé partir mon ennemi qui s''est échappé? Mical répondit à Saül: Il m''a dit: Laisse moi aller, ou je te tue!
verses.am: ሳኦልም ሜልኮልን። ስለ ምን እንዲህ አድርገሽ አታለልሽኝ? ጠላቴን አስኰበለልሽው አላት። ሜልኮልም ለሳኦል። እርሱ። አውጥተሽ ስደጂኝ፥ አለዚያም እገድልሻለሁ አለኝ ብላ መለሰችለት።

verses.en: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que David prit la fuite et qu''il échappa. Il se rendit auprès de Samuel à Rama, et lui raconta tout ce que Saül lui avait fait. Puis il alla avec Samuel demeurer à Najoth.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሸሽቶ አመለጠ፥ ወደ አርማቴምም ወደ ሳሙኤል መጣ፥ ሳኦልም ያደረገበትን ሁሉ ነገረው፤ እርሱና ሳሙኤልም ሄዱ በነዋትዘራማም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.fr: On le rapporta à Saül, en disant: Voici, David est à Najoth, près de Rama.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። ዳዊት፥ እነሆ፥ በአርማቴም አገር በነዋትዘራማ ተቀምጦአል የሚል ወሬ ሰማ።

verses.en: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.fr: Saül envoya des gens pour prendre David. Ils virent une assemblée de prophètes qui prophétisaient, ayant Samuel à leur tête. L''esprit de Dieu saisit les envoyés de Saül, et ils se mirent aussi à prophétiser eux-mêmes.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን ያመጡት ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን ሰደደ፤ የነቢያት ጉባኤ ትንቢት ሲናገሩ፥ ሳሙኤልም አለቃቸው ሆኖ ሲቆም ባዩ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በሳኦል መልእክተኞች ላይ ወረደ፥ እነርሱም ትንቢት ይናገሩ ጀምር።

verses.en: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
verses.fr: On en fit rapport à Saül, qui envoya d''autres gens, et eux aussi prophétisèrent. Il en envoya encore pour la troisième fois, et ils prophétisèrent également.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ያንን በሰማ ጊዜ ሌሎች መልእክተኞችን ሰደደ፥ እነርሱም ደግሞ ትንቢት ተናገሩ። ሳኦልም እንደ ገና ሦስተኛ ጊዜ መልእክተኞችን ሰደደ፥ እነርሱም ደግሞ ትንቢት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.fr: Alors Saül alla lui-même à Rama. Arrivé à la grande citerne qui est à Sécou, il demanda: Où sont Samuel et David? On lui répondit: Ils sont à Najoth, près de Rama.
verses.am: የሳኦልም ቍጣ ነደደ፥ እርሱም ደግሞ ወደ አርማቴም መጣ፥ በሤኩም ወዳለው ወደ ታላቁ የውኃ ጕድጓድ ደረሰ። ሳሙኤልና ዳዊት የት ናቸው? ብሎ ጠየቀ፤ አንድ ሰውም። እነሆ፥ በአርማቴም አገር በነዋትዘራማ ናቸው አለው።

verses.en: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.fr: Et il se dirigea vers Najoth, près de Rama. L''esprit de Dieu fut aussi sur lui; et Saül continua son chemin en prophétisant, jusqu''à son arrivée à Najoth, près de Rama.
verses.am: ወደ አርማቴምም አገር ወደ ነዋትዘራማ ሄደ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በእርሱ ደግሞ ወረደ፥ እርሱም ሄደ፥ ወደ አርማቴምም አገር ወደ ነዋትዘራማ እስኪመጣ ድረስ ትንቢት ይናገር ነበር።

verses.en: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.fr: Il ôta ses vêtements, et il prophétisa aussi devant Samuel; et il se jeta nu par terre tout ce jour-là et toute la nuit. C''est pourquoi l''on dit: Saül est-il aussi parmi les prophètes?
verses.am: ልብሱንም አወለቀ፥ በሳሙኤልም ፊት ትንቢት ተናገረ፥ ራቁቱንም ወድቆ በዚያ ቀን ሁሉ በዚያም ሌሊት ሁሉ ተጋደመ። ስለዚህ። ሳኦል ደግሞ ከነቢያት መካከል ነውን? ይባባሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
verses.fr: David s''enfuit de Najoth, près de Rama. Il alla trouver Jonathan, et dit: Qu''ai-je fait? quel est mon crime, quel est mon péché aux yeux de ton père, pour qu''il en veuille à ma vie?
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከአርማቴም አገር ከነዋትዘራማ ሸሸ፥ ወደ ዮናታንም መጥቶ። ምን አደረግሁ? እኔንስ ለመግደል የሚፈልግ በአባትህ ፊት ጠማምነቴና ኃጢአቴ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
verses.fr: Jonathan lui répondit: Loin de là! tu ne mourras point. Mon père ne fait aucune chose, grande ou petite, sans m''en informer; pourquoi donc mon père me cacherait-il celle-là? Il n''en est rien.
verses.am: ዮናታንም። ይህንስ ያርቀው፥ አትሞትም፤ እነሆ፥ አባቴ አስቀድሞ ለእኔ ሳይገልጥ ትልቅም ትንሽም ነገር ቢሆን አያደርግም፤ አባቴስ ይህን ነገር ለምን ይሰውረኛል? እንዲህ አይደለም አለው።

verses.en: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
verses.fr: David dit encore, en jurant: Ton père sait bien que j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, et il aura dit: Que Jonathan ne le sache pas; cela lui ferait de la peine. Mais l''Eternel est vivant et ton âme est vivante! il n''y a qu''un pas entre moi et la mort.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። እኔ በፊትህ ሞገስ እንዳገኘሁ አባትህ በእውነት ያውቃል፤ እርሱም። ዮናታን እንዳይከፋው አይወቅ ይላል፤ ነገር ግን ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ! በእኔና በሞት መካከል አንድ እርምጃ ያህል ቀርቶአል ብሎ ማለ።

verses.en: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
verses.fr: Jonathan dit à David: Je ferai pour toi ce que tu voudras.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ዳዊትን። ነፍስህ የወደደችውን ሁሉ አደርግልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
verses.fr: Et David lui répondit: Voici, c''est demain la nouvelle lune, et je devrais m''asseoir avec le roi pour manger; laisse-moi aller, et je me cacherai dans les champs jusqu''au soir du troisième jour.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ዮናታንን አለው። እነሆ፥ ነገ መባቻ ነው፤ በንጉሥም አጠገብ ለምሳ አልቀመጥም፤ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን ማታ ድረስ በውጭ በሜዳ እንድሸሸግ አሰናብተኝ።

verses.en: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
verses.fr: Si ton père remarque mon absence, tu diras: David m''a prié de lui laisser faire une course à Bethléhem, sa ville, parce qu''il y a pour toute la famille un sacrifice annuel.
verses.am: አባትህም ቢፈልገኝ። ለዘመዶቹ ሁሉ በዚያ በቤተ ልሔም የዓመት መሥዋዕት አላቸውና ዳዊት ወደ ከተማው ፈጥኖ ይሄድ ዘንድ አጽንቶ ለምኖኛል በለው።

verses.en: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
verses.fr: Et s''il dit: C''est bien! ton serviteur alors n''a rien à craindre; mais si la colère s''empare de lui, sache que le mal est résolu de sa part.
verses.am: እርሱም። መልካም ነው ቢል ለእኔ ለባሪያህ ደኅንነት ይሆናል፤ ቢቈጣ ግን ክፋት ከእርሱ ዘንድ በእኔ ላይ እንደ ተቈረጠች እወቅ።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the Lord with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
verses.fr: Montre donc ton affection pour ton serviteur, puisque tu as fait avec ton serviteur une alliance devant l''Eternel. Et, s''il y a quelque crime en moi, ôte-moi la vie toi-même, car pourquoi me mènerais-tu jusqu''à ton père?
verses.am: እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ከባሪያህ ጋር አድርገሃልና ለባሪያህ ቸርነት አድርግ፤ በደል ግን ቢገኝብኝ አንተ ግደለኝ፤ ለምን ወደ አባትህ ታደርሰኛለህ?

verses.en: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
verses.fr: Jonathan lui dit: Loin de toi la pensée que je ne t''informerai pas, si j''apprends que le mal est résolu de la part de mon père et menace de t''atteindre!
verses.am: ዮናታንም። ይህ ከአንተ ይራቅ፤ ከአባቴ ዘንድ ክፋት በላይህ እንደ ተቈጠረች ያወቅሁ እንደ ሆነ አልነግርህምን? አለ።

verses.en: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
verses.fr: David dit à Jonathan: Qui m''informera dans le cas où ton père te répondrait durement?
verses.am: ዳዊትም ዮናታንን። አባትህ ስለ እኔ ክፉ ነገር የነገረህ እንደ ሆን ማን ይነግረኛል? አለው።

verses.en: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
verses.fr: Et Jonathan dit à David: Viens, sortons dans les champs. Et ils sortirent tous deux dans les champs.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ዳዊትን። ና ወደ ሜዳ እንውጣ አለው። ሁለቱም ወደ ሜዳ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Jonathan said unto David, O Lord God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
verses.fr: Jonathan dit à David: Je prends à témoin l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël! Je sonderai mon père demain ou après-demain; et, dans le cas où il serait bien disposé pour David, si je n''envoie vers toi personne pour t''en informer,
verses.am: ዮናታንም ዳዊትን አለው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ምስክር ይሁን፤ ነገ ወይም ከነገ ወዲያ በዚህ ጊዜ አባቴን መርምሬ፥ እነሆ፥ በዳዊት ላይ መልካም ቢያስብ ልኬ እገልጥልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: The Lord do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the Lord be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
verses.fr: que l''Eternel traite Jonathan dans toute sa rigueur! Dans le cas où mon père trouverait bon de te faire du mal, je t''informerai aussi et je te laisserai partir, afin que tu t''en ailles en paix; et que l''Eternel soit avec toi, comme il a été avec mon père!
verses.am: አባቴም በአንተ ላይ ክፋት ማድረግ ቢወድድ እኔም ባላስታውቅህ በደህና ትሄድ ዘንድ ባላሰናብትህ፥ እግዚአብሔር በዮናታን ይህን ያድርግ ይህንም ይጨምር፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከአባቴ ጋር እንደ ነበረ ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the Lord, that I die not:
verses.fr: Si je dois vivre encore, veuille user envers moi de la bonté de l''Eternel; et si je meurs,
verses.am: እኔም እንዳልሞት በሕይወቴ ዘመን የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነት አድርግልኝ፤

verses.en: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the Lord hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.fr: ne retire jamais ta bonté envers ma maison, pas même lorsque l''Eternel retranchera chacun des ennemis de David de dessus la face de la terre.
verses.am: ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር የዳዊትን ጠላቶች ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ከምድር ባጠፋቸው ጊዜ ለዘላለም ቸርነትህን ከቤቴ አታርቀው።

verses.en: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the Lord even require it at the hand of David's enemies.
verses.fr: Car Jonathan a fait alliance avec la maison de David. Que l''Eternel tire vengeance des ennemis de David!
verses.am: ዮናታንም። እግዚአብሔር ከዳዊት ጠላቶች እጅ ይፈልገው ብሎ ከዳዊት ቤት ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.fr: Jonathan protesta encore auprès de David de son affection pour lui, car il l''aimait comme son âme.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ዳዊትን እንደ ነፍሱ ይወድድ ነበርና እንደ ገና ማለለት።

verses.en: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
verses.fr: Jonathan lui dit: C''est demain la nouvelle lune; on remarquera ton absence, car ta place sera vide.
verses.am: ዮናታንም አለው። ነገ መባቻ ነው፥ መቀመጫህም ባዶ ሆኖ ይገኛልና ትታሰባለህ።

verses.en: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.fr: Tu descendras le troisième jour jusqu''au fond du lieu où tu t''étais caché le jour de l''affaire, et tu resteras près de la pierre d''Ezel.
verses.am: ሦስት ቀንም ያህል ቆይ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ ፈጥነህ ውረድ፥ ነገሩም በተደረገበት ቀን ወደ ተሸሸግህበት ስፍራ ሂድ፥ በኤዜል ድንጋይም አጠገብ ቆይ።

verses.en: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.fr: Je tirerai trois flèches du côté de la pierre, comme si je visais un but.
verses.am: እኔም በዓላማ ላይ እወረውራለሁ ብዬ ሦስት ፍላጻዎችን ወደ አጠገቡ እወረውራለሁ።

verses.en: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the Lord liveth.
verses.fr: Et voici, j''enverrai un jeune homme, et je lui dirai: Va, trouve les flèches. Si je lui dis: Voici, les flèches sont en deçà de toi, prends-les! alors viens, car il y a paix pour toi, et tu n''as rien à craindre, l''Eternel est vivant!
verses.am: እነሆም። ሂድ ፍላጻዎችን ፈልግ ብዬ ብላቴናውን እልከዋለሁ፤ ብላቴናውንም። እነሆ፥ ፍላጻው ከአንተ ወደዚህ ነው፤ ይዘኸው ወደ እኔ ና ያልሁት እንደ ሆነ፥ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ለአንተ ደኅንነት ነውና ምንም የለብህም።

verses.en: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the Lord hath sent thee away.
verses.fr: Mais si je dis au jeune homme: Voici, les flèches sont au delà de toi! alors va-t-en, car l''Eternel te renvoie.
verses.am: ብላቴናውን ግን። እነሆ፥ ፍላጻው ከአንተ ወዲያ ነው ያልሁት እንደ ሆነ፥ እግዚአብሔር አሰናብቶሃልና መንገድህን ሂድ።

verses.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the Lord be between thee and me for ever.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est à jamais témoin de la parole que nous nous sommes donnée l''un à l''autre.
verses.am: አንተና እኔም ስለ ተነጋገርነው፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም በመካከላችን ምስክር ነው።

verses.en: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
verses.fr: David se cacha dans les champs. C''était la nouvelle lune, et le roi prit place au festin pour manger.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በሜዳው ተሸሸገ፤ መባቻም በሆነ ጊዜ ንጉሡ ግብር ለመብላት ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.
verses.fr: Le roi s''assit comme à l''ordinaire sur son siège contre la paroi, Jonathan se leva, et Abner s''assit à côté de Saül; mais la place de David resta vide.
verses.am: ንጉሡም እንደ ቀድሞው በግንቡ አጠገብ በዙፋኑ ላይ ተቀመጠ፤ ዮናታንም ቆሞ ነበር፥ አበኔርም በሳኦል አጠገብ ተቀመጠ፤ የዳዊትም ስፍራ ባዶውን ነበረ።

verses.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.fr: Saül ne dit rien ce jour-là; car, pensa-t-il, c''est par hasard, il n''est pas pur, certainement il n''est pas pur.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። አንድ ነገር ሆኖአል፥ ንጹሕም አይደለም፤ በእውነት ንጹሕ አይደለም ብሎ አስቦአልና በዚያን ቀን ምንም አልተናገረም።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
verses.fr: Le lendemain, second jour de la nouvelle lune, la place de David était encore vide. Et Saül dit à Jonathan, son fils: Pourquoi le fils d''Isaï n''a-t-il paru au repas ni hier ni aujourd''hui?
verses.am: ከመባቻም በኋላ በማግሥቱ በሁለተኛው ቀን የዳዊት ስፍራ ባዶውን ነበረ፤ ሳኦልም ልጁን ዮናታንን። የእሴይ ልጅ ትናንትና ወይም ዛሬ ግብር ሊበላ ያልመጣ ስለ ምን ነው? አለው።

verses.en: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:
verses.fr: Jonathan répondit à Saül: David m''a demandé la permission d''aller à Bethléhem.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ለሳኦል። ዳዊት ወደ ቤተ ልሔም ይሄድ ዘንድ አጽንቶ ለመነኝ፤

verses.en: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.
verses.fr: Il a dit: Laisse-moi aller, je te prie, car nous avons dans la ville un sacrifice de famille, et mon frère me l''a fait savoir; si donc j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, permets que j''aille en hâte voir mes frères. C''est pour cela qu''il n''est point venu à la table du roi.
verses.am: እርሱም። ዘመዶቼ በከተማ ውስጥ መሥዋዕት አላቸውና፥ ወንድሜም ጠርቶኛልና እባክህ፥ አሰናብተኝ፤ አሁንም በዓይኖችህ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ ልሂድና ወንድሞቼን ልይ አለ፤ ስለዚህ ወደ ንጉሥ ሰደቃ አልመጣም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?
verses.fr: Alors la colère de Saül s''enflamma contre Jonathan, et il lui dit: Fils pervers et rebelle, ne sais je pas que tu as pour ami le fils d''Isaï, à ta honte et à la honte de ta mère?
verses.am: የሳኦልም ቍጣ በዮናታን ላይ ነደደና። አንተ የጠማማ ሴት ልጅ፥ የእሴይን ልጅ ለአንተ ማፈርያ ለእናትህም ኀፍረተ ሥጋ ማፈርያ እንደ መረጥህ እኔ አላውቅምን?

verses.en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.fr: Car aussi longtemps que le fils d''Isaï sera vivant sur la terre, il n''y aura point de sécurité ni pour toi ni pour ta royauté. Et maintenant, envoie-le chercher, et qu''on me l''amène, car il est digne de mort.
verses.am: የእሴይም ልጅ በምድር ላይ በሕይወት በሚኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ አንተና መንግሥትህ አትጸኑም፤ አሁንም የሞት ልጅ ነውና ልከህ አስመጣልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
verses.fr: Jonathan répondit à Saül, son père, et lui dit: Pourquoi le ferait-on mourir? Qu''a-t-il fait?
verses.am: ዮናታንም ለአባቱ ለሳኦል። ስለ ምን ይሞታል? ያደረገውስ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
verses.fr: Et Saül dirigea sa lance contre lui, pour le frapper. Jonathan comprit que c''était chose résolue chez son père que de faire mourir David.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ሊወጋው ጦሩን ወረወረበት፤ ዮናታንም አባቱ ዳዊትን ፈጽሞ ሊገድለው እንደ ፈቀደ አወቀ።

verses.en: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.fr: Il se leva de table dans une ardente colère, et ne participa point au repas le second jour de la nouvelle lune; car il était affligé à cause de David, parce que son père l''avait outragé.
verses.am: አባቱ ዳዊትን ስላሳፈረው ዮናታን ስለ ዳዊት አዝኖአልና እጅግ ተቈጥቶ ከሰደቃው ተነሣ፥ በመባቻውም በሁለተኛ ቀን ግብር አልበላም።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.fr: Le lendemain matin, Jonathan alla dans les champs au lieu convenu avec David, et il était accompagné d''un petit garçon.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በነጋው ዮናታን ከዳዊት ጋር ወደ ተቃጠረበት ቦታ ወደ ሜዳ ወጣ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ታናሽ ብላቴና ነበረ።

verses.en: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Cours, trouve les flèches que je vais tirer. Le garçon courut, et Jonathan tira une flèche qui le dépassa.
verses.am: ብላቴናውንም። ሮጠህ የምወረውራቸውን ፍላጻዎች ፈልግልኝ አለው። ብላቴናውም በሮጠ ጊዜ ፍላጻውን ወደ ማዶ ወረወረው።

verses.en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il arriva au lieu où était la flèche que Jonathan avait tirée, Jonathan cria derrière lui: La flèche n''est-elle pas plus loin que toi?
verses.am: ብላቴናውም ዮናታን ፍላጻውን ወደ ወረወረበት ስፍራ በመጣ ጊዜ ዮናታን። ፍላጻው ከአንተ ወዲያ ነው ብሎ ወደ ብላቴናው ጮኸ።

verses.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
