verses.fr: Il lui cria encore: Vite, hâte-toi, ne t''arrête pas! Et le garçon de Jonathan ramassa les flèches et revint vers son maître.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ደግሞ። ቶሎ ፍጠን፥ አትቆይ ብሎ ወደ ብላቴናው ጮኸ፤ የዮናታንም ብላቴና ፍላጻዎቹን ሰብስቦ ወደ ጌታው መጣ።

verses.en: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.fr: Le garçon ne savait rien; Jonathan et David seuls comprenaient la chose.
verses.am: ዮናታንና ዳዊት ብቻ ነገሩን ያውቁ ነበር እንጂ ብላቴናው ምንም አያውቅም ነበር።

verses.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.fr: Jonathan remit ses armes à son garçon, et lui dit: Va, porte-les à la ville.
verses.am: ዮናታንም መሣርያውን ለብላቴናው ሰጥቶ። ወደ ከተማ ውሰድ አለው።

verses.en: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.fr: Après le départ du garçon, David se leva du côté du midi, puis se jeta le visage contre terre et se prosterna trois fois. Les deux amis s''embrassèrent et pleurèrent ensemble, David surtout fondit en larmes.
verses.am: ብላቴናውም በሄደ ጊዜ ዳዊት ከስፍራው በደቡብ አጠገብ ተነሣ፥ በምድርም ላይ በግምባሩ ተደፋ፥ ሦስት ጊዜም ለሰላምታ ሰገደ፤ እየተላቀሱም እርስ በእርሳቸው ተሳሳሙ፥ ይልቁንም ዳዊት እጅግ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.fr: Et Jonathan dit à David: Va en paix, maintenant que nous avons juré l''un et l''autre, au nom de l''Eternel, en disant: Que l''Eternel soit à jamais entre moi et toi, entre ma postérité et ta postérité! David se leva, et s''en alla, et Jonathan rentra dans la ville.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ዳዊትን። በደኅና ሂድ፤ እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁለታችን በእኔና በአንተ፥ በዘሬና በዘርህ መካከል ለዘላለም እግዚአብሔር ይሁን ብለን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ተማምለናል አለው። ዳዊትም ተነሥቶ ሄደ፤ ዮናታንም ወደ ከተማ ገባ።

verses.en: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
verses.fr: David se rendit à Nob, vers le sacrificateur Achimélec, qui accourut effrayé au-devant de lui et lui dit: Pourquoi es-tu seul et n''y a-t-il personne avec toi?
verses.am: ዳዊትም ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አቢሜሌክ ወደ ኖብ መጣ፤ አቢሜሌክም እየተንቀጠቀጠ ዳዊትን ሊገናኘው መጣና። ስለ ምን አንተ ብቻህን ነህ? ከአንተስ ጋር ስለ ምን ማንም የለም? አለው።

verses.en: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.
verses.fr: David répondit au sacrificateur Achimélec: Le roi m''a donné un ordre et m''a dit: Que personne ne sache rien de l''affaire pour laquelle je t''envoie et de l''ordre que je t''ai donné. J''ai fixé un rendez-vous à mes gens.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ካህኑን አቢሜሌክን። የተላክህበትን ነገርና የሰጠሁህን ትእዛዝ ማንም አይወቅ ብሎ ንጉሡ አንድ ነገር አዝዞኛል፤ ስለዚህም ብላቴኖቹን እንዲህ ባለ ስፍራ ተውኋቸው።

verses.en: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
verses.fr: Maintenant qu''as-tu sous la main? Donne-moi cinq pains, ou ce qui se trouvera.
verses.am: አሁንስ በእጅህ ምን አለ? አምስት እንጀራ ወይም የተገኘውን በእጄ ስጠኝ አለው።

verses.en: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur répondit à David: Je n''ai pas de pain ordinaire sous la main, mais il y a du pain consacré; si du moins tes gens se sont abstenus de femmes!
verses.am: ካህኑም ለዳዊት መልሶ። ሁሉ የሚበላው እንጀራ የለኝም፥ ነገር ግን የተቀደስ እንጀራ አለ፤ ብላቴኖቹ ከሴቶቹ ንጹሐን እንደ ሆኑ መብላት ይቻላል አለው።

verses.en: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.
verses.fr: David répondit au sacrificateur: Nous nous sommes abstenus de femmes depuis trois jours que je suis parti, et tous mes gens sont purs: d''ailleurs, si c''est là un acte profane, il sera certainement aujourd''hui sanctifié par celui qui en sera l''instrument.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ለካህኑ መልሶ። በእውነት ከወጣን ጀምረን እኛ ሰውነታችንን ከሴቶች ሦስት ቀን ጠብቀናል፤ የብላቴኖችም ዕቃ የተቀደሰች ናት፤ ስለዚህ ዛሬ ዕቃቸው የተቀደሰች በመሆንዋ እንጀራው እንደሚበላ እንጀራ ይሆናል አለው።

verses.en: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the Lord, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
verses.fr: Alors le sacrificateur lui donna du pain consacré, car il n''y avait là d''autre pain que du pain de proposition, qu''on avait ôté de devant l''Eternel pour le remplacer par du pain chaud au moment où on l''avait pris.
verses.am: ካህኑም በእርሱ ፋንታ ትኩስ እንጀራ ይደረግ ዘንድ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ከተነሣው ከገጹ ኅብስት በቀር ሌላ እንጀራ አልነበረምና የተቀደሰውን እንጀራ ሰጠው።

verses.en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.
verses.fr: Là, ce même jour, un homme d''entre les serviteurs de Saül se trouvait enfermé devant l''Eternel; c''était un Edomite, nommé Doëg, chef des bergers de Saül.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ከሳኦል ባሪያዎች አንድ ሰው በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ተገኝቶ ነበር፤ ስሙም ኤዶማዊው ዶይቅ ነበረ፥ ለሳኦልም የእረኞቹ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.
verses.fr: David dit à Achimélec: N''as-tu pas sous la main une lance ou une épée? car je n''ai pris avec moi ni mon épée ni mes armes, parce que l''ordre du roi était pressant.
verses.am: ዳዊትም አቢሜሌክን። የንጉሥ ጉዳይ ስላስቸኰለኝ ሰይፌንና መሣሪያዬን አላመጣሁምና በአንተ ዘንድ ጦር ወይም ሰይፍ አለ ወይ? አለው።

verses.en: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur répondit: Voici l''épée de Goliath, le Philistin, que tu as tué dans la vallée des térébinthes; elle est enveloppée dans un drap, derrière l''éphod; si tu veux la prendre, prends-la, car il n''y en a pas d''autre ici. Et David dit: Il n''y en a point de pareille; donne-la-moi.
verses.am: ካህኑም። በኤላ ሸለቆ የገደልኸው የፍልስጥኤማዊው የጎልያድ ሰይፍ፥ እነሆ፥ በመጎናጸፊያ ተጠቅልሎ ከዚህ ከኤፉዱ በኋላ አለ፤ ትወድደውም እንደ ሆነ ውሰደው፤ ሌላ ከዚህ የለም አለ። ዳዊትም። እንደ እርሱ ያለ የለምና እርሱን ስጠኝ አለው።

verses.en: And David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.fr: David se leva et s''enfuit le même jour loin de Saül. Il arriva chez Akisch, roi de Gath.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ተነሣ በዚያም ቀን ሳኦልን ፈርቶ ሸሸ፥ ወደ ጌትም ንጉሥ ወደ አንኩስ ሄደ።

verses.en: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.fr: Les serviteurs d''Akisch lui dirent: N''est-ce pas là David, roi du pays? n''est-ce pas celui pour qui l''on chantait en dansant: Saül a frappé ses mille, -Et David ses dix mille?
verses.am: የአንኩስ ባሪያዎችም። ይህ ዳዊት የአገሩ ንጉሥ አይደለምን? ሳኦል ሺህ፥ ዳዊትም እልፍ ገደለ ብለው ሴቶች በዘፈን የዘመሩለት እርሱ አይደለምን? አሉት።

verses.en: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.fr: David prit à coeur ces paroles, et il eut une grande crainte d''Akisch, roi de Gath.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ይህን ቃል በልቡ አኖረ፥ የጌትንም ንጉሥ አንኩስን እጅግ ፈራ።

verses.en: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
verses.fr: Il se montra comme fou à leurs yeux, et fit devant eux des extravagances; il faisait des marques sur les battants des portes, et il laissait couler sa salive sur sa barbe.
verses.am: በፊታቸውም አእምሮውን ለወጠ፥ በያዙትም ጊዜ እንደ እብድ ሆነ፥ በበሩም መድረክ ላይ ተንፈራፈረ፥ ልጋጉም በጢሙ ላይ ይወርድ ነበር።

verses.en: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
verses.fr: Akisch dit à ses serviteurs: Vous voyez bien que cet homme a perdu la raison; pourquoi me l''amenez-vous?
verses.am: አንኩስም ባሪያዎቹን። እነሆ፥ ይህ ሰው እብድ እንደ ሆነ አይታችኋል፤ ለምን ወደ እኔ አመጣችሁት? በፊቴ ያብድ ዘንድ ይህን ያመጣችሁት እብድ ጠፍቶብኝ ነውን? እንዲህ ያለውስ ወደ ቤቴ ይገባልን? አላቸው።

verses.en: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
verses.fr: Est-ce que je manque de fous, pour que vous m''ameniez celui-ci et me rendiez témoin de ses extravagances? Faut-il qu''il entre dans ma maison?

verses.en: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
verses.fr: David partit de là, et se sauva dans la caverne d''Adullam. Ses frères et toute la maison de son père l''apprirent, et ils descendirent vers lui.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከዚያ ተነሣ ወደ ዓዶላም ዋሻ ኮበለለ፤ ወንድሞቹና የአባቱም ቤተ ሰብ ሁሉ ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ወደ እርሱ ወደዚያ ወረዱ።

verses.en: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui se trouvaient dans la détresse, qui avaient des créanciers, ou qui étaient mécontents, se rassemblèrent auprès de lui, et il devint leur chef. Ainsi se joignirent à lui environ quatre cents hommes.
verses.am: የተጨነቀውም ሁሉ፥ ብድርም ያለበት ሁሉ፥ የተከፋም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ተከማቸ፤ እርሱም በላያቸው አለቃ ሆነ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር አራት መቶ የሚያህሉ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
verses.fr: De là David s''en alla à Mitspé dans le pays de Moab. Il dit au roi de Moab: Permets, je te prie, à mon père et à ma mère de se retirer chez vous, jusqu''à ce que je sache ce que Dieu fera de moi.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከዚያ በሞዓብ ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ምጽጳ ሄደ፤ የሞዓብንም ንጉሥ። እግዚአብሔር የሚያደርግልኝን እስካውቅ ድረስ አባቴና እናቴ ከአንተ ጋር ይቀመጡ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
verses.fr: Et il les conduisit devant le roi de Moab, et ils demeurèrent avec lui tout le temps que David fut dans la forteresse.
verses.am: በሞዓብም ንጉሥ ፊት አመጣቸው፤ ዳዊትም በአምባ ውስጥ በነበረበት ወራት ሁሉ በእርሱ ዘንድ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
verses.fr: Le prophète Gad dit à David: Ne reste pas dans la forteresse, va-t''en, et entre dans le pays de Juda. Et David s''en alla, et parvint à la forêt de Héreth.
verses.am: ነቢዩ ጋድም ዳዊትን። ተነሥተህ ወደ ይሁዳ ምድር ሂድ እንጂ በአምባው ውስጥ አትቀመጥ አለው፤ ዳዊትም ተነሥቶ ወደ ሔሬት ዱር መጣ።

verses.en: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)
verses.fr: Saül apprit que l''on avait des renseignements sur David et sur ses gens. Saül était assis sous le tamarisc, à Guibea, sur la hauteur; il avait sa lance à la main, et tous ses serviteurs se tenaient près de lui.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት እንደ ተገለጡ ሰማ። ሳኦልም በጊብዓ በአጣጥ ዛፍ በታች በኮረብታው ላይ ተቀምጦ በእጁም ጦር ይዞ ነበር፤ ባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ በአጠገቡ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;
verses.fr: Et Saül dit à ses serviteurs qui se tenaient près de lui: Ecoutez, Benjamites! Le fils d''Isaï vous donnera-t-il à tous des champs et des vignes? Fera-t-il de vous tous des chefs de mille et des chefs de cent?
verses.am: ሳኦልም በአጠገቡ የቆሙትን ባሪያዎቹን። ብንያማውያን ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ስሙ፤ በውኑ የእሴይ ልጅ እርሻና የወይን ቦታ ለሁላችሁ ይሰጣችኋልን? ሁላችሁንስ ሻለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች ያደርጋችኋልን?

verses.en: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.fr: Sinon, pourquoi avez-vous tous conspiré contre moi, et n''y a-t-il personne qui m''informe de l''alliance de mon fils avec le fils d''Isaï? Pourquoi n''y a-t-il personne de vous qui souffre à mon sujet, et qui m''avertisse que mon fils a soulevé mon serviteur contre moi, afin qu''il me dressât des embûches, comme il le fait aujourd''hui?
verses.am: ሁላችሁ በላዬ ዶልታችሁ ተነሣችሁብኝ፤ ልጄ ከእሴይ ልጅ ጋር ሲማማል ምንም አይገልጥልኝም፤ ከእናንተም አንድ ለእኔ የሚያዝን የለም፥ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው ሁሉ ልጄ ባሪያዬን እንዲዶልት ሲያስነሣብኝ ማንም አላስታወቀኝም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.fr: Doëg, l''Edomite, qui se trouvait aussi parmi les serviteurs de Saül, répondit: J''ai vu le fils d''Isaï venir à Nob, auprès d''Achimélec, fils d''Achithub.
verses.am: በሳኦልም ባሪያዎች አጠገብ የቆመው ኤዶማዊው ዶይቅ መልሶ። የእሴይ ልጅ ወደ ኖብ ወደ አኪጦብ ልጅ ወደ አቢሜሌክ ሲመጣ አይቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: And he enquired of the Lord for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
verses.fr: Achimélec a consulté pour lui l''Eternel, il lui a donné des vivres et lui a remis l''épée de Goliath, le Philistin.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ጠየቀለት፥ ስንቅንም ሰጠው፥ የፍልስጥኤማዊውንም የጎልያድን ሰይፍ ሰጠው አለ።

verses.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
verses.fr: Le roi envoya chercher Achimélec, fils d''Achithub, le sacrificateur, et toute la maison de son père, les sacrificateurs qui étaient à Nob. Ils se rendirent tous vers le roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የአኪጦብን ልጅ ካህኑን አቢሜሌክን በኖብም ያሉትን ካህናት የአባቱን ቤት ሁሉ ልኮ አስጠራቸው፤ ሁላቸውም ወደ ንጉሡ መጡ።

verses.en: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
verses.fr: Saül dit: Ecoute, fils d''Achithub! Il répondit: Me voici, mon seigneur!
verses.am: ሳኦልም። የአኪጦብ ልጅ ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ስማ አለ፤ እርሱም። እነሆኝ፥ ጌታዬ ሆይ ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.fr: Saül lui dit: Pourquoi avez-vous conspiré contre moi, toi et le fils d''Isaï? Pourquoi lui as-tu donné du pain et une épée, et as-tu consulté Dieu pour lui, afin qu''il s''élevât contre moi et me dressât des embûches, comme il le fait aujourd''hui?
verses.am: ሳኦልም። አንተና የእሴይ ልጅ ለምን ዶለታችሁብኝ? እንጀራና ሰይፍ ሰጠኸው፥ ዛሬም እንደ ተደረገው ጠላት ሆኖ ይነሣብኝ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔርን ስለ እርሱ ጠየቅህለት አለው።

verses.en: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?
verses.fr: Achimélec répondit au roi: Lequel d''entre tous tes serviteurs peut être comparé au fidèle David, gendre du roi, dévoué à ses ordres, et honoré dans ta maison?
verses.am: አቢሜሌክም መልሶ ንጉሡን። ከባሪያዎችህ ሁሉ የታመነ፥ ለንጉሥም አማች የሆነ፥ በትእዛዝህ የሚሄድ፥ በቤትህም የከበረ እንደ ዳዊት ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.
verses.fr: Est-ce aujourd''hui que j''ai commencé à consulter Dieu pour lui? Loin de moi! Que le roi ne mette rien à la charge de son serviteur ni de personne de la maison de mon père, car ton serviteur ne connaît de tout ceci aucune chose, petite ou grande.
verses.am: በውኑ ስለ እርሱ እግዚአብሔርን እጠይቅ ዘንድ ዛሬ ጀመርሁን? ይህ ከእኔ ይራቅ፤ እኔ ባሪያህ ይህን ሁሉ እጅግ ወይም ጥቂት ቢሆን አላውቅምና ንጉሡ እንደዚህ ያለውን ነገር በእኔ በባሪያውና በአባቴ ቤት ሁሉ ላይ አያኑር አለ።

verses.en: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.
verses.fr: Le roi dit: Tu mourras, Achimélec, toi et toute la maison de ton père.
verses.am: ንጉሡም። አቢሜሌክ ሆይ። አንተና የአባትህ ቤት ሁሉ ፈጽማችሁ ትሞታላችሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the Lord: because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et le roi dit aux coureurs qui se tenaient près de lui: Tournez-vous, et mettez à mort les sacrificateurs de l''Eternel; car ils sont d''accord avec David, ils ont bien su qu''il s''enfuyait, et ils ne m''ont point averti. Mais les serviteurs du roi ne voulurent pas avancer la main pour frapper les sacrificateurs de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ንጉሡም በዙሪያው የቆሙትን እግረኞች። የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት እጅ ከዳዊት ጋር ነውና፥ ኵብለላውንም ሲያውቁ በጆሮዬ አልገለጡምና ዞራችሁ ግደሉአቸው አላቸው። የንጉሡ ባሪያዎች ግን እጃቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ላይ ይዘረጉ ዘንድ እንቢ አሉ።

verses.en: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
verses.fr: Alors le roi dit à Doëg: Tourne-toi, et frappe les sacrificateurs. Et Doëg, l''Edomite, se tourna, et ce fut lui qui frappa les sacrificateurs; il fit mourir en ce jour quatre-vingt-cinq hommes portant l''éphod de lin.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዶይቅን። አንተ ዞረህ በካህናቱ ላይ ውደቅባቸው አለው። ኤዶማዊውም ዶይቅ ዞሮ በካህናቱ ላይ ወደቀ፥ በዚያም ቀን የበፍታ ኤፉድ የለበሱትን ሰማንያ አምስት ሰዎች ገደለ።

verses.en: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
verses.fr: Saül frappa encore du tranchant de l''épée Nob, ville sacerdotale; hommes et femmes, enfants et nourrissons, boeufs, ânes, et brebis, tombèrent sous le tranchant de l''épée.
verses.am: የካህናቱም ከተማ ኖብን በሰይፍ ስለት መታ፤ ወንዶችንና ሴቶችንም፥ ብላቴኖችንና ጡት የሚጠቡትን፥ በሬዎችንና አህዮችንም በጎችንም በሰይፍ ስለት ገደለ።

verses.en: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
verses.fr: Un fils d''Achimélec, fils d''Achithub, échappa. Son nom était Abiathar. Il s''enfuit auprès de David,
verses.am: ከአኪጦብም ልጅ ከአቢሜሌክ ልጆች ስሙ አብያታር የሚባል አንዱ ልጅ አምልጦ ወደ ዳዊት ሸሸ።

verses.en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the Lord's priests.
verses.fr: et lui rapporta que Saül avait tué les sacrificateurs de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አብያታርም ሳኦል የእግዚአብሔርን ካህናት እንደ ፈጀ ለዳዊት ነገረው።

verses.en: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father's house.
verses.fr: David dit à Abiathar: J''ai bien pensé ce jour même que Doëg, l''Edomite, se trouvant là, ne manquerait pas d''informer Saül. C''est moi qui suis cause de la mort de toutes les personnes de la maison de ton père.
verses.am: ዳዊት አብያታርን። ኤዶማዊው ዶይቅ በዚያ መኖሩን ባየሁ ጊዜ። ለሳኦል በእርግጥ ይነግራል ብዬ በዚያው ቀን አውቄዋለሁ፤ ለአባትህ ቤት ነፍስ ሁሉ የጥፋታቸው ምክንያት እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
verses.fr: Reste avec moi, ne crains rien, car celui qui cherche ma vie cherche la tienne; près de moi tu seras bien gardé.
verses.am: ነፍሴን የሚፈልግ የአንተን ነፍስ ይፈልጋልና፥ ከእኔም ጋር ተጠብቀህ ትኖራለህና በእኔ ዘንድ ተቀመጥ፥ አትፍራ አለው።

verses.en: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.
verses.fr: On vint dire à David: Voici, les Philistins ont attaqué Keïla, et ils pillent les aires.
verses.am: ለዳዊትም። እነሆ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ቅዒላን ይወጋሉ፥ አውድማውንም ይዘርፋሉ የሚል ወሬ ደረሰው።

verses.en: Therefore David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the Lord said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
verses.fr: David consulta l''Eternel, en disant: Irai-je, et battrai-je ces Philistins? Et l''Eternel lui répondit: Va, tu battras les Philistins, et tu délivreras Keïla.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ልሂድን? እነዚህንስ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ልምታን? ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዳዊትን። ሂድ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ምታ ቅዒላንም አድን አለው።

verses.en: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
verses.fr: Mais les gens de David lui dirent: Voici, nous ne sommes pas sans crainte ici même en Juda; que sera-ce si nous allons à Keïla contre les troupes des Philistins?
verses.am: የዳዊትም ሰዎች። እነሆ፥ በዚህ በይሁዳ መቀመጥ እንፈራለን፥ ይልቁንስ በፍልስጥኤማውያን ጭፍሮች ላይ ወደ ቅዒላ ብንሄድ እንዴት ነው? አሉት።

verses.en: Then David enquired of the Lord yet again. And the Lord answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.fr: David consulta encore l''Eternel. Et l''Eternel lui répondit: Lève-toi, descends à Keïla, car je livre les Philistins entre tes mains.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ደግሞ እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቀ፤ እግዚአብሔርም መልሶ። ፍልስጥኤማውያንን በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁና ተነሥተህ ወደ ቅዒላ ውረድ አለው።

verses.en: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.fr: David alla donc avec ses gens à Keïla, et il se battit contre les Philistins; il emmena leur bétail, et leur fit éprouver une grande défaite. Ainsi David délivra les habitants de Keïla.
verses.am: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ወደ ቅዒላ ሄዱ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጋር ተዋጉ፤ እንስሶቻቸውንም ማረኩ፥ በታላቅም አገዳደል ገደሉአቸው። ዳዊትም በቅዒላ የሚኖሩትን አዳነ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.fr: Lorsque Abiathar, fils d''Achimélec, s''enfuit vers David à Keïla, il descendit ayant en main l''éphod.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የአቢሜሌክ ልጅ አብያታር ወደ ዳዊት ወደ ቅዒላ በኰበለለ ጊዜ ኤፉዱን ይዞ ወርዶ ነበር።

verses.en: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
verses.fr: Saül fut informé de l''arrivée de David à Keïla, et il dit: Dieu le livre entre mes mains, car il est venu s''enfermer dans une ville qui a des portes et des barres.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊት ወደ ቅዒላ እንደ መጣ ሰማ፤ ሳኦልም። መዝጊያና መወርወሪያ ወዳለባት ከተማ ገብቶ ተገኝቶአልና እግዚአብሔር በእጄ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶታል አለ።

verses.en: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
verses.fr: Et Saül convoqua tout le peuple à la guerre, afin de descendre à Keïla et d''assiéger David et ses gens.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ወደ ቅዒላ ወርደው ይዋጉ ዘንድ፥ ዳዊትንና ሰዎቹንም ይከብቡ ዘንድ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ አዘዘ።

verses.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
verses.fr: David, ayant eu connaissance du mauvais dessein que Saül projetait contre lui, dit au sacrificateur Abiathar: Apporte l''éphod!
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሳኦል ክፉን እንዳሰበበት አወቀ፤ ካሁኑን አብያታርንም። ኤፉዱን ወደዚህ አምጣ አለው።

verses.en: Then said David, O Lord God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.fr: Et David dit: Eternel, Dieu d''Israël, ton serviteur apprend que Saül veut venir à Keïla pour détruire la ville à cause de moi.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ፥ በእኔ ምክንያት ከተማይቱን ያጠፋ ዘንድ ሳኦል ወደ ቅዒላ ሊመጣ እንደሚፈልግ እኔ ባሪያህ ፈጽሜ ሰምቻለሁ።

verses.en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O Lord God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the Lord said, He will come down.
verses.fr: Les habitants de Keïla me livreront-ils entre ses mains? Saül descendra-t-il, comme ton serviteur l''a appris? Eternel, Dieu d''Israël, daigne le révéler à ton serviteur! Et l''Eternel répondit: Il descendra.
verses.am: የቅዒላ ሰዎች በእጁ አሳልፈው ይሰጡኛልን? ባሪያህስ እንደ ሰማ ሳኦል በውኑ ይወርዳልን? የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ፥ እንድትነግረኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። ይወርዳል አለ።

verses.en: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the Lord said, They will deliver thee up.
verses.fr: David dit encore: Les habitants de Keïla me livreront-ils, moi et mes gens, entre les mains de Saül? Et l''Eternel répondit: Ils te livreront.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። የቅዒላ ሰዎች እኔንና ሰዎቼን በሳኦል እጅ አሳልፈው ይሰጡናልን? አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.
verses.fr: Alors David se leva avec ses gens au nombre d''environ six cents hommes; ils sortirent de Keïla, et s''en allèrent où ils purent. Saül, informé que David s''était sauvé de Keïla, suspendit sa marche.
verses.am: ዳዊትና ስድስት መቶ የሚሆኑ ሰዎችም ተነሥተው ከቅዒላ ወጡ፥ መሄድም ወደሚችሉበት ሄዱ። ሳኦልም ዳዊት ከቅዒላ እንደ ሸሸ ሰማ፤ ስለዚህም ከመውጣት ቀረ።

verses.en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
verses.fr: David demeura au désert, dans des lieux forts, et il resta sur la montagne du désert de Ziph. Saül le cherchait toujours, mais Dieu ne le livra pas entre ses mains.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በምድረ በዳ በአምባ ውስጥ ይኖር ነበር፥ ከዚፍ ምድረ በዳም ባለው በተራራማው አገር ተቀመጠ፤ ሳኦልም ሁልጊዜ ይፈልገው ነበር፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን በእጁ አሳልፎ አልሰጠውም።

verses.en: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
verses.fr: David, voyant Saül en marche pour attenter à sa vie, se tint au désert de Ziph, dans la forêt.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሳኦል ነፍሱን ሊፈልግ እንደ ወጣ አየ፤ ዳዊትም በዚፍ ምድረ በዳ በጥሻው ውስጥ ይኖር ነበር።

verses.en: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.fr: Ce fut alors que Jonathan, fils de Saül, se leva et alla vers David dans la forêt. Il fortifia sa confiance en Dieu,
verses.am: የሳኦልም ልጅ ዮናታን ተነሥቶ ወደ ዳዊት ወደ ጥሻው ስጥ ሄደ፤ እጁንም በእግዚአብሔር አጽንቶ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.
verses.fr: et lui dit: Ne crains rien, car la main de Saül, mon père, ne t''atteindra pas. Tu régneras sur Israël, et moi je serai au second rang près de toi; Saül, mon père, le sait bien aussi.
verses.am: የአባቴ የሳኦል እጅ አታገኝህምና አትፍራ፤ አንተም በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ትሆናለህ፥ እኔም ከአንተ በታች ሁለተኛ እሆናለሁ፤ ይህን ደግሞ አባቴ ሳኦል ያውቃል አለው።

verses.en: And they two made a covenant before the Lord: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.fr: Ils firent tous deux alliance devant l''Eternel; et David resta dans la forêt, et Jonathan s''en alla chez lui.
verses.am: ሁለቱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ፤ ዳዊትም በጥሻው ውስጥ ተቀመጠ፥ ዮናታንም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
verses.fr: Les Ziphiens montèrent auprès de Saül à Guibea, et dirent: David n''est-il pas caché parmi nous dans des lieux forts, dans la forêt, sur la colline de Hakila, qui est au midi du désert?
verses.am: የዚፍ ሰዎችም ወደ ሳኦል ወደ ጊብዓ መጥተው። እነሆ፥ ዳዊት በየሴሞን ደቡብ በኩል በኤኬላ ኮረብታ ላይ በጥሻ ውስጥ ባሉት አምባዎች በእኛ ዘንድ ተሸሽጎ የለምን?

verses.en: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.
verses.fr: Descends donc, ô roi, puisque c''est là tout le désir de ton âme; et à nous de le livrer entre les mains du roi.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ትወርድ ዘንድ ነፍስህ እንደ ወደደች ውረድ፤ በንጉሡም እጅ እርሱን አሳልፎ ለመስጠት እኛ አለን አሉት።

verses.en: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the Lord; for ye have compassion on me.
verses.fr: Saül dit: Que l''Eternel vous bénisse de ce que vous avez pitié de moi!
verses.am: ሳኦልም አለ። እናንተ ስለ እኔ አዝናችኋልና ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የተባረካችሁ ሁኑ፤

verses.en: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.
verses.fr: Allez, je vous prie, prenez encore des informations pour savoir et découvrir dans quel lieu il a dirigé ses pas et qui l''y a vu, car il est, m''a-t-on dit, fort rusé.
verses.am: አሁንም ደግሞ ሂዱ፤ እርሱም እጅግ ተንኰለኛ እንደ ሆነ ሰምቻለሁና አጥብቃችሁ ፈልጉት፥ እግሩም የሚሄድበትን ስፍራ እዩና እወቁ፥ በዚያ ያየውንም ሰው አግኙ።

verses.en: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.
verses.fr: Examinez et reconnaissez tous les lieux où il se cache, puis revenez vers moi avec quelque chose de certain, et je partirai avec vous. S''il est dans le pays, je le chercherai parmi tous les milliers de Juda.
verses.am: እርሱ የሚደበቅበትንና የሚሸሸግበትን ስፍራ እዩና እወቁ፥ በእርግጥም ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፥ እኔም ከእናንተ ጋር እሄዳለሁ፤ በምድርም ውስጥ ቢሸሸግ በይሁዳ አእላፋት ሁሉ መካከል እፈልገዋለሁ።

verses.en: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
verses.fr: Ils se levèrent donc et allèrent à Ziph avant Saül. David et ses gens étaient au désert de Maon, dans la plaine au midi du désert.
verses.am: እነዚያም ተነሥተው ከሳኦል በፊት ወደዚፍ ሄዱ፤ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹ ግን በየሴሞን ደቡብ በኩል በዓረባ በማዖን ምድረ በዳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David; wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.fr: Saül partit avec ses gens à la recherche de David. Et l''on en informa David, qui descendit le rocher et resta dans le désert de Maon. Saül, l''ayant appris, poursuivit David au désert de Maon.
verses.am: ሳኦልና ሰዎቹም ሊፈልጉት ሄዱ፤ ዳዊትም በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ዓለቱ ወርዶ በማዖን ምድረ በዳ ተቀመጠ፤ ሳኦልም ያንን በሰማ ጊዜ ዳዊትን በማዖን ምድረ በዳ አሳደደው።

verses.en: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
verses.fr: Saül marchait d''un côté de la montagne, et David avec ses gens de l''autre côté de la montagne. David fuyait précipitamment pour échapper à Saül. Mais déjà Saül et ses gens entouraient David et les siens pour s''emparer d''eux,
verses.am: ሳኦልም በተራራው በአንድ ወገን ሄደ፥ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም በተራራው በሌላው ወገን ሄዱ። ሳኦልና ሰዎቹም ዳዊትንና ሰዎቹን ለመያዝ ከብበዋቸው ነበርና ዳዊት ከሳኦል ፊት ያመልጥ ዘንድ ፈጠነ።

verses.en: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
verses.fr: lorsqu''un messager vint dire à Saül: Hâte-toi de venir, car les Philistins ont fait invasion dans le pays.
verses.am: ወደ ሳኦልም መልእክተኛ መጥቶ። ፍልስጥኤማውያን አገሩን ወርረውታልና ፈጥነህ ና አለው።

verses.en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.
verses.fr: Saül cessa de poursuivre David, et il s''en retourna pour aller à la rencontre des Philistins. C''est pourquoi l''on appela ce lieu Séla-Hammachlekoth.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊትን ማሳደድ ትቶ ተመለሰ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጋር ሊዋጋ ሄደ። ስለዚህ የዚህ ስፍራ ስም የማምለጥ ዓለት ተባለ።

verses.en: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.
verses.fr: De là David monta vers les lieux forts d''En-Guédi, où il demeura.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከዚያ ወጥቶ በዓይንጋዲ አምባዎች ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.
verses.fr: Lorsque Saül fut revenu de la poursuite des Philistins, on vint lui dire: Voici, David est dans le désert d''En-Guédi.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሳኦል ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ከማሳደድ ከተመለሰ በኋላ። እነሆ፥ ዳዊት በዓይንጋዲ ምድረ በዳ አለ የሚል ወሬ ደረሰለት።

verses.en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.fr: Saül prit trois mille hommes d''élite sur tout Israël, et il alla chercher David et ses gens jusque sur les rochers des boucs sauvages.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ የተመረጡትን ሦስት ሺህ ሰዎች ወሰደ፥ ዳዊትንና ሰዎቹንም ለመፈለግ የበረሀ ፍየሎች ወደ ነበሩባቸው ዓለቶች ሄደ።

verses.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
verses.fr: Il arriva à des parcs de brebis, qui étaient près du chemin; et là se trouvait une caverne, où il entra pour se couvrir les pieds. David et ses gens étaient au fond de la caverne.
verses.am: በመንገድም አጠገብ ወዳሉት የበጎች ማደሪያዎች መጣ፥ በዚያም ዋሻ ነበረ፤ ሳኦልም ወገቡን ይሞክር ዘንድ ከዚያ ገባ፤ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ከዋሻው በውስጠኛው ቦታ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.en: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the Lord said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.
verses.fr: Les gens de David lui dirent: Voici le jour où l''Eternel te dit: Je livre ton ennemi entre tes mains; traite-le comme bon te semblera. David se leva, et coupa doucement le pan du manteau de Saül.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ሰዎች። እነሆ፥ ጠላትህን በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ፥ በዓይንህም ደስ የሚያሰኝህን ታደርግበታለህ ብሎ እግዚአብሔር የነገረህ ቀን፥ እነሆ፥ ዛሬ ነው አሉት። ዳዊትም ተነሥቶ የሳኦልን መጎናጸፊያ ዘርፍ በቀስታ ቈረጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.
verses.fr: Après cela le coeur lui battit, parce qu''il avait coupé le pan du manteau de Saül.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የሳኦልን የልብሱን ዘርፍ ስለቈረጠ የዳዊት ልብ በኀዘን ተመታ።

verses.en: And he said unto his men, The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord's anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et il dit à ses gens: Que l''Eternel me garde de commettre contre mon seigneur, l''oint de l''Eternel, une action telle que de porter ma main sur lui! car il est l''oint de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰዎቹንም። እግዚአብሔር የቀባው ነውና እግዚአብሔር በቀባው በጌታዬ ላይ እንዲህ ያለውን ነገር አደርግ ዘንድ እጄንም እጥልበት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከእኔ ያርቀው አላቸው።

verses.en: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
verses.fr: Par ces paroles David arrêta ses gens, et les empêcha de se jeter sur Saül. Puis Saül se leva pour sortir de la caverne, et continua son chemin.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በዚህ ቃል ሰዎቹን ከለከላቸው፥ በሳኦልም ላይ ይነሡ ዘንድ አልተዋቸውም፤ ሳኦልም ከዋሻው ተነሥቶ መንገዱን ሄደ።

verses.en: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
verses.fr: Après cela, David se leva et sortit de la caverne. Il se mit alors à crier après Saül: O roi, mon seigneur! Saül regarda derrière lui, et David s''inclina le visage contre terre et se prosterna.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ዳዊት ደግሞ ተነሣ፥ ከዋሻውም ወጣ፥ ከሳኦልም በኋላ። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ብሎ ጮኸ፤ ሳኦልም ወደ ኋላው ተመለከተ፥ ዳዊትም ወደ ምድር ተጐንብሶ እጅ ነሣ።

verses.en: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men's words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?
verses.fr: David dit à Saül: Pourquoi écoutes-tu les propos des gens qui disent: Voici, David cherche ton malheur?
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሳኦልን አለው። እነሆ፥ ዳዊት ክፉ ነገር ይሻብሃል የሚሉህን ሰዎች ቃል ለምን ትሰማለህ?

verses.en: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the Lord had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the Lord's anointed.
verses.fr: Tu vois maintenant de tes propres yeux que l''Eternel t''avait livré aujourd''hui entre mes mains dans la caverne. On m''excitait à te tuer; mais je t''ai épargné, et j''ai dit: Je ne porterai pas la main sur mon seigneur, car il est l''oint de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ዛሬ በዋሻው ውስጥ እግዚአብሔር በእጄ አሳልፎ እንደ ሰጠህ ዓይንህ አይታለች፤ አንተንም እንድገድልህ ሰዎች ተናገሩኝ፤ እኔ ግን። በእግዚአብሔር የተቀባ ነውና እጄን በጌታዬ ላይ አልዘረጋም ብዬ ራራሁልህ።

verses.en: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.
verses.fr: Vois, mon père, vois donc le pan de ton manteau dans ma main. Puisque j''ai coupé le pan de ton manteau et que je ne t''ai pas tué, sache et reconnais qu''il n''y a dans ma conduite ni méchanceté ni révolte, et que je n''ai point péché contre toi. Et toi, tu me dresses des embûches, pour m''ôter la vie!
verses.am: ደግሞም፥ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የልብስህ ዘርፍ በእጄ እንዳለ ተመልክተህ እወቅ፤ የልብስህንም ዘርፍ በቈረጥሁ ጊዜ አልገደልሁህም፤ ስለዚህም በእጄ ክፋትና በደል እንደሌለ፥ አንተም ነፍሴን ልትወስድ ምንም ብታሳድደኝ እንዳልበደልሁህ ተመልክተህ እወቅ።

verses.en: The Lord judge between me and thee, and the Lord avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel sera juge entre moi et toi, et l''Eternel me vengera de toi; mais je ne porterai point la main sur toi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ይፍረድ፥ እግዚአብሔርም አንተን ይበቀልልኝ፤ እጄ ግን በአንተ ላይ አትሆንም።

verses.en: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
verses.fr: Des méchants vient la méchanceté, dit l''ancien proverbe. Aussi je ne porterai point la main sur toi.
verses.am: በጥንት ምሳሌ። ከኃጢአተኞች ኀጢአት ይወጣል እንደ ተባለ፤ እጄ ግን በአንተ ላይ አትሆንም።

verses.en: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
verses.fr: Contre qui le roi d''Israël s''est-il mis en marche? Qui poursuis-tu? Un chien mort, une puce!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ማንን ለማሳደድ መጥቶአል? አንተስ ማንን ታሳድዳለህ? የሞተ ውሻን ወይስ ቁንጫን ታሳድዳለህን?

verses.en: The Lord therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.
verses.fr: L''Eternel jugera et prononcera entre moi et toi; il regardera, il défendra ma cause, il me rendra justice en me délivrant de ta main.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር ዳኛ ይሁን፥ በእኔና በአንተም መካከል ይፍረድ፥ አይቶም ይምዋገትልኝ፥ ከእጅህም ያድነኝ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.fr: Lorsque David eut fini d''adresser à Saül ces paroles, Saül dit: Est-ce bien ta voix, mon fils David? Et Saül éleva la voix et pleura.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ዳዊት ይህን ቃል ለሳኦል መናገር በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ ሳኦል። ልጄ ሆይ ዳዊት፥ ይህ ድምፅህ ነውን? አለ፤ ሳኦልም ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.
verses.fr: Et il dit à David: Tu es plus juste que moi; car tu m''as fait du bien, et moi je t''ai fait du mal.
verses.am: ዳዊትን አለው። እኔ ክፉ በመለስሁልህ ፋንታ በጎ መልሰህልኛልና አንተ ከእኔ ይልቅ ጻድቅ ነህ።

verses.en: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the Lord had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.
verses.fr: Tu manifestes aujourd''hui la bonté avec laquelle tu agis envers moi, puisque l''Eternel m''avait livré entre tes mains et que tu ne m''as pas tué.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእጅህ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶኝ ሳለ አልገደልኸኝምና ለእኔ መልካም እንዳደረግህልኝ አንተ ዛሬ አሳየኸኝ።

verses.en: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the Lord reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un rencontre son ennemi, le laisse-t-il poursuivre tranquillement son chemin? Que l''Eternel te récompense pour ce que tu m''as fait en ce jour!
verses.am: ጠላቱን አግኝቶ በመልካም መንገድ ሸኝቶ የሚሰድድ ማን ነው? ስለዚህ ለእኔ ስላደረግኸው ቸርነት እግዚአብሔር ይመልስልህ።

verses.en: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.
verses.fr: Maintenant voici, je sais que tu régneras, et que la royauté d''Israël restera entre tes mains.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ አንተ በእርግጥ ንጉሥ እንድትሆን የእስራኤልም መንግሥት በእጅህ እንድትጸና እኔ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Swear now therefore unto me by the Lord, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father's house.
verses.fr: Jure-moi donc par l''Eternel que tu ne détruiras pas ma postérité après moi, et que tu ne retrancheras pas mon nom de la maison de mon père.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ከእኔ በኋላ ዘሬን እንዳትቈርጥ ከአባቴም ቤት ስሜን እንዳታጠፋው በእግዚአብሔር ማልልኝ።

verses.en: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
verses.fr: David le jura à Saül. Puis Saül s''en alla dans sa maison, et David et ses gens montèrent au lieu fort.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ለሳኦል ማለለት፤ ሳኦልም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ፥ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ወደ አምባው ወጡ።

verses.en: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
verses.fr: Samuel mourut. Tout Israël s''étant assemblé le pleura, et on l''enterra dans sa demeure à Rama. Ce fut alors que David se leva et descendit au désert de Paran.
verses.am: ሳሙኤልም ሞተ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ተሰብስበው አለቀሱለት፥ በአርማቴምም በቤቱ ቀበሩት። ዳዊትም ተነሥቶ ወደ ፋራን ምድረ በዳ ወረደ።

verses.en: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
verses.fr: Il y avait à Maon un homme fort riche, possédant des biens à Carmel; il avait trois mille brebis et mille chèvres, et il se trouvait à Carmel pour la tonte de ses brebis.
verses.am: በማዖንም የተቀመጠ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፥ ከብቱም በቀርሜሎስ ነበረ፤ እጅግም ታላቅ ሰው ነበረ፥ ለእርሱም ሦስት ሺህ በጎችና አንድ ሺህ ፍየሎች ነበሩት፤ በቀርሜሎስም በጎቹን ይሸልት ነበር።

verses.en: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.
verses.fr: Le nom de cet homme était Nabal, et sa femme s''appelait Abigaïl; c''était une femme de bon sens et belle de figure, mais l''homme était dur et méchant dans ses actions. Il descendait de Caleb.
verses.am: የሰውዮውም ስም ናባል፥ የሚስቱም ስም አቢግያ ነበረ፤ የሴቲቱም አእምሮ ታላቅ፥ መልክዋም የተዋበ ነበረ፤ ሰውዮው ግን ባለጌ ነበረ፥ ግብሩም ክፉ ነበረ፤ ከካሌብም ወገን ነበረ።

verses.en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
verses.fr: David apprit au désert que Nabal tondait ses brebis.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በምድረ በዳ ሳለ። ናባል በጎቹን ይሸልታል የሚል ወሬ ሰማ።

verses.en: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
verses.fr: Il envoya vers lui dix jeunes gens, auxquels il dit: Montez à Carmel, et allez auprès de Nabal. Vous le saluerez en mon nom,
verses.am: ዳዊትም አሥር ጕልማሶች ላከ ለጕልማሶችም አለ። ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ወጥታችሁ ወደ ናባል ሂዱ፥ በስሜም ስለ ሰላም ጠይቁት፤

verses.en: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
verses.fr: et vous lui parlerez ainsi: Pour la vie sois en paix, et que la paix soit avec ta maison et tout ce qui t''appartient!
verses.am: እንዲህም በሉት። በደኅንነት ኑር፥ ለአንተና ለቤትህም ለአንተም ላሉት ሁሉ ሰላም ይሁን።

verses.en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, j''ai appris que tu as les tondeurs. Or tes bergers ont été avec nous; nous ne leur avons fait aucun outrage, et rien ne leur a été enlevé pendant tout le temps qu''ils ont été à Carmel.
verses.am: አሁንም በጎችህን እንድትሸልት ሰምቻለሁ፤ እረኞችህም ከእኛ ጋር ነበሩ፥ ከቶ አልበደልናቸውም፤ በቀርሜሎስም በተቀመጡበት ዘመን ሁሉ ከመንጋው አንዳች አልጎደለባቸውም።

verses.en: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.
verses.fr: Demande-le à tes serviteurs, et ils te le diront. Que ces jeunes gens trouvent donc grâce à tes yeux, puisque nous venons dans un jour de joie. Donne donc, je te prie, à tes serviteurs et à ton fils David ce qui se trouvera sous ta main.
verses.am: ጕልማሶችህን ጠይቃቸው፥ እነርሱም ይነግሩሃል፤ አሁንም እንግዲህ በመልካም ቀን መጥተንብሃልና ጕልማሶች በፊትህ ሞገስ ያግኙ፤ በእጅህም ከተገኘው ለባሪያዎችህና ለልጅህ ለዳዊት፥ እባክህ፥ ስጥ።

verses.en: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
verses.fr: Lorsque les gens de David furent arrivés, ils répétèrent à Nabal toutes ces paroles, au nom de David. Puis ils se turent.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ጕልማሶች መጡ፥ ይህንም ቃል ሁሉ በዳዊት ስም ለናባል ነግረው ዝም አሉ።

verses.en: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
verses.fr: Nabal répondit aux serviteurs de David: Qui est David, et qui est le fils d''Isaï? Il y a aujourd''hui beaucoup de serviteurs qui s''échappent d''auprès de leurs maîtres.
verses.am: ናባልም ለዳዊት ባሪያዎች። ዳዊት ማን ነው? የእሴይስ ልጅ ማን ነው? እያንዳንዳቸው ከጌቶቻቸው የኰበለሉ ባሪያዎች ዛሬ ብዙዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
verses.fr: Et je prendrais mon pain, mon eau, et mon bétail que j''ai tué pour mes tondeurs, et je les donnerais à des gens qui sont je ne sais d''où?
verses.am: እንጀራዬንና የወይን ጠጄን ለሸላቾቼም ያረድሁትን ሥጋ ወስጄ ከወዴት እንደ ሆኑ ለማላውቃቸው ሰዎች እሰጣለሁን? ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
verses.fr: Les gens de David rebroussèrent chemin; ils s''en retournèrent, et redirent, à leur arrivée, toutes ces paroles à David.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ጕልማሶች ዞረው በመጡበት መንገድ ተመለሱ፥ መጥተውም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ለዳዊት ነገሩት።

verses.en: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
verses.fr: Alors David dit à ses gens: Que chacun de vous ceigne son épée! Et ils ceignirent chacun leur épée. David aussi ceignit son épée, et environ quatre cents hommes montèrent à sa suite. Il en resta deux cents près des bagages.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሰዎቹን። ሁላችሁ ሰይፋችሁን ታጠቁ አላቸው። ሁሉም ሰይፋቸውን ታጠቁ፥ ዳዊትም ሰይፉን ታጠቀ፤ አራት መቶ ሰዎችም ዳዊትን ተከትለው ወጡ፥ ሁለት መቶውም በዕቃው ዘንድ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
verses.fr: Un des serviteurs de Nabal vint dire à Abigaïl, femme de Nabal: Voici, David a envoyé du désert des messagers pour saluer notre maître, qui les a rudoyés.
verses.am: ከብላቴኖቹ አንዱ ለናባል ሚስት ለአቢግያ እንዲህ ብሎ ነገራት። እነሆ፥ ዳዊት በምድረ በዳ ሳለ ጌታችንን ሊባርኩ መልእክተኞች ላከ፤ እርሱ ግን ሰደባቸው።

verses.en: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
verses.fr: Et pourtant ces gens ont été très bons pour nous; ils ne nous ont fait aucun outrage, et rien ne nous a été enlevé, tout le temps que nous avons été avec eux lorsque nous étions dans les champs.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሰዎች ግን በእኛ ዘንድ እጅግ መልካም ነበሩ፤ አልበደሉንምም፥ ከእነርሱም በሄድንበት ዘመን ሁሉ በምድረ በዳ ሳለን አንዳች አልጠፋብንም፤

verses.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
verses.fr: Ils nous ont nuit et jour servi de muraille, tout le temps que nous avons été avec eux, faisant paître les troupeaux.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ጋር ሆነን መንጋውን በጠበቅንበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሌሊትና ቀን አጥር ሆነውን ነበር።

verses.en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
verses.fr: Sache maintenant et vois ce que tu as à faire, car la perte de notre maître et de toute sa maison est résolue, et il est si méchant qu''on n''ose lui parler.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በጌታችንና በቤቱ ሁሉ ላይ ክፉ ነገር እንዲመጣ ተቈርጦአልና፥ እርሱ ምናምንቴ ሰው ስለ ሆነ ማንም ሊናገረው አይችልምና የምታደርጊውን ተመልከቺና እወቂ።

verses.en: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
verses.fr: Abigaïl prit aussitôt deux cents pains, deux outres de vin, cinq pièces de bétail apprêtées, cinq mesures de grain rôti, cent masses de raisins secs, et deux cents de figues sèches. Elle les mit sur des ânes,
verses.am: አቢግያም ፈጥና ሁለት መቶ እንጀራ፥ ሁለት አቁማዳ የወይን ጠጅ፥ አምስትም የተዘጋጁ በጎች፥ አምስትም መስፈሪያ ጥብስ እሸት፥ አንድ መቶ ዘለላ ዘቢብ፥ ሁለት መቶም የበለስ ጥፍጥፍ ወሰደች፥ በአህዮችም ላይ አስጫነች።

verses.en: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
verses.fr: et elle dit à ses serviteurs: Passez devant moi, je vais vous suivre. Elle ne dit rien à Nabal, son mari.
verses.am: ለብላቴኖችዋም። አስቀድማችሁ በፊቴ ሂዱ፥ እነሆም፥ እከተላችኋለሁ አለች። ይህንም ለባልዋ ለናባል አልነገረችውም።

verses.en: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert on the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
verses.fr: Montée sur un âne, elle descendit la montagne par un chemin couvert; et voici, David et ses gens descendaient en face d''elle, en sorte qu''elle les rencontra.
verses.am: እርስዋም በአህያው ላይ ተቀምጣ በተራራው ላይ በተሰወረ ስፍራ በወረደች ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ዳዊትና ሰዎቹ ወደ እርስዋ ወረዱ፤ እርስዋም ተገናኘቻቸው።

verses.en: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.
verses.fr: David avait dit: C''est bien en vain que j''ai gardé tout ce que cet homme a dans le désert, et que rien n''a été enlevé de tout ce qu''il possède; il m''a rendu le mal pour le bien.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ለዚህ ሰው ከሆነው ሁሉ አንድ ነገር እንዳይጠፋበት በእውነት ከብቱን ሁሉ በምድረ በዳ በከንቱ ጠበቅሁ፥ እርሱም ስለ በጎነቴ ክፋት መለሰልኝ።

verses.en: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.fr: Que Dieu traite son serviteur David dans toute sa rigueur, si je laisse subsister jusqu''à la lumière du matin qui que ce soit de tout ce qui appartient à Nabal!
verses.am: ለእርሱም ከሆነው ሁሉ እስከ ነገ ጥዋት ድረስ አንድ ወንድ ስንኳ ብተው፥ እግዚአብሔር በዳዊት ላይ እንዲህ ያድርግ እንዲህም ይጨምር ብሎ ነበር።

verses.en: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
verses.fr: Lorsque Abigaïl aperçut David, elle descendit rapidement de l''âne, tomba sur sa face en présence de David, et se prosterna contre terre.
verses.am: አቢግያም ዳዊትን ባየች ጊዜ ከአህያዋ ላይ ፈጥና ወረደች፥ በዳዊትም ፊት በግምባርዋ ወደቀች፥ በምድርም ላይ እጅ ነሣች።

verses.en: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.
verses.fr: Puis, se jetant à ses pieds, elle dit: A moi la faute, mon seigneur! Permets à ta servante de parler à tes oreilles, et écoute les paroles de ta servante.
verses.am: በእግሩም ላይ ወደቀች፥ እንዲህም አለች። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ይህ ኃጢአት በእኔ ላይ ይሁን፤ እኔ ባሪያህ በጆሮህ ልናገር፥ የባሪያህንም ቃል አድምጥ።

verses.en: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.
verses.fr: Que mon seigneur ne prenne pas garde à ce méchant homme, à Nabal, car il est comme son nom; Nabal est son nom, et il y a chez lui de la folie. Et moi, ta servante, je n''ai pas vu les gens que mon seigneur a envoyés.
verses.am: በዚህ ምናምንቴ ሰው በናባል ላይ ጌታዬ ልቡን እንዳይጣል እለምናለሁ፤ እንደ ስሙ እንዲሁ እርሱ ነው፤ ስሙ ናባል ነው፥ ስንፍናም አድሮበታል፤ እኔ ባሪያህ ግን ከአንተ የተላኩትን የጌታዬን ጕልማሶች አላየሁም።

verses.en: Now therefore, my lord, as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the Lord hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
verses.fr: Maintenant, mon seigneur, aussi vrai que l''Eternel est vivant et que ton âme est vivante, c''est l''Eternel qui t''a empêché de répandre le sang et qui a retenu ta main. Que tes ennemis, que ceux qui veulent du mal à mon seigneur soient comme Nabal!
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በሕያው ነፍስህም እምላለሁ! ወደ ደም እንዳትገባ፥ እጅህም ራስህን እንዳታድን የከለከለህ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ አሁንም ጠላቶችህና በጌታዬ ላይ ክፉ የሚሹ ሁሉ እንደ ናባል ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
verses.fr: Accepte ce présent que ta servante apporte à mon seigneur, et qu''il soit distribué aux gens qui marchent à la suite de mon seigneur.
verses.am: አሁንም ባሪያህ ወደ ጌታዬ ያመጣችው ይህ መተያያ ጌታዬን ለሚከተሉ ጕልማሶች ይሰጥ።

verses.en: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the Lord will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the Lord, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.
verses.fr: Pardonne, je te prie, la faute de ta servante, car l''Eternel fera à mon seigneur une maison stable; pardonne, car mon seigneur soutient les guerres de l''Eternel, et la méchanceté ne se trouvera jamais en toi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ጦርነት ስለምትዋጋ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት ለጌታዬ የታመነ ቤት ይሠራልና የእኔን የባሪያህን ኃጢአት፥ እባክህ፥ ይቅር በል፤ በዘመንህም ሁሉ ክፋት አይገኝብህም።

verses.en: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the Lord thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.
verses.fr: S''il s''élève quelqu''un qui te poursuive et qui en veuille à ta vie, l''âme de mon seigneur sera liée dans le faisceau des vivants auprès de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et il lancera du creux de la fronde l''âme de tes ennemis.
verses.am: ያሳድድህ ዘንድ ነፍስህንም ይሻ ዘንድ ሰው ቢነሣ፥ የጌታዬ ነፍስ በሕያዋን ወገን በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የታሰረች ትሆናለች፤ የጠላቶችህንም ነፋስ ከወንጭፍ እንደሚጣል እንዲሁ ይጥላታል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel aura fait à mon seigneur tout le bien qu''il t''a annoncé, et qu''il t''aura établi chef sur Israël,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለጌታዬ የተናገረውን ቸርነት ሁሉ ባደረገልህ ጊዜ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ አለቃ አድርጎ ባስነሣህ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the Lord shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.
verses.fr: mon seigneur n''aura ni remords ni souffrance de coeur pour avoir répandu le sang inutilement et pour s''être vengé lui-même. Et lorsque l''Eternel aura fait du bien à mon seigneur, souviens-toi de ta servante.
verses.am: አንተ በከንቱ ደም እንዳላፈሰስህ፥ በገዛ እጅህም እንዳልተካስህ ይህ ዕንቅፋትና የሕሊና ጸጸት በጌታዬ አይሆንልህም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለጌታዬ በጎ ባደረገልህ ጊዜ፥ ባሪያህን አስብ።

verses.en: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
verses.fr: David dit à Abigaïl: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, qui t''a envoyée aujourd''hui à ma rencontre!
verses.am: ዳዊትም አቢግያን አላት። ዛሬ እኔን ለመገናኘት አንቺን የሰደደ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.
verses.fr: Béni soit ton bon sens, et bénie sois-tu, toi qui m''as empêché en ce jour de répandre le sang, et qui as retenu ma main!
verses.am: ወደ ደም እንዳልሄድ፥ በእጄም በቀል እንዳላደርግ ዛሬ የከለከለኝ አእምሮሽ የተመሰገነ ይሁን፥ አንቺም የተመሰገንሽ ሁኚ።

verses.en: For in very deed, as the Lord God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, qui m''a empêché de te faire du mal, est vivant! si tu ne t''étais hâtée de venir au-devant de moi, il ne serait resté qui que ce soit à Nabal, d''ici à la lumière du matin.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክፉ እንዳላደርግብሽ የከለከለኝ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እኔን ለመገናኘት ፈጥነሽ ባልመጣሽ ኖሮ እስኪነጋ ድረስ ለናባል አንድ ወንድ ስንኳ ባልቀረውም ነበር።

verses.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.
verses.fr: Et David prit de la main d''Abigaïl ce qu''elle lui avait apporté, et lui dit: Monte en paix dans ta maison; vois, j''ai écouté ta voix, et je t''ai favorablement accueillie.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ያመጣችውን ከእጅዋ ተቀብሎ። በደኅና ወደቤትሽ ሂጂ፤ እነሆ፥ ቃልሽን ሰማሁ፥ ፊትሽንም አከበርሁ አላት።

verses.en: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.
verses.fr: Abigaïl arriva auprès de Nabal. Et voici, il faisait dans sa maison un festin comme un festin de roi; il avait le coeur joyeux, et il était complètement dans l''ivresse. Elle ne lui dit aucune chose, petite ou grande, jusqu''à la lumière du matin.
verses.am: አቢግያም ወደ ናባል መጣች፤ እነሆም፥ በቤቱ እንደ ንጉሥ ግብዣ ያለ ግብዣ ያደርግ ነበር፤ ናባልም እጅግ ሰክሮ ነበርና ልቡ ደስ ብሎት ነበር፤ ስለዚህም እስኪነጋ ድረስ ታናሽ ነገር ወይም ታላቅ ነገር አልነገረችውም ነበር።

verses.en: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
verses.fr: Mais le matin, l''ivresse de Nabal s''étant dissipée, sa femme lui raconta ce qui s''était passé. Le coeur de Nabal reçut un coup mortel, et devint comme une pierre.
verses.am: በነጋውም የጠጁ ስካር ከናባል ባለፈ ጊዜ ሚስቱ ይህን ነገር ነገረችው፤ ልቡም በውስጡ ሞተ፥

verses.en: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the Lord smote Nabal, that he died.
verses.fr: Environ dix jours après, l''Eternel frappa Nabal, et il mourut.
verses.am: እንደ ድንጋይም ሆነ፤ ከአሥር ቀንም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ናባልን ቀሠፈው፥ እርሱም ሞተ።

verses.en: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the Lord, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the Lord hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
verses.fr: David apprit que Nabal était mort, et il dit: Béni soit l''Eternel, qui a défendu ma cause dans l''outrage que m''a fait Nabal, et qui a empêché son serviteur de faire le mal! L''Eternel a fait retomber la méchanceté de Nabal sur sa tête. David envoya proposer à Abigaïl de devenir sa femme.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ናባል እንደ ሞተ በሰማ ጊዜ። ከናባል እጅ የስድቤን ፍርድ የፈረደልኝ፥ ባሪያውንም ከክፋት የጠበቀ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን፤ እግዚአብሔርም የናባልን ክፋት በራሱ ላይ መለሰ አለ። ዳዊትም ልኮ ያገባት ዘንድ አቢግያን ተነጋገራት።

verses.en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs de David arrivèrent chez Abigaïl à Carmel, et lui parlèrent ainsi: David nous a envoyés vers toi, afin de te prendre pour sa femme.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ባሪያዎች ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ወደ አቢግያ በመጡ ጊዜ። ዳዊት ያገባሽ ዘንድ ወደ አንቺ ልኮናል ብለው ነገሩአት።

verses.en: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.
verses.fr: Elle se leva, se prosterna le visage contre terre, et dit: Voici, ta servante sera une esclave pour laver les pieds des serviteurs de mon seigneur.
verses.am: ተነሥታም በግምባርዋ ወድቃ እጅ ነሣችና። እነሆ፥ እኔ ገረድህ የጌታዬን ሎሌዎች እግር አጥብ ዘንድ አገልጋይ ነኝ አለች።

verses.en: And Abigail hasted, and arose and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
verses.fr: Et aussitôt Abigaïl partit, montée sur un âne, et accompagnée de cinq jeunes filles; elle suivit les messagers de David, et elle devint sa femme.
verses.am: አቢግያም ፈጥና ተነሣች፤ በአህያም ላይ ተቀመጠች፥ አምስቱም ገረዶችዋ ተከተሉአት፤ የዳዊትንም መልእክተኞች ተከትላ ሄደች፥ ሚስትም ሆነችው።

verses.en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.
verses.fr: David avait aussi pris Achinoam de Jizreel, et toutes les deux furent ses femmes.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ደግሞ ኢይዝራኤላዊቱን አኪናሆምን ወሰደ፤ ሁለቱም ሚስቶች ሆኑለት።

verses.en: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.
verses.fr: Et Saül avait donné sa fille Mical, femme de David, à Palthi de Gallim, fils de Laïsch.
verses.am: ሳኦል ግን የዳዊትን ሚስት ልጁን ሜልኮልን አገሩ ጋሊም ለነበረው ለሌሳ ልጅ ለፈልጢ ሰጥቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
verses.fr: Les Ziphiens allèrent auprès de Saül à Guibea, et dirent: David n''est-il pas caché sur la colline de Hakila, en face du désert?
verses.am: የዚፍ ሰዎችም ወደ ጊብዓ ወደ ሳኦል መጥተው። እነሆ፥ ዳዊት በየሴሞን ፊት ለፊት ባለው በኤኬላ ኮረብታ ላይ ተሸሽጎአል አሉት።

verses.en: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
verses.fr: Saül se leva et descendit au désert de Ziph, avec trois mille hommes de l''élite d''Israël, pour chercher David dans le désert de Ziph.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ተነሥቶ ዳዊትን በዚፍ ምድረ በዳ ይሻ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል የተመረጡ ሦስት ሺህ ሰዎች ይዞ ወደ ዚፍ ምድረ በዳ ወረደ።

verses.en: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
verses.fr: Il campa sur la colline de Hakila, en face du désert, près du chemin. David était dans le désert; et s''étant aperçu que Saül marchait à sa poursuite au désert,
verses.am: ሳኦልም በየሴሞን ፊት ለፊት ባለው በኤኬላ ኮረብታ ላይ በመንገዱ አጠገብ ሰፈረ። ዳዊትም በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ ተቀምጦ ነበር፥ ሳኦልም በስተ ኋላው ወደ ምድረ በዳ እንደ መጣ አየ።

verses.en: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
verses.fr: il envoya des espions, et apprit avec certitude que Saül était arrivé.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ሰላዮች ሰደደ፥ ሳኦልም ወደዚህ እንደ መጣ በእርግጥ አወቀ።

verses.en: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.
verses.fr: Alors David se leva et vint au lieu où Saül était campé, et il vit la place où couchait Saül, avec Abner, fils de Ner, chef de son armée. Saül couchait au milieu du camp, et le peuple campait autour de lui.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ተነሥቶ ሳኦል ወደ ሰፈረበት ቦታ መጣ፤ ሳኦልና የሠራዊቱ አለቃ የኔር ልጅ አበኔርም የተኙበትን ስፍራ አየ፤ ሳኦልም በሰፈሩ ውስጥ ተኝቶ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም በዙሪያው ሰፍሮ ነበር።

verses.en: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.
verses.fr: David prit la parole, et s''adressant à Achimélec, Héthien, et à Abischaï, fils de Tseruja et frère de Joab, il dit: Qui veut descendre avec moi dans le camp vers Saül? Et Abischaï répondit: Moi, je descendrai avec toi.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ኬጢያዊውን አቢሜሌክንና የጽሩያን ልጅ የኢዮአብን ወንድም አቢሳን። ወደ ሳኦል ወደ ሰፈሩ ከእኔ ጋር የሚወርድ ማን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቃቸው፤ አቢሳም። እኔ ከአንተ ጋር እወርዳለሁ አለ።

verses.en: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.
verses.fr: David et Abischaï allèrent de nuit vers le peuple. Et voici, Saül était couché et dormait au milieu du camp, et sa lance était fixée en terre à son chevet. Abner et le peuple étaient couchés autour de lui.
verses.am: ዳዊትና አቢሳም ወደ ሕዝቡ በሌሊት መጡ፤ እነሆም፥ ሳኦል ጦሩ በራሱ አጠገብ በምድር ተተክሎ በሰፈሩ ውስጥ ተኝቶ ነበር፤ አበኔርና ሕዝቡም በዙርያው ተኝተው ነበር።

verses.en: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.
verses.fr: Abischaï dit à David: Dieu livre aujourd''hui ton ennemi entre tes mains; laisse-moi, je te prie, le frapper de ma lance et le clouer en terre d''un seul coup, pour que je n''aie pas à y revenir.
verses.am: አቢሳም ዳዊትን። ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ጠላትህን በእጅህ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶታል፤ አሁንም እኔ በጦር አንድ ጊዜ ከምድር ጋር ላጣብቀው፥ ሁለተኛም አያዳግምም አለው።

verses.en: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the Lord's anointed, and be guiltless?
verses.fr: Mais David dit à Abischaï: Ne le détruis pas! car qui pourrait impunément porter la main sur l''oint de l''Eternel?
verses.am: ዳዊትም አቢሳን። እግዚአብሔር በቀባው ላይ እጁን የሚዘረጋ ንጹሕ አይሆንምና አትግደለው አለው።

verses.en: David said furthermore, As the Lord liveth, the Lord shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.
verses.fr: Et David dit: L''Eternel est vivant! c''est à l''Eternel seul à le frapper, soit que son jour vienne et qu''il meure, soit qu''il descende sur un champ de bataille et qu''il y périsse.
verses.am: ደግሞም ዳዊት። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እግዚአብሔር ይመታዋል፥ ወይም ቀኑ ደርሶ ይሞታል፥ ወይም ወደ ሰልፍ ወርዶ ይገደላል፤

verses.en: The Lord forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the Lord's anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
verses.fr: Loin de moi, par l''Eternel! de porter la main sur l''oint de l''Eternel! Prends seulement la lance qui est à son chevet, avec la cruche d''eau, et allons-nous-en.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እግዚአብሔር በቀባው ላይ እጄን እዘረጋ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ከእኔ ያርቀው፤ አሁንም በራሱ አጠገብ ያለውን ጦርና የውኃውን መንቀል ይዘህ እንሂድ አለ።

verses.en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the Lord was fallen upon them.
verses.fr: David prit donc la lance et la cruche d''eau qui étaient au chevet de Saül; et ils s''en allèrent. Personne ne les vit ni ne s''aperçut de rien, et personne ne se réveilla, car ils dormaient tous d''un profond sommeil dans lequel l''Eternel les avait plongés.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በሳኦል ራስ አጠገብ የነበረውን ጦርና የውኃውን መንቀል ወሰደ፤ ማንም ሳያይ ሳያውቅም ሄዱ፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ከባድ እንቅልፍ ወድቆባቸው ነበርና ሁሉ ተኝተው ነበር እንጂ የነቃ አልነበረም።

verses.en: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:
verses.fr: David passa de l''autre côté, et s''arrêta au loin sur le sommet de la montagne, à une grande distance du camp.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ወደዚያ ተሻገረ፤ በተራራውም ራስ ላይ ርቆ ቆመ፤ በመካከላቸውም ሰፊ ስፍራ ነበረ።

verses.en: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?
verses.fr: Et il cria au peuple et à Abner, fils de Ner: Ne répondras-tu pas, Abner? Abner répondit: Qui es-tu, toi qui pousses des cris vers le roi?
verses.am: ዳዊትም ለሕዝቡና ለኔር ልጅ ለአበኔር። አበኔር ሆይ፥ አትመልስምን? ብሎ ጮኸ። አበኔርም መልሶ። ለንጉሡ የምትጮኸው አንተ ማን ነህ? አለ።

verses.en: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.
verses.fr: Et David dit à Abner: N''es-tu pas un homme? et qui est ton pareil en Israël? Pourquoi donc n''as-tu pas gardé le roi, ton maître? Car quelqu''un du peuple est venu pour tuer le roi, ton maître.
verses.am: ዳዊትም አበኔርን። አንተ ጕልማሳ አይደለህምን? በእስራኤል ዘንድ አንተን የሚመስል ማን ነው? ጌታህን ንጉሡን ለመግደል አንድ ሰው ገብቶ ነበርና ጌታህን ንጉሡን የማትጠብቅ ስለ ምን ነው?

verses.en: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the Lord liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the Lord's anointed. And now see where the king's spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.
verses.fr: Ce que tu as fait là n''est pas bien. L''Eternel est vivant! vous méritez la mort, pour n''avoir pas veillé sur votre maître, sur l''oint de l''Eternel. Regarde maintenant où sont la lance du roi et la cruche d''eau, qui étaient à son chevet!
verses.am: ይህ ያደረግኸው ነገር መልካም አይደለም፤ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እናንተ እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን ጌታችሁን አልጠበቃችሁምና ሞት ይገባችኋል፤ አሁንም የንጉሡ ጦርና በራሱ አጠገብ የነበረው የውኃው መንቀል የት እንደ ሆነ ተመልከት አለው።

verses.en: And Saul knew David's voice, and said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.
verses.fr: Saül reconnut la voix de David, et dit: Est-ce bien ta voix, mon fils David? Et David répondit: C''est ma voix, ô roi, mon seigneur!
verses.am: ሳኦልም የዳዊት ድምፅ እንደ ሆነ አውቆ። ልጄ ዳዊት ሆይ፥ ይህ ድምፅህ ነውን? አለው። ዳዊትም። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ድምፄ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?
verses.fr: Et il dit: Pourquoi mon seigneur poursuit-il son serviteur? Qu''ai-je fait, et de quoi suis-je coupable?
verses.am: ደግሞ አለ። ጌታዬ ባሪያውን ስለ ምን ያሳድዳል? ምን አደረግሁ? ምንስ ክፋት በእጄ ላይ ተገኘብኝ?

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If the Lord have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the Lord; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, Go, serve other gods.
verses.fr: Que le roi, mon seigneur, daigne maintenant écouter les paroles de son serviteur: si c''est l''Eternel qui t''excite contre moi, qu''il agrée le parfum d''une offrande; mais si ce sont des hommes, qu''ils soient maudits devant l''Eternel, puisqu''ils me chassent aujourd''hui pour me détacher de l''héritage de l''Eternel, et qu''ils me disent: Va servir des dieux étrangers!
verses.am: አሁንም ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ የእኔን የባሪያህን ቃል ትሰማ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር በእኔ ላይ አስነሥቶህ እንደ ሆነ፥ ቁርባንን ይቀበል፤ የሰው ልጆች ግን ቢሆኑ። ሂድ ሌሎችን አማልክት አምልክ ብለው በእግዚአብሔር ርስት ላይ እንዳልቀመጥ ዛሬ ጥለውኛልና በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርጉማን ይሁኑ።

verses.en: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the Lord: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.
verses.fr: Oh! que mon sang ne tombe pas en terre loin de la face de l''Eternel! Car le roi d''Israël s''est mis en marche pour chercher une puce, comme on chasserait une perdrix dans les montagnes.
verses.am: አሁንም በተራራው ላይ ሰው ቆቅን እንደሚሻ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነፍሴን ለመሻት ወጥቶአልና ደሜ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርቆ በምድር ላይ አይፍሰስ።

verses.en: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
verses.fr: Saül dit: J''ai péché; reviens, mon fils David, car je ne te ferai plus de mal, puisqu''en ce jour ma vie a été précieuse à tes yeux. J''ai agi comme un insensé, et j''ai fait une grande faute.
verses.am: ሳኦልም። በድያለሁ፤ ልጄ ሆይ ዳዊት፥ ተመለስ፤ ዛሬ ነፍሴ በዓይንህ ፊት ከብራለችና ከዚህ በኋላ ክፉ አላደርግብህም እነሆ፥ ስንፍና አድርጌአለሁ፥ እጅግ ብዙም ስቻለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
verses.fr: David répondit: Voici la lance du roi; que l''un de tes gens vienne la prendre.
verses.am: ዳዊትም መልሶ አለ። የንጉሥ ጦር እነሆ፥ ከብላቴኖችም አንድ ይምጣና ይውሰዳት።

verses.en: The Lord render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the Lord delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the Lord's anointed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel rendra à chacun selon sa justice et sa fidélité; car l''Eternel t''avait livré aujourd''hui entre mes mains, et je n''ai pas voulu porter la main sur l''oint de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዛሬም እግዚአብሔር በእጄ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶህ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር በቀባው ላይ እጄን እዘረጋ ዘንድ አልወደድሁምና ለሁሉ እያንዳንዱ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጽድቁና እንደ እምነቱ ፍዳውን ይክፈለው።

verses.en: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the Lord, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.
verses.fr: Et comme aujourd''hui ta vie a été d''un grand prix à mes yeux, ainsi ma vie sera d''un grand prix aux yeux de l''Eternel et il me délivrera de toute angoisse.
verses.am: ነፍስህም ዛሬ በዓይኔ ፊት እንደ ከበረች እንዲሁ ነፍሴ በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ፊት ትክበር፥ ከመከራም ሁሉ ያድነኝ።

verses.en: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things, and also shalt still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
verses.fr: Saül dit à David: Sois béni, mon fils David! tu réussiras dans tes entreprises. David continua son chemin, et Saül retourna chez lui.
verses.am: ሳኦል ዳዊትን። ልጄ ዳዊት ሆይ፥ ቡሩክ ሁን፤ ማድረግን ታደርጋለህ፥ መቻልንም ትችላለህ አለው። ዳዊትም መንገዱን ሄደ፥ ሳኦልም ወደ ስፍራው ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.
verses.fr: David dit en lui-même: je périrai un jour par la main de Saül; il n''y a rien de mieux pour moi que de me réfugier au pays des Philistins, afin que Saül renonce à me chercher encore dans tout le territoire d''Israël; ainsi j''échapperai à sa main.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በልቡ። አንድ ቀን በሳኦል እጅ እጠፋለሁ፤ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ምድር ከመሸሽ በቀር የሚሻለኝ የለም፤ ሳኦልም በእስራኤል አውራጃ ሁሉ እኔን መሻት ይተዋል፥ እንዲሁም ከእጁ እድናለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
verses.fr: Et David se leva, lui et les six cents hommes qui étaient avec lui, et ils passèrent chez Akisch, fils de Maoc, roi de Gath.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ስድስቱ መቶ ሰዎች ተነሥተው ወደ ጌት ንጉሥ ወደ አሜህ ልጅ ወደ አንኩስ አለፉ።

verses.en: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.
verses.fr: David et ses gens restèrent à Gath auprès d''Akisch; ils avaient chacun leur famille, et David avait ses deux femmes, Achinoam de Jizreel, et Abigaïl de Carmel, femme de Nabal.
verses.am: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም እያንዳንዳቸው ከነ ቤተ ሰቡ ከአንኩስ ጋር በጌት ውስጥ ተቀመጡ፤ ከዳዊትም ጋር ኢይዝራኤላዊቱ አኪናሆምና የቀርሜሎሳዊው የናባል ሚስት አቢግያ ሁለቱ ሚስቶቹ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
verses.fr: Saül, informé que David s''était enfui à Gath, cessa de le chercher.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ዳዊት ወደ ጌት እንደ ኰበለለ ሰማ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ደግሞ አልፈለገውም።

verses.en: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?
verses.fr: David dit à Akisch: Si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, qu''on me donne dans l''une des villes du pays un lieu où je puisse demeurer; car pourquoi ton serviteur habiterait-il avec toi dans la ville royale?
verses.am: ዳዊትም አንኩስን። በዓይንህ ፊት ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ በዚህ አገር በአንዲቱ ከተማ የምቀመጥበት ስፍራ ስጠኝ፤ ስለ ምን እኔ ባሪያህ ከአንተ ጋር በንጉሥ ከተማ እቀመጣለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
verses.fr: Et ce même jour Akisch lui donna Tsiklag. C''est pourquoi Tsiklag a appartenu aux rois de Juda jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን አንኩስ ጺቅላግን ሰጠው፤ ስለዚህም ጺቅላግ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ለይሁዳ ነገሥታት ሆነች።

verses.en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
verses.fr: Le temps que David demeura dans le pays des Philistins fut d''un an et quatre mois.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በፍልስጥኤማውያን አገር የተቀመጠበት የዘመን ቍጥር አንድ ዓመት ከአራት ወር ነበረ።

verses.en: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: David et ses gens montaient et faisaient des incursions chez les Gueschuriens, les Guirziens et les Amalécites; car ces nations habitaient dès les temps anciens la contrée, du côté de Schur et jusqu''au pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ዳዊትና ሰዎቹም ወጥተው በጌሹራውያንና በጌርዛውያን በአማሌቃውያንም ላይ ዘመቱ፤ እነዚህም እስከ ሱር እስከ ግብጽ ምድር ድረስ ባለው አገር ድሮውኑ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.en: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.
verses.fr: David ravageait cette contrée; il ne laissait en vie ni homme ni femme, et il enlevait les brebis, les boeufs, les ânes, les chameaux, les vêtements, puis s''en retournait et allait chez Akisch.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ምድሪቱን መታ፤ ወንድ ሆነ ሴትም ሆነ ማንንም በሕይወት አልተወም፤ በጎችንና ላሞችን አህያዎችንና ግመሎችን ልብስንም ማረከ፥ ተመልሶም ወደ አንኩስ መጣ።

verses.en: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.
verses.fr: Akisch disait: Où avez-vous fait aujourd''hui vos courses? Et David répondait: Vers le midi de Juda, vers le midi des Jerachmeélites et vers le midi des Kéniens.
verses.am: አንኩስም። ዛሬ በማን ላይ ዘመታችሁ? አለ፤ ዳዊትም። በይሁዳ ደቡብ፥ በይረሕምኤላውያንም ደቡብ፥ በቄናውያንም ደቡብ ላይ ዘመትን አለ።

verses.en: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.
verses.fr: David ne laissait en vie ni homme ni femme, pour les amener à Gath; car, pensait-il, ils pourraient parler contre nous et dire: Ainsi a fait David. Et ce fut là sa manière d''agir tout le temps qu''il demeura dans le pays des Philistins.
verses.am: ዳዊት እንዲህ አደረገ በፍልስጥኤማውያንም አገር በሚቀመጥበት ዘመን ሁሉ ልማዱ ይህ ነበረ ብለው እንዳይናገሩብን ብሎ ዳዊት ወደ ጌት ያመጣቸው ዘንድ ወንድም ሆነ ሴትም ሆነ ማንንም በሕይወት አልተወም።

verses.en: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.
verses.fr: Akisch se fiait à David, et il disait: Il se rend odieux à Israël, son peuple, et il sera mon serviteur à jamais.
verses.am: አንኩስም። በሕዝቡ በእስራኤል ዘንድ እጅግ የተጠላ ሆኖአል፤ ስለዚህም ለዘላለም ባሪያ ይሆነኛል ብሎ ዳዊትን አመነው።

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, les Philistins rassemblèrent leurs troupes et formèrent une armée, pour faire la guerre à Israël. Akisch dit à David: Tu sais que tu viendras avec moi à l''armée, toi et tes gens.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በዚያ ወራት ከእስራኤል ጋር ይዋጉ ዘንድ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ጭፍሮቻቸውን ለሰልፍ ሰበሰቡ፤ አንኩስም ዳዊትን። አንተና ሰዎችህ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ እንድትወጡ በእርግጥ እወቅ አለው።

verses.en: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.
verses.fr: David répondit à Akisch: Tu verras bien ce que ton serviteur fera. Et Akisch dit à David: Aussi je te donnerai pour toujours la garde de ma personne.
verses.am: ዳዊትም አንኩስን። አሁን ባሪያህ የሚያደርገውን ታያለህ አለው። አንኩስም ዳዊትን። እንግዲህ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ራሴን ጠባቂ አደርግሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.
verses.fr: Samuel était mort; tout Israël l''avait pleuré, et on l''avait enterré à Rama, dans sa ville. Saül avait ôté du pays ceux qui évoquaient les morts et ceux qui prédisaient l''avenir.
verses.am: ሳሙኤል ግን ሞቶ ነበር፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ አልቅሰውለት ነበር፥ በከተማውም በአርማቴም ቀብረውት ነበር። ሳኦልም መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ከምድር አጥፍቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
